description_raw:
Master Works is seeking a SAP Technical/Functional, Consultant will be responsible for extracting data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems and integrating it into the Cloudera/HDFS data platform. The role requires strong knowledge of SAP functional modules, SAP data structures, extraction methods, and enterprise data-engineering tools.

Key Responsibilities:
Extract data from SAP (ECC/S4HANA) and load into Cloudera/HDFS
Strong SAP functional knowledge (MM/SD/FI modules) and SAP data model (transparent, cluster/pool tables)
ABAP / Open SQL skills to write and validate extraction queries (SE16N, SQVI, ABAP reports)
Experience with SAP extraction methods: SLT, ODP, BODS, or CDS views
Comfortable handling delta/CDC loads from SAP
Apache Airflow: orchestration and scheduling of extraction/load pipelines
Informatica (PowerCenter/BDM): ETL development and SAP connector experience
Apache Spark/PySpark: data transformation and processing on Cloudera

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in SAP data extraction and integration.
Strong functional knowledge of SAP MM, SD, and FI modules.
Hands-on experience with SAP ECC/S4HANA, ABAP, Open SQL, SLT, ODP, BODS, or CDS Views.
Experience with Cloudera/HDFS, Apache Airflow, Informatica PowerCenter/BDM, and Apache Spark/PySpark.
Strong understanding of SAP data models and delta/CDC loading processes.
Strong functional knowledge of SAP MM, SD, and FI modules.
Strong understanding of the SAP data model, including transparent, cluster, and pool tables.
Proficiency in ABAP and Open SQL.
Experience with SAP extraction methods and delta/CDC loads.
Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow and Informatica PowerCenter/BDM.
Proficiency in Apache Spark/PySpark and Cloudera/HDFS.

Client Site

Experience of delivery projects in Middle East region, especially in Saudi Arabia
Excellent stakeholder management, ability to connect and present to senior leadership team of client

title_raw: ServiceNow Support Engineer - Service & Change Management
description_raw:
Job Purpose

To provide technical and functional support for the ServiceNow platform, with a focus on Service Management and Change Management processes. The role will ensure the stability, availability, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow services while supporting ITSM operations within a banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

Provide L2/L3 support for ServiceNow, including incident, problem, request, and change management processes.
Administer and support ServiceNow ITSM modules, ensuring reliable and efficient day-to-day operations.
Manage and support Change Management workflows, approvals, change scheduling, risk assessment, and implementation processes.
Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow incidents, defects, workflow issues, and integration-related problems.
Monitor ServiceNow platform performance and identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement.
Configure and maintain ServiceNow forms, workflows, business rules, notifications, SLAs, and user access based on approved requirements.
Support Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities and ensure changes follow established governance and approval procedures.
Work closely with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Application Support, Development, and other technology teams to resolve ServiceNow-related issues.
Support integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems and coordinate troubleshooting with relevant technical teams.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Prepare operational reports and dashboards related to incidents, requests, changes, SLAs, and service performance.
Ensure ServiceNow processes and configurations align with ITSM best practices, internal controls, and banking policies.
Participate in ServiceNow upgrades, releases, enhancements, testing, and deployment activities.
Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and configuration records.
Ensure compliance with information security, audit, risk, and regulatory requirements applicable to the banking environment.
Participate in 24/7 support and on-call activities, when required.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
4–7 years of experience in ServiceNow administration, support, or ITSM platform operations.
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITSM, particularly Incident, Problem, Request, and Change Management.
Strong understanding of ITIL processes and IT Service Management practices.
Practical experience supporting Change Management and CAB processes.
Previous experience working in a banking or financial services environment is required.
Experience with ServiceNow configuration, workflows, business rules, SLAs, notifications, and access management.
Good understanding of ServiceNow integrations and APIs.
Experience with ServiceNow upgrades, releases, testing, and production support.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
Good understanding of IT governance, risk, compliance, and change control within regulated environments.
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) is preferred; ITIL certification is an advantage.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Design, develop, and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines to produce clean, structured, and reliable datasets.

Develop and test data transformations using SQL, Python, and PySpark.

Collaborate with Data Integration, Data Engineering, BI, and Analytics Engineering teams to support data initiatives.

Participate in capacity planning, platform optimization, and cost-management initiatives.
Provide coverage and support for Data Integration activities during team absences or periods of increased workload.

Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark, Apache Spark, Trino, and Apache Airflow.
Hands-on experience with lakehouse architecture, object storage, and ELT/ETL development.
Practical experience with Bitbucket, Jenkins, and CI/CD practices.
Knowledge of access management, platform monitoring, incident response, and performance optimization.
Experience working with enterprise data platforms and supporting production data environments.

ELT/ETL Pipeline Development
Apache Airflow Orchestration
SQL, Python & PySpark
Apache Spark & Trino
Lakehouse Architecture & Object Storage
CI/CD using Bitbucket & Jenkins
Data Platform Administration
Access, Role, Permission & Quota Management

Performance & Storage Optimization

description_raw:
Job Purpose

Support the successful delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement of Data & AI products by acting as the bridge between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and technology partners. Manage product requirements, backlog execution, user acceptance activities, release coordination, and ongoing product performance to ensure business needs are translated into valuable and scalable Data & AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Product Delivery & Lifecycle Management

Support end-to-end delivery of Data & AI products from requirement definition through deployment and adoption.
Manage and maintain product backlogs, user stories, features, and enhancement requests.
Coordinate delivery activities with business stakeholders, project teams, and implementation partners.
Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, and delivery tracking.
Monitor product performance and ensure timely resolution of issues and enhancement requests.

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

Gather, document, and validate business requirements.
Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Conduct stakeholder workshops, requirement walkthroughs, and product demonstrations.
Ensure requirements are clearly understood by delivery and development teams.
Support prioritization of requirements based on business value and strategic objectives.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the primary interface between business users and delivery teams for assigned products.
Maintain regular engagement with functional stakeholders to align product requirements and priorities.
Support communication of product updates, releases, and enhancement plans.
Facilitate issue resolution and coordinate stakeholder feedback.

Testing & Release Management

Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
Ensure test scenarios and acceptance criteria are defined and validated.
Support defect triage and resolution management.
Participate in release readiness reviews and production deployment activities.
Monitor post-release performance and business adoption.

Product Adoption & Continuous Improvement

Support product adoption and value realization initiatives.
Gather user feedback and identify opportunities for product enhancements.
Track product utilization, adoption trends, and business benefits.
Support training, communication, and change management activities for assigned products.
Recommend improvements to maximize user experience and business value.

Governance & Compliance

Ensure products comply with established Data & AI governance standards.
Support adherence to data governance, security, PDPL, and organizational policies.
Maintain product documentation, requirements repositories, and operational procedures.
Support reporting of product status, risks, issues, and performance metrics.

Requirements

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
0-3 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Digital Products, Data & AI, Analytics, or Technology Delivery.
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and product management principles.
Knowledge of Data & AI products, analytics platforms, reporting solutions, or digital products is preferred.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.
Professional certifications such as PSPO, CSPO, Agile, Scrum, or Business Analysis certifications are preferred.

description_raw:
Reliable hardware and seamless software are at the heart of every day-to-day IHG experience. To deliver a truly first-class service, we need an IT Supervisor capable of installing new systems, boosting security and setting exceptional standards. While making sure our teams have all the tools and resources, they need to make a difference, right at their fingertips.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:
 Being our primary contact for servicing our computer hardware, making sure systems are installed properly and working efficiently and regularly reporting back to the GM, Director of Finance and Business Support and Area IT Leader
 Keeping up to date with all our approved systems and technology – from LAN to POS
 Maintaining hardware and software performance, digital and physical security standards and evaluating vendor proposals
 Passing on your expertise to the hotel team by running knowledge sharing and training sessions
 Safeguarding our IT infrastructure against cyberthreats

What We need from you:
 Diploma or Vocational Certificate in Computer Science or IT or related field
 4 years’ related experience with computer set-up and troubleshooting
 Working knowledge of networks, operating systems, and databases
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Knowledge in PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards)
 Great communication skills
 You’ll be a team player, proactive, responsible, hardworking, and able to work under pressure

What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our myWellbeing
framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Adree is seeking a Devops Engineer, Senior to support product development and platform automation initiatives by leveraging technical and analytical expertise to design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure solutions that enable efficient and automated software delivery. The role focuses on bridging development and operations through CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automation practices to ensure seamless deployment, system reliability, and standardized delivery processes with full visibility and auditability.

Key Responsibilities
Engage with clients and stakeholders to gather platform requirements and understand digital transformation and automation goals.
Deliver presentations and documentation that demonstrate CI/CD capabilities, including:
Agent pool management
Environment provisioning
Enterprise pipeline design
Support product and engineering teams by creating reusable pipeline templates and secure shared libraries in Azure DevOps Server.
Provide DevOps expertise across the product lifecycle to:
Enforce complex branching strategies
Optimize build runner performance
Maintain Linux-based runner systems
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security and QA) to:
Manage 3rd-party libraries
Integrate OpenText security tooling (Fortify SCA)
Embed automated testing automation frameworks
Stay current with industry trends in containerization, automation workflows, and infrastructure delivery mechanisms to position solutions effectively.
Conduct internal and client workshops to enable GitOps delivery and workload promotion using Argo CD to OpenShift/Kubernetes platforms.
Participate in Agile development and release processes by integrating monitoring hooks and driving production deployment patterns, including:
AppDynamics / BMC / Azure Monitoring

Requirements

Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

Experience
6–10+ years of professional experience in:
DevOps
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Build & Release automation in enterprise environments
Proven, hands-on production delivery exposure (e.g., scaling live environments, not only sandbox/testing environments).
Experience in government, heavily regulated, or complex enterprise sectors is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies (Technical & Analytical + Soft)

Deep expertise in:
CI/CD pipeline engineering and secure pipeline patterns
Agent pool configuration
Advanced branching strategies
Strong hands-on containerization and orchestration experience:
Docker
Kubernetes
Red Hat OpenShift
Practical infrastructure automation skills:
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
Configuration management (Ansible)
Linux administration and systems scripting
Familiarity with enterprise artifact and dependency management:
JFrog Artifactory
Binary artifact and 3rd-party library handling
Analytical capability to implement secure application pipelines, including:
Fortify SCA
HashiCorp Vault secrets
Sigstore / SecurEnvoy MFA verification setups
Strong soft skills:
Excellent communication
Coaching mindset
Cross-team collaboration (Developers, Security, QA)
High ownership and accountability

Experience Summary (Must-Have Themes)

Enterprise-grade CI/CD template design and multi-agent pool management
Core infrastructure automation using IaC and configuration management
GitOps continuous delivery execution into live production
CI/CD + automation testing frameworks integrated with OpenText security validation
Third-party library compliance management and secure artifact storage
Production-level application profiling and monitoring hook setups
Documentation authorship

Location: client site

About Us

Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.

Tamara is Saudi Arabia’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others. The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to take us to the next stage of growth across the Credit department. The successful candidate will have experience developing analytical solutions and assisting with data-driven decision making, while managing stakeholders across a broad range of functions. Tamara is a high growth startup looking to develop key product success metrics and enhancing decision making through data.

Your Responsibilities

Drive business impact through actionable insights and identifying key opportunities for rapid growth
Build dashboards that provide accurate and actionable insights
Work with the data engineering team on the data enrichment needs of the product team
Work with stakeholders across the business to prioritize projects based on impact and drive delivery
Developing a process to identify, analyse, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets, empower informed decision making for stakeholders
Ensuring governance and being a steward of good analytical practices throughout the process

Your Expertise

6+ years of experience in data analytics
Expertise in Credit Risk Analytics or Collections is a must
Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science or other analytical field. Graduates from other fields with relevant knowledge and experience are welcome to apply.
Hands on experience using programming (Python, R) to manipulate large data sets for insights
Demonstrated proficiency in one or more implementations of SQL (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL)
Display understanding of your domain of interest - Whether its Finance, Risk, or Product
Experience using Machine Learning tools and techniques in R or Python a plus!
Experience using one or more data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Qlik)
Experience creating data visualizations and dashboards with Apache Superset a bonus
Experience in a high-growth startup or unicorn a bonus!

All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

00440K - Data Solutions and Storage Intern (COOP)

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

At HPE, our team members search beyond customers' needs today to accelerate what’s next and make a difference — for others, our company, and the planet. Our customers turn to us because we are positive, empathetic, and enterprising. We embrace opportunities to accelerate this transformation across data, connectivity, cloud, and security. And together we make what was once thought impossible, possible.

That’s why we not only give you the space to grow into the professional you want to be, but we also embrace who you are and where you come from. We also value flexibility and autonomy to balance work and personal needs in a way that works best for you.

The Data Solutions team has responsibility for HPE’s Hybrid Cloud Vision and fulling partner and customer demand based on these key areas;

· Storage Solutions for structured and unstructured data, either Fiber Channel or ethernet for performance workloads such as SAP/Oracle to S3 repositories and data lakes use cases for AI.

· Private Cloud Solutions for edge to core based on our own HPE technology offering a turnkey solution.

· Cyber Resilience Solutions with based on Zerto or other integrations with ISV partners.

· We are also responsible for defining the future of our solutions and their integration into the HPE Green lake offering.

A career as a Data Solutions Intern includes working within the existing established team in Saudi Arabia. Supporting the team with real hands-on experience, increasing your knowledge of Hybrid Cloud solutions from storage to compute at a presales level. Working with a very knowledgeable team looking at megatrends and exceeding partner/customer expectations.

Our internship provides you with an opportunity to gain real world experience and make an immediate impact at HPE. You’ll get assigned meaningful projects, gain exposure to leaders, and connect with other interns. Key aspects of our internship program include learning and professional development, social and networking events, and volunteer opportunities.

What you'll do:

· Support proposals and customer engagements across projects of different size and complexities.

· Engage with HPE Hybrid Cloud Product Management teams to help shape the future portfolio.

· Join early-stage conversations and build capability by working closely with the local team.

· Back the local team on live engagements, from scoping through delivery.

Locations:

· Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

What you’ll need:

· Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree with a focus in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information & Communication Technology or other IT related field.

Interest in the following:

· Server and storage hardware and solutions, operating systems, networks, and communications.

· An understanding of data lakes, megatrends, market demand and storage technologies.

· Knowledge of Fiber Channel and Ethernet networks.

· Ability to create clear documentation of processes, investigations, and proposals.

What we’d prefer you bring:

· On track to receive a 2:1 or higher

· The drive to seek out what’s next and to deliver exceptional results

· A collaborative, solution focused spirit and overall sense of urgency

· Experience as an active leader on campus who strives to make a positive impact on the world

· Comfort with working in a hybrid (virtual and face-to-face) environment

· Exceptional communication and presentation skills and the ability to ask smart questions

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Are you passionate about being part of a successful team?

Would you like the opportunity to work for a world class oilfield services company?

Join our team!

our organization increasingly adopts AI-enabled and agentic ways of working, we are looking for individuals who combine strong scientific and engineering fundamentals with curiosity, adaptability, and a bias for execution. Success in this role requires the ability to rapidly learn emerging technologies, collaborate across disciplines, and contribute throughout the entire solution lifecycle from problem framing and experimentation through deployment, operationalization, and continuous improvement.

Experience in Oil & Gas and an appreciation for the importance of domain context in solving real business problems are highly valued.

Partner with the best:

As a Digital Technology Specialist, you will be responsible for:

Identify, frame, and solve complex business and operational challenges using data science, machine learning, AI, optimization, and software engineering techniques.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain end-to-end data and AI solutions that create measurable business impact.
Translate analytical concepts into scalable, reliable, and maintainable production systems.
Contribute across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements discovery, experimentation, development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with domain experts to incorporate operational context and business constraints into solution design.
Leverage modern AI-assisted development practices and emerging technologies to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering rigor, quality, and governance.
Work closely with data engineers and platform teams to ensure data quality, reliability, scalability, and observability.
Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and methodologies, adopting them where they provide meaningful business value.
Communicate technical findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute actively within Agile teams operating across multiple locations, functions, and time zones.
Document, share, and promote best practices that improve team effectiveness and technical excellence.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

Have a bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Information Systems, or another STEM discipline.
Have a minimum 4 years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, analytics, software engineering, or a closely related technical field.
Demonstrated experience delivering solutions from concept through production deployment.
Have a strong programming and software engineering fundamentals.
Proven ability to learn and apply new technologies, frameworks, and methodologies in rapidly evolving environments.
Technical Expertise
Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing production-quality software.
Experience with modern development ecosystems and cloud-native technologies, such as:
Python
TypeScript
Go and/or Rust
AWS
Databricks
Git-based CI/CD pipelines
Containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with machine learning, AI, optimization, statistical analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, agentic systems, and AI application development.
Understanding of software architecture, testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence.
Experience working with structured, semi-structured, and time-series industrial data.
Strong data visualization, storytelling, and stakeholder communication skills.
Domain Knowledge
Experience in Oil & Gas, energy, industrial operations, manufacturing, or related sectors is strongly preferred.
Ability to combine domain understanding with analytical and engineering expertise to solve practical business problems.
Understanding of operational workflows, reliability, production optimization, asset performance, or related industrial challenges is advantageous.
Leadership & Collaboration
Demonstrated ability to contribute effectively within cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
Strong critical thinking, systems thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to balance experimentation with disciplined execution.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
Ability to influence technical direction through evidence, collaboration, and demonstrated results.
Desired Mindset & Ways of Working
Successful candidates will demonstrate behaviors aligned with the culture and aspirations of Baker Hughes. In particular, we value individuals who:
Embrace change and continuously learn in rapidly evolving technology environments.
Innovate courageously and challenge conventional approaches when better solutions exist.
Focus on delivering measurable business outcomes rather than solely producing technical outputs.
Build trust through transparent communication, active listening, and effective collaboration across multidisciplinary and global teams.
Create value for customers and stakeholders through practical, impactful solutions.
Apply sound scientific, analytical, and engineering principles while balancing experimentation, rigor, and execution.
Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a willingness to see solutions through from inception to operational adoption.
Approach ambiguity with curiosity and confidence, creating clarity where it does not yet exist.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.

Comprehensive private medical care options.

Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.

Tailored financial programs.

Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Job Description:

The opportunity

As Trainee - Improvement Process, you will be responsible for learning and onboarding in various programs and functions across the organization in 6 months spells, seeking to further comprehension of the company and its workings for accelerated growth and progression within the organization. Key areas of responsibility include: Shadowing and working with individuals within various organizational roles, learning complex skills and inner company comprehension, including but not limited to site experience, product training and mentorship program work. Demonstrating a high technical comprehension, including strong aspects of a conceptual and analytical mindset, proving an ability to innovate and improve processes where necessary. Maintaining a close and strong relationship with all colleagues and stakeholders, showing a true ability to lead and motivate others. Proving a high-level comprehension of the company’s core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility where applicable, typically achieving discipline within a given role after approximately twelve months. An Entry Professional (P1) applies broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. May require the following proficiency: Work is closely supervised. Problems faced are not typically difficult or complex. Explains facts, policies and practices related to job area.

How you’ll make an impact

You will play a critical role in supporting the Continuous Improvement team in driving operational excellence through the application of Lean, Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, and process improvement methodologies. The role is designed to develop technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills while contributing to productivity, quality, delivery, cost, and safety improvement initiatives. The trainee will gain hands-on experience in data analysis, process mapping, root cause analysis, and project execution. This aligns with the organization's focus on enhancing efficiency, reducing waste, improving quality, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Continuous Improvement Projects

Support Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, and operational excellence projects.
Assist in identifying process improvement opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and support functions.
Participate in project teams to improve productivity, quality, delivery performance, and cost efficiency.
Collect and validate project data and assist in preparing project documentation.

Process Analysis & Optimization

Conduct process mapping and value stream mapping exercises.
Identify waste, bottlenecks, and non-value-added activities.
Support implementation of standardized work and process optimization initiatives.
Assist in monitoring improvement actions and sustainability plans.

Data Analysis & Reporting

Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data.
Develop dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools.
Support performance reviews by providing trend analysis and improvement insights.
Maintain project trackers and improvement databases.

Problem Solving

Participate in structured problem-solving activities using:
PDCA
DMAIC
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Pareto Analysis
A3 Problem Solving
Assist teams in investigating root causes and implementing corrective actions.

Lean & Six Sigma Deployment

Support Lean awareness and training programs.
Participate in Kaizen events, Gemba walks, and workshops.
Assist in promoting a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement.
Support Lean Six Sigma certification activities and project reviews.

Documentation & Governance

Maintain improvement project records and lessons learned.
Support development of work instructions, standard operating procedures, and best practices.
Ensure compliance with company quality, safety, and environmental requirements.
You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background

A bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Software engineering, Computer Science and, Management Information Systems or a related field.
Fresh Graduate with basic knowledge of Continuous Improvement Projects, Data Analysis and Reporting, Problem Solving, and Documentation.
Proficiency in both spoken & written in English & Arabic language is required.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.

This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.

Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment

As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

Background Screening and Security Checks

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.

The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

Permanent Contract
Mid-Senior Level
Riyadh
Technical Engineering
About the Role

Responsible for the operational tasks for account administration, eDiscovery, incident response, waiver/policy assistance, and implementation of cyber security/protection technologies for the Project information and process systems/applications.
Acts as contact with suppliers to develop technical solutions for computer security needs and makes recommendations to management.
Develops, maintains, and audits the analytical and technical aspects of major computer security systems.
Maintains the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of computer workstations, servers, and local area networks by maintaining user accounts and upgrading systems and software as required.
Responsible for secure operations of security equipment, secure transmission of sensitive unclassified information and protection of cryptographic principles and methods.
Mitigates threats and vulnerabilities that are associated with potentially compromising corporate and client data.
Provides technical support, training, and timely computer system data recovery to end-users.
Oversees the investigation of computer security incidents and acts as an assistant for cyber security initiatives.
Conducts operations of computer protection measures and creates measurement tools for system vulnerability assessments.
Serves on project teams and internal committees to represent cyber security interests.
Oversee the client/server/infrastructure group on appropriate procedures for computer/system security.

What do we need from you

Required Skills and Experience:

15+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity roles, with at least 5 years in a senior or leadership capacity
Advanced knowledge of network security, threat analysis, and incident response procedures
Proficiency with security tools and platforms, including firewalls, SIEM systems, and intrusion detection systems
Strong understanding of security protocols, vulnerability management, and risk assessment methodologies
Experience with security auditing, compliance frameworks, and regulatory requirements
Demonstrated expertise in firewall configuration, network segmentation, and access control implementation
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make decisive security decisions
Strong organizational and project management capabilities
Proficiency in security documentation and technical report writing

Preferred Skills and Experience:

Experience with cloud security platforms and hybrid security architectures
Knowledge of penetration testing and ethical hacking methodologies
Familiarity with security information and event management (SIEM) tools
Understanding of encryption technologies and data protection mechanisms
Experience with digital forensics and malware analysis
Knowledge of cybersecurity requirements specific to the Middle East region
Familiarity with local Saudi Arabian compliance standards and regulations

Certifications and Domain Expertise:

CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or equivalent certification preferred
CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) or similar advanced security certification
CCNA Security or comparable networking security certification
Domain expertise in enterprise security, information security management, and risk management

description_raw:
Who Are We

HALA is a leading fintech player in the MENAP region that aims to redefine financial services and build the future bank of SMEs. HALA aims at empowering SMEs to start, run, and grow their businesses by providing them with cutting-edge financial and technological tools.

HALA currently holds multiple entities in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt (including HALA Payments and HALA Logistics) and offers solutions that enable merchants to digitize their payments as well as manage their sales and operations.

Founded in 2017, HALA is currently licensed by the Saudi Arabian Central Bank.
Responsibilities 
Governance & Strategy:
Develop, implement, and continuously improve the organization's Information Security Governance framework, policies, standards, and procedures.
Lead the creation and execution of the Cyber Security Strategy in alignment with the company's overall business goals.
Providing regular reports to the Board of Directors and executive management on the state of cybersecurity.
Establish and manage a security metrics and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) program to measure the effectiveness of the security program and report on progress.
Oversee the information security budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively to manage risk.
Risk Management:
Design and manage a comprehensive enterprise-wide Cyber Security Risk Management program.
Conduct regular risk assessments, including Business Impact Analysis (BIA), to identify, analyze, and evaluate information security risks.
Facilitate risk treatment planning with business and technology owners, ensuring appropriate mitigation, acceptance, or transfer strategies are implemented.
Manage the vendor risk management program, assessing the security posture of third-party vendors and partners, especially cloud service providers and payment gateways.
Integrate risk management into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management processes.
Regulatory Compliance:
Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all regulatory examinations and audits related to cybersecurity (e.g., SAMA, CMA).
Ensure continuous compliance with SAMA's Cyber Security Framework (CSF), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) requirements, and other relevant regulations.
Manage the process for obtaining and maintaining necessary regulatory licenses and certifications from a cybersecurity perspective.
Prepare and submit accurate and timely regulatory reports, questionnaires, and evidence requests.
Monitor the regulatory landscape for changes in laws, regulations, and standards, and proactively advise the business on required adjustments.
Audit & Assurance:
Manage all internal and external security audits, including coordinating with auditors, providing evidence, and tracking remediation of findings.
Develop and maintain a robust control testing program to validate the effectiveness of key security controls.
Manage the remediation of all audit and assessment findings, ensuring they are closed out effectively and permanently.
Awareness & Culture:
Develop and deliver a security awareness and training program tailored to different roles within the organization, with a focus on local context and threats.
Champion a strong security culture, ensuring that every employee understands their role in protecting the company's information assets.
What We Offer You
We believe you will love working at HALA!
We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in remote, in-office, and hybrid work setups.
We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including the potential for shares.
We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 7 countries and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.
If you think you have what it takes to join a remarkable team #apply_now 
Show more Show less

Meet the Team

• We are at the forefront of the AI revolution, building the secure, intelligent, and resilient network infrastructure that serves as the foundation for modern autonomous systems and predictive analytics.

• We act as strategic partners to our customers, translating complex business ambitions into robust digital architectures that drive global innovation.

• Our work is integral to the broader Cisco mission, ensuring our technology serves as a catalyst for our customers' most critical digital and AI initiatives.

• We foster a collaborative, high-energy environment where technologists are encouraged to solve sophisticated challenges and push the boundaries of what is possible.

• You will have the opportunity to make a tangible, large-scale impact while helping shape the future of enterprise technology.

Your Impact

• Orchestrate the full power of the Cisco portfolio to design and deliver transformative technical outcomes that align with our customers' strategic business goals.

• Architect comprehensive, multi-architecture solutions across networking, security, cloud, and AI to build the resilient platforms necessary for customer digital success.

• Lead end-to-end technical strategy and customized proofs-of-value to demonstrate the art of the possible and solve our customers' most critical technical challenges.

• Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level stakeholders, providing expert guidance on navigating the complexities of modern IT and emerging AI opportunities.

• Influence the future of Cisco products by serving as a critical feedback loop between our customers and our internal engineering and product development teams.

Minimum Qualifications

• Extensive experience in a pre-sales engineering or similar customer-facing technical role.

• Significant technical experience in at least two of the following areas: Enterprise Networking, Data Center, Security, or Collaboration.

• Substantial experience delivering technical presentations to internal partners or external customers.

• Demonstrated experience managing technical relationships with customers and partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• Deep, cross-architectural understanding of how technology domains intersect, such as the integration of security with cloud strategy.

• Proven experience leading complex technical sales cycles for large-scale enterprise accounts.

• Exceptional ability to articulate a technical vision and translate it into tangible business outcomes for executive-level audiences.

• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their relationship to on-premise and hybrid infrastructure.

• Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and a history of mentoring others, with industry certifications such as CCIE or CCDE highly valued.

• Nature of the Work: Hybrid full time
• Hours of work: 48 hours per week
• Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
• Application start and end date: Starting 9th of Septmber 2026 for approx. 4-6 weeks

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title_raw: Position Senior SAP PP & QM Consultant
description_raw:
*Senior SAP PP & QM Consultant*

* *Work Location:* Onsite
* *Preferred Candidate Profile:* Arabic nationality
* *Gender:* Any
* *Experience Required:* 10–15 years
* *Salary:* Up to SAR 25,000 per month

The Senior SAP PP & QM Consultant will be responsible for the design, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) modules across GASCO Group’s manufacturing and industrial entities.

The successful candidate must also have strong working exposure to SAP Materials Management (MM), ensuring seamless integration across procure-to-produce, production execution, inventory, and quality inspection processes.

This position will serve as the functional authority for production planning, shop-floor execution, and quality processes within the SAP landscape, working closely with plant operations, procurement, quality, finance, and IT teams.

*Key Duties and Responsibilities *
SAP Production Planning (PP)

* Configure and support demand management, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), capacity planning, and production order execution across discrete, repetitive, and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Maintain and optimize production master data, including:
* Material master records
* Bills of Materials (BOMs)
* Work centers and resources
* Routings and recipes
* Production versions
* Manage and support the complete production order lifecycle, including order creation, release, material issue, confirmation, goods receipt, settlement, and variance resolution.
* Support production scheduling, shop-floor control, and PP integration with SAP QM and MM.
* Improve planning strategies, including Make-to-Stock (MTS) and Make-to-Order (MTO), according to plant and business requirements.

*SAP Quality Management (QM)*

* Configure and maintain inspection types, inspection plans, sampling procedures, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), and quality information records.
* Support incoming, in-process, and outgoing quality inspections, including inspection lot processing, results recording, usage decisions, defects, and quality notifications.
* Manage quality notifications, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), vendor quality processes, batch management, and vendor evaluation integration.
* Support compliance-related quality documentation and audit readiness in line with regulatory, customer, and applicable NCA requirements.

*SAP Materials Management (MM) Integration*

* Ensure effective integration between SAP PP/QM and MM for raw-material procurement, subcontracting, goods movements, inventory management, and material valuation.
* Support material master data governance, including views related to planning, procurement, quality, inventory, batch management, and stock status.
* Troubleshoot cross-functional issues involving procurement, inspection lot creation, batch status, quality stock, and inventory postings.

*General and Cross-Functional Responsibilities*

* Gather requirements from production, plant, quality, and procurement stakeholders and translate them into clear functional specifications.
* Prepare and maintain configuration documents, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, process documents, and end-user guides.
* Lead or support SAP S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and continuous-improvement initiatives across GASCO Group entities.
* Coordinate with ABAP and other technical teams on system enhancements, interfaces, forms, workflows, and reports.
* Conduct functional testing, integration testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and solution validation.
* Provide day-to-day production support, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution in accordance with agreed SLAs.
* Mentor junior consultants and support knowledge transfer within the SAP Center of Excellence.

*Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* SAP certification in PP and/or QM is preferred but not mandatory.

*Experience Requirements*

* 10–15 years of hands-on SAP PP and QM configuration and support experience.
* Participation in at least five full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP MM and the ability to manage PP/QM–MM integration points independently.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial, oil and gas, or process-industry environments is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-company, multi-entity, or multi-plant SAP environments is an advantage.

*Required Technical Skills*

* Advanced SAP PP configuration knowledge, including MRP, demand management, BOMs, routings, capacity planning, production versions, and production orders.
* Advanced SAP QM knowledge, including inspection planning, inspection lots, quality notifications, sampling, usage decisions, and quality certificates.
* Working knowledge of SAP MM, including procurement, inventory management, subcontracting, batch management, and material valuation.
* Experience with relevant SAP S/4HANA Fiori applications for production and quality management.
* Knowledge of SAP integration with PM, SD, and FI/CO from a PP/QM perspective is an advantage.
* Basic ABAP debugging knowledge and the ability to prepare detailed functional specifications.
* Strong understanding of SAP master data and end-to-end manufacturing processes.

*Additional Competencies*

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with plant operations, production, quality, procurement, finance, and IT teams.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities across multiple entities.
* Strong documentation discipline and commitment to knowledge sharing.
* Good command of both Arabic and English.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV to with the following subject line:

*Application – Senior SAP PP & QM Consultant*

Please include the following information in your application:

* Current location
* Nationality
* Total years of SAP experience
* Years of hands-on SAP PP and QM experience
* SAP MM integration experience
* Number of full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations completed
* Current salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period or earliest joining date
* Availability to work onsite

Only candidates whose experience closely matches the position requirements will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Riyadh

ADREE is seeking a Software Technical, Senior Engineer with a strong software development background to provide technical leadership, drive engineering best practices, and support the delivery of scalable, reliable, and high-quality software solutions. The role combines hands-on software development with technical leadership, mentoring, architecture, and collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the technical execution of software development initiatives and ensure alignment with business and technical requirements.
Translate business requirements into scalable and effective technical solutions.
Design and contribute to system architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, and APIs.
Make technical decisions related to application design, development, performance, and scalability.
Develop and maintain high-quality, production-ready software while remaining hands-on with coding.
Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards, coding best practices, and quality guidelines.
Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and other stakeholders to define technical solutions and delivery approaches.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and support their technical and professional growth.
Provide technical guidance to the engineering team and support effective problem-solving and decision-making.
Support technical roadmap planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery planning.
Drive the adoption and effective use of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
Identify and address system performance, scalability, reliability, and security concerns.
Participate in incident management, troubleshooting, and on-call rotations when required.
Promote Agile/Scrum practices and contribute to continuous improvement within the engineering team.
Support conflict resolution and facilitate effective technical discussions within the team.
Balance hands-on development responsibilities with team leadership and technical coordination.

Requirements

Experience Requirements

Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience.
At least 2–3 years in a technical leadership, senior engineer, or team lead capacity.
Proven track record of delivering production systems at scale.
Experience mentoring or managing a team of engineers (typically 3–8 people).

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in at least one primary language (e.g., Java, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#).
Deep understanding of system design and architecture (microservices, distributed systems, APIs).
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Solid grasp of databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching, and data modeling.
CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) is a plus.
Strong understanding of security best practices and performance optimization.
Experience with version control workflows (Git) and code review processes.

Leadership & Soft Skills

Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Experience conducting code reviews and enforcing engineering best practices.
Strong communication skills — able to work with product managers, designers, and stakeholders.
Ability to mentor junior/mid-level engineers and support their growth.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Conflict resolution and decision-making skills.
Ability to balance hands-on coding with team leadership responsibilities.

Additional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience with technical roadmap planning and estimation.
History of driving architectural decisions and technical strategy.
Experience with incident management and on-call rotations.
Contributions to open source or technical writing/blogging (nice to have).

Job Location: HQ

description_raw:
Join CAE Middle East as a Simulator Software Engineer and play a critical role in keeping cutting-edge flight training technology operational at Riyadh Air’s new training centre in Saudi Arabia . This is a highly technical, hands-on role where you will take ownership of software configuration control, diagnose and resolve complex software and hardware issues, develop and integrate system improvements, and contribute to simulator performance and certification activities.

Duties & Responsibilities

Support the Flight Simulator Training Devices and Cabin Crew Training Devices: Point of contact for complex issues (Software, and/or hardware, and/or performance-QTG), lead and offer technical support and on the job training to fellow engineers and technicians, short-term dispatch on AOG situations.
Accountable for Software Configuration Control on all training devices. Debug, identify and actively participate in solving complex issues (software, and/or hardware, and/or performance-QTG). Develop, implement, test, integrate, and present fixes (local and/or from CAE-MTL) on all simulators. Monitor Sim issues and action / update issues that are assigned to the specialists.
Participate in project reviews as required. Review system design and architecture to ensure it meets the requirements of the project and customers. Provide support to the CAE-MTL team during installation in terms of software integration, performance-QTG, and hardware requirements. Can be involved in the acceptance process, and the review and acceptance of the initial Master QTG.
As applicable, be the main point of contact for the relevant authorities for recurrent evaluations, post evaluation status reports, and general authority related communications.
Participate in regular technical meetings, NAA evaluation debrief meetings, and SLA review meetings with CAE upper management and/or the customer. Interact and work closely with customers, engineers, and the authorities. Coordinate with the CAE Customer Service to follow-up on business critical issues. Support the Service Level Agreements within the Middle East Region, with possible international travel.
Comply with local & global CAE Environmental Health & Safety standards, instructions, and safe working procedures. Exercise duty of care for own H&S, and that of others who may be affected by his/her work.

Job-Related Skills/Background

Bachelor’s degree in engineering with minimum of seven to ten years related experience.
Knowledge of CAE software and applications including but not limited to CAELIB, STARTEAM, Strive framework, Visual Systems, SIM XXI, Simfinity, Launchpad, ITMS.
Knowledge of C, C++ and FORTRAN programming languages and scripting languages (Perl).
Knowledge of Microsoft development tools for Windows platform (Visual Studio 6.0 and higher).
Knowledge of simulated systems and instruments/avionics interface including but not limited to SIM XXI, CAE R3, R4, & R5 technology and 7000 XR.
Self-motivated, dynamic, team player.
Strong planning and organizational skill. Ability to adapt quickly to changes in technology.
Demonstrate flexibility and strong project and assigned tasks ownership as well as ability to work and make decisions unsupervised.
Ability to troubleshoot problems.
Result-oriented.
Excellent communication skills.
Good knowledge of Windows Environment and PC hardware.
Good knowledge of simulated systems and the interface with Aircraft instruments and avionics.
Advanced working knowledge of the following items: Operating system(s), Programming Language(s), Software and System Architecture, Software Development tools and utilities, Software configuration and Management Tools.
Ability to troubleshoot & debug integrated systems.
Good understanding of the relevant Configuration Management and Control process.
Good knowledge of Flight Aerodynamics.
Experience with Qualification Test Guide.
Good knowledge of local & International (EASA, FAA, etc) regulations, with demonstrated experience, as they pertain to FSTDs.

What CAE Offers

Hands-on experience with advanced flight simulation software and integrated systems.
Professional development and internal career progression opportunities.
Exposure to cross-functional technical collaboration.

description_raw:
Systems Engineer – (APPSEC) FortiADC, FortiWeb, FortiAppSec

Location – Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

As a member of the System Engineering department, you will work closely with the Sales Team to position our portfolio of Solutions.

Job Responsibilities:

Lead all technical aspects of a sales cycle with the Enterprise customers, from the initial RFIs, through to RFPs & RFQs when required. This includes the project management and active participation in POCs in partnership with the relevant teams both internally and within the customer and/or commercial partner.

Have the ability to listen and to understand the technical requirements of the customer, reading between the lines to build a solution which outperforms the competitor offering.

Be the primary technical point of contact for the customer(s) and partners in close collaboration with your sales partner.

Required skills:

Technical pre-sales experience (8 years)

Vendor experience in similar fields

Experience in a global organization, international is preferred

Strong understanding of Web Technology, Application Security, Network Security, TCP/IP, Routing, Switching

Architectural and hands-on experience with both on-prem and cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Expert level in at least two of the following areas:

DDoS: DoS/DDoS detection, analysis and mitigation, Routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), TCP/IP, DNS in-depth, Multi-layer L3-L4-L7 attack vectors, vulnerability analysis, network defense, auditing processes

ADC: Load Balancing (SLB, LLB, GSLB), OWASP TOP10, Negative/Positive Security model, Signature and Machine Learning based protection, HTTP/2 – HTTP/3, TLS 1.3, API security (OpenAPI, REST, GraphQL), Bot Protection, DoS protection, Threat Analytics

CASB: Proxy, API, Cloud SaaS (e.g. Office 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Box etc). Cloud IaaS management, Compliance reporting, SSPM, DLP, EntraID, Directory Services.

Strong presentation skills to executives, DMU and technical individual contributors

Excellent English written and verbal communication skills

A self-motivated, independent thinker

Candidates with hands-on experience with one of the leading vendors are preferred

CISSP, CISM, Fortinet NSE4, 7 or other equivalent certification is a plus

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in the network security industry.

What you can expect from us

Excellent training and development opportunities, providing you with all the tools you need to be successful.

An open working environment, sharing knowledge and information collaboratively and transparently, with respect to everyone’s thoughts and opinions.

The opportunity to be part of an innovative, collaborative and winning team.

A competitive salary and incentive compensation package, including stock awards, health and welfare benefits.

Why Join Us:

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being . Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates.

Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes, please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any Agency submit any resumes to Fortinet, these resumes if considered, will be assumed to have been given by the Agency free of any related fees/charges.

Qiddiya Digital is seeking a hands-on Senior Expert - MarTech to provide technical ownership across Qiddiya’s MarTech and digital experience platforms.

The role will be responsible for the technical design, implementation oversight, integration quality, release readiness, platform reliability and operational support of MarTech capabilities across Adobe Experience Cloud, AEM / AEMaaCS, AEP, AJO, CJA, Target, DAM / Content Hub, Sprinklr, Workfront, analytics, tagging and related integrations.

This is a senior individual contributor role with strong technical authority. While the role may not have direct line-management responsibility, it will provide technical leadership to vendor engineering teams and remain accountable for technical quality, resilience, reliability, security, performance and operational readiness of the MarTech platform landscape.

A key objective is to eliminate black-box delivery, retain critical MarTech technical knowledge within Qiddiya, and ensure Qiddiya remains in control of its MarTech platforms, integrations and release processes.

Key Responsibilities

Take technical ownership of MarTech platforms, integrations and delivery quality across Adobe, AEM/AEMaaCS, AEP, AJO, CJA, Target, DAM / Content Hub, Sprinklr, Workfront and analytics.
Define and maintain MarTech technical architecture, integration patterns, engineering standards, release approach and technical roadmap.
Provide hands-on technical leadership across solution design, development, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, release and production support.
Lead and challenge vendor engineering teams, ensuring compliance with Qiddiya Digital standards and MarTech architecture principles.
Review and approve technical designs, APIs, data models, event schemas, tracking specifications, integration flows, code quality and major technical decisions.
Support AEMaaCS governance, Cloud Manager pipelines, environment strategy, release controls, shared component standards and multi-SI code management.
Own technical quality for analytics and tagging, including data layer, Adobe Tags / Launch, WebSDK / MobileSDK, UTM governance, CJA data flows and reporting reliability.
Support AEP / AJO / CJA / Target enablement, including profile, audience, journey, decisioning, personalisation, experimentation and reporting use cases.
Ensure MarTech solutions are secure, scalable, observable, resilient, maintainable, reusable and cost efficient.
Validate vendor deliverables using clear technical acceptance criteria, test evidence, deployment checks and production readiness criteria.
Ensure appropriate automated testing, CI/CD controls, monitoring, logging, alerting, access controls and operational runbooks are in place.
Validate release plans, rollback procedures, capacity considerations, integration testing, disaster recovery and production readiness.
Lead technical incident management, root-cause analysis and permanent remediation for MarTech-related issues.
Identify and manage technical debt, architecture risks, recurring incidents, performance issues and operational weaknesses.
Maintain technical documentation, architecture decisions, integration specifications, release notes, runbooks and support procedures.
Drive knowledge transfer from vendors and ensure Qiddiya can independently operate, govern and evolve the MarTech ecosystem.

Requirements

8+ years of software engineering, technical lead, solution architecture or senior development experience in digital platforms, MarTech or customer-facing technology environments.
Strong hands-on technical capability and ability to challenge implementation-level decisions.
Experience with Adobe Experience Manager, AEMaaCS, Adobe Experience Cloud or equivalent enterprise digital experience platforms.
Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, data flows, integrations, identity, consent, customer profiles and distributed systems.
Experience with analytics and tagging technologies, preferably Adobe Tags / Launch, WebSDK / MobileSDK, CJA, data layer design, UTM governance and campaign tracking.
Experience with CI/CD, cloud environments, release management, automated testing, observability, performance engineering, security and production operations.
Experience overseeing vendors, system integrators or outsourced engineering teams.
Strong incident management, root-cause analysis and problem-management experience.
Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management and technical decision-making skills.

description_raw:
Serve as the site's primary authority for digital systems across materials management, manufacturing operations, quality, and maintenance. This role drives system adoption, process compliance, workforce capability, and master data quality while ensuring alignment with global standards. Acting as the site's Local Process Digital Authority, this role bridges factory operations and enterprise digital standards, partnering closely with DPE Global Process Digital Authorities, the Master Data Governance team, and site leadership to ensure digital solutions enable operational excellence locally.

Job Description

What will you do:

Digital Operations Leadership

Serve as the site's Local Process Digital Authority for digital systems and processes across materials management, manufacturing operations, quality, and maintenance.
Lead local deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement activities related to ERP, MES and other digital manufacturing systems and initiatives.
Partner with site leadership to drive adoption of standardized business processes and digital solutions.
Represent site operational requirements, risks, and opportunities within enterprise transformation programs, ensuring the site's voice is heard when global standards are defined or updated.

Digital Systems & Process Governance

During deployment, serve as the site's primary resource for data conversion activities: validate legacy data against new system requirements, make practical decisions on data cleansing scope and prioritization, and own the classification and enrichment decisions needed to load accurate, usable data into the new system before go-live.
Validate that global process designs, system configurations, and localization requirements support site operational needs across materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance systems while maintaining compliance with enterprise standards.
Partner with Global Process Digital Authorities and the Master Data Governance team to ensure process consistency, data integrity, and operational readiness throughout deployment and beyond.
Support system testing, user acceptance activities, deployment readiness reviews, and go-live preparation. Maintain site governance tools, including process documentation and decision-support guides.

Capability Development & Operational Support

Own the site digital systems capability strategy once systems are live, ensuring employees have the knowledge and skills required to operate effectively within standardized digital processes across materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance.
Lead the development and execution of role-based training programs for materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance teams, maintaining training curricula aligned with global standards.
Serve as the primary functional escalation point for digital systems and user-support issues across all covered domains, distinguishing between a local training gap, a process gap, and a standard that needs updating, and routing each to the right resolution path.
Monitor operational performance indicators related to system utilization, process compliance, and master data quality.

Continuous Improvement & Cross-Site Collaboration

Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve data quality, and increase user productivity without introducing unauthorized local process variations.
Participate in the DPE LPDA network and collaborate with peers across manufacturing sites to share best practices, lessons learned, and standardization opportunities.

What will you bring:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain, materials management, or production operations within an industrial environment.
Demonstrated experience with SAP, Oracle, or equivalent ERP platforms supporting manufacturing and supply chain operations.
Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems and other digital systems supporting quality or maintenance operations in a manufacturing environment.
Experience supporting user adoption, training, or business process transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, inventory management, production execution, and master data governance.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in Arabic.

What will make you stand out :

Experience supporting ERP, MES, quality, maintenance, or other digital manufacturing system deployments in a key user, super user, or deployment role, including data conversion and cutover activities.
Knowledge of master data governance, data migration, and ERP transformation methodologies.
Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement experience.
Experience working within global manufacturing organizations and matrixed team structures.
Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change and drive sustainable process adoption.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No
