Business Unit:

Cubic Defense

Company Details:

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details:

Job Summary:

This role will provide operations and maintenance for the P4-SAKITS Display/Debriefing Systems in accordance with the applicable technical documentation.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Load programs for operation and test.

Perform subsystem test to assess operational readiness.

Load all pre-mission exercise data into the Data Transfer Device (DTD).

Maintain a control log of DTD issue to and receipt from aircrews.

Operate the graphics terminals during live exercises and assist with display and control operations.

Provide technical assistance to RSAF or aircrews in setting up for replay/debriefing.

Maintain and store records of mission tapes.

Maintain a mission event log with specific, concise, and pertinent data entered under the following headings: date, time, mission/event, remarks, and operator.

For mission replays, "mission replay" should be entered. Any system problems encountered during the aforementioned events shall be briefly described in the remarks column in sufficient detail to readily interpret the event. Any aircraft that does not track or function properly shall be noted and this information promptly passed to the P4-SAKITS pod shop for follow-up pod testing.

File all filled log books into the technical library

Ensure log books are readily available for on-site RSAF evaluations

Interface directly with the RSAF regarding mission sortie effectiveness.

Ensure reasons for partially successful or unsuccessful missions and the system's operating status/conditions will be noted for the record. This data is required for the monthly status reports.

Generate exercise status printouts as required by the RSAF. When a hard copy printout is required, the operator shall activate the display to enable printing of the specified display(s).

Perform additional operations duties as directed by the Site Supervisor

Assist as required with P4-SAKITS F-15 operations and maintenance.

Work as one team and support colleagues with their duties when required to ensure the successful provision of service to the customer

Support the set-up of project equipment when required

Comply with Cubic’s values and adherence to all company policy and procedures. In particular comply with the code of conduct, quality, security and occupational health, safety and environmental policies and procedures.

In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed, the job holder is required to perform other duties assigned by their manager from time-to-time, as may be reasonably required of them.

Skills, knowledge and experience:

Demonstrated Arabic/English Bilingual Proficiency

Previous experience in a similar role

Ability to comply with the company standard practice as it applies to field assignments.

Education And Qualifications

College qualification in Technical related field; or equivalent technical education and military experience

Desirable:

Bachelors Degree in Electrical Engineering, Avionics, Computer Engineering or equivalent concentrations

Saudi-Government-recognized Certificate of Arabic/English Bilingual Proficiency (STEP, TOEFL or equivalent)

Personal Qualities

Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.

Diligent, with attention to detail.

Ability to work as part of a team towards individual and shared goals.

Self-motivated with the ability to work on own initiatives and under pressure.

Ability to work in confined spaces.

Ability to lift 75-pounds

The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need.

Employee

Act as an escalation point for architecture-related decisions and conflicts.

Job Title: Information Security Risk Assessment Manager
Division: Cybersecurity / Risk
Location: Riyadh
Working Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Sunday to Thursday)

Role:
Cybersecurity Risk Management to support in managing the enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk management program. This position is responsible for conducting threat modeling, developing and maintaining risk assessment methodologies under the risk management team, Also play a critical role in protecting the organization’s information assets by identifying, assessing cybersecurity risks.

Key Responsibilities
Cybersecurity Risk Assessment: Conduct detailed and risk-based Cybersecurity Risk Assessment, meeting SLA commitments during IT and cybersecurity engagements.
Maintains a close awareness of best practices and industry standards in Information Security assesses potential policy gaps and/or loopholes and responding risks to SAB IT infrastructure, systems, network and data and recommends any improvements in policies.
Liaises closely with end users, explains Cybersecurity risks and the business role in preventing Cybersecurity risks and drives initiatives to sensitize end-users on Cybersecurity risks.
Advise IT and business on the optimal way of dealing the identified Cybersecurity risks and mitigation.
Final Cybersecurity Risk Assessment: Execute comprehensive Cybersecurity Risk Assessment before go-live.
Conduct detailed Cybersecurity Threat Modeling
Threat Modeling & Risk Assessments: Conduct detailed cybersecurity risk assessments and threat modeling for IT projects and systems – at early project stages, before major changes, for new technologies, and periodically for existing assets. Identify threats, vulnerabilities, and controls for critical information assets and document these risks in a centralized risk register.
Cybersecurity Risk Assessment Validation: Review, analyze, and validate Cybersecurity Risk Assessment results to align the result with Cybersecurity issues raised by other Cybersecurity teams.
Raise application security related defect
Enhance Cybersecurity pattern during engagements, periodic assessments or Ad-Hoc assessments by highlighting new risks to domain owners
All engaged/assigned engagements, periodic assessments or Ad-Hoc assessments should be assessed in accordance to the Cybersecurity Risk Management Methodology, Cybersecurity Risk Pattern and Cybersecurity Change Review and Engagement Process and within the agreed timeline (SLA)
Cybersecurity Risk Assessment platform Tuning: Customize and fine-tune Cybersecurity risk assessment platform for optimal compatibility and accuracy.
Cybersecurity Risk Management Maturity:
Enhance the existing Risk Management process and documentation
Review and update the existing Cybersecurity Risk Management documentation (methodology, FIM section, standards, guidelines)
Ensure that both Cybersecurity Risk Management process and documentation are aligned with Group latest practices, regulatory practice/framework such as NCA , SAMA CSF …etc
Cybersecurity Risk Management Policy and Design: Ensure all Cybersecurity Risk Management design documents are maintained and aligned with regulators and internal policies.
Cybersecurity Risk Management domain Ownership: Develop, unify, and maintain the cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures, aligned with enterprise risk management and regulatory requirements. Regularly review and update risk management policies, design documents, and tools to reflect changes in the threat landscape or laws. Ensure that risk treatment plans (mitigation, transfer, acceptance, avoidance) are in place and tracked through completion.
Periodic Cybersecurity Risk and Crown Jewels assessment: Ensure all required IT Services assessed as per the annual plan
Cybersecurity Assessment Plan: manage periodic cybersecurity assessment plan. Ensure critical systems and services undergo regular security reviews. Document review findings, identified risks, and recommended actions. Coordinate independent cybersecurity teams.

Cybersecurity Risk Management Reporting: Provide quarter report about all Cybersecurity risks by highlighting priority risks to be actioned with IT and Cybersecurity Management including:
Cybersecurity Risk Management KPIs and KRIs: Calculate required KPIs and KRIs to highlight related risks
Cybersecurity Risk Management Escalation: Establish escalation matrix for outstanding risks to be followed for all Cybersecurity Risks

Qualifications and Experience :
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in cybersecurity risk management, governance, IT audit, or a related field, preferably in the financial or banking sector.
Experience in roles involving compliance with SAMA CSF and NCA ECC.

Senior Platform Engineer
Full-time | Riyadh

We are partnering with a growing technology organisation to appoint a Senior Platform Engineer to build the shared technology foundation used by engineering teams to develop, integrate and operate modern applications.

This is a hands-on role spanning platform architecture, backend services, developer tooling, APIs, cloud infrastructure and AI-enabled systems. You will create reusable capabilities that allow engineering teams to move quickly without repeatedly solving the same integration, orchestration, security and operational problems.

The role is suited to an engineer who has built internal platforms in production and understands that good platform engineering combines strong technical foundations with a simple developer experience. You will have significant ownership and help establish the patterns, interfaces and standards that other engineers build upon.

Key Responsibilities
Design and build shared platform services, APIs, SDKs and engineering tooling.
Develop orchestration capabilities for applications involving multiple services, tools, models and workflows.
Build reliable interfaces that allow teams to consume shared capabilities consistently.
Integrate AI models and supporting services into reusable platform capabilities.
Develop secure, identity-aware services with authentication and authorisation enforced at the appropriate layer.
Create reusable templates, libraries, examples and automation to accelerate application development.
Provide common capabilities for both interactive applications and programmatic consumers.
Establish standards for API design, service contracts, versioning, testing and observability.
Build tracing, monitoring and operational controls into platform services.
Work closely with infrastructure and application teams to ensure services are scalable, reliable and secure.
Identify recurring engineering problems and turn them into reusable platform solutions.
Improve developer experience by reducing friction and increasing self-service across engineering teams.
Review code, document technical decisions and help establish engineering standards across the platform.

What We're Looking For
8+ years of experience in software, backend, platform or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience building and operating internal platforms, shared services or developer tooling in production.
Strong hands-on experience with AI-enabled applications, agent systems or comparable technologies.
Strong Python and Go development skills. Experience with Java or Node.js is advantageous.
Experience designing and building APIs and SDKs consumed by other engineering teams.
Experience with workflow orchestration, tool integration, asynchronous processing or multi-step service interactions.
Strong understanding of distributed systems and service architecture.
Experience with authentication, authorisation, OIDC/SSO and identity-aware services.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and modern CI/CD practices.
Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform.
Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Crossplane.
Strong understanding of reliability, security, scalability and operational trade-offs.
A strong focus on developer experience, usability and adoption.

AI & Application Platforms
Experience building production AI or agent-based systems is highly desirable.

Relevant experience may include:
Agent orchestration and workflow systems.
Tool calling and integration between AI services and business applications.
Model gateways and provider integrations.
Retrieval and data-access capabilities.
Evaluation, tracing and guardrails for AI-enabled applications.
Standardised interfaces for connecting applications, services and tools.
Technologies such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK or comparable frameworks.

Technical Environment
Python | Go | Java/Node.js | APIs | SDKs | AI/Agent Systems | Workflow Orchestration | Docker | Kubernetes | CI/CD | AWS | Terraform/Crossplane | OIDC/SSO | Authentication | Authorisation | Observability | Developer Tooling

We're looking for an engineer with strong technical depth and platform thinking who can turn complex engineering requirements into simple, reusable capabilities. You should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making architectural trade-offs and building systems that are secure, reliable and genuinely useful to the engineers who depend on them.

_*Hiring for Senior Manager - Enterprise System*_

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. D365 Implementation — End-to-End Ownership*

* Lead the full SAP-to-D365 F&SCM migration at HSE from pre-implementation through go-live and stabilization
* Own the implementation partner selection process: define evaluation criteria, run the RFP, assess technical and commercial bids, and make the recommendation to the CIO
* Conduct a rigorous current-state documentation exercise with HSE business users before the implementation partner begins discovery — the vendor will describe the system as configured; you must capture how it is actually used
* Define functional scope, data migration strategy, integration architecture with JCC (Epicor), and cutover plan
* Maintain accountability for delivery timelines, budget, and quality — the implementation partner is a vendor you manage, not a safety net you lean on
* Ensure ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing compliance is embedded in the D365 design from day one, not retrofitted
* Hire and develop the D365 team beneath you: Technical Consultant, Administrator, End User Support, and D365 Functional Analyst (internal transition)

*2. Business Stakeholder Management*

* Establish direct working relationships with HSE CEO, CFO, and operations leadership — independently, not through the CIO
* Translate system constraints, implementation risks, and timeline realities into business language that executives can act on
* Manage expectations across the implementation lifecycle — including delivering uncomfortable news about scope, timeline, or complexity without losing the relationship
* Drive organizational readiness and change adoption across HSE's business functions
* Chair the HSE-side implementation steering cadence with business leadership

*3. Enterprise Systems Architecture & Governance*

* Define the long-term enterprise systems roadmap for HSE in alignment with the cross-entity architecture led by the Enterprise Systems Architect (JCC)
* Establish D365 governance: change management, access controls, release management, and configuration documentation standards
* Own the intercompany integration specification between HSE (D365) and JCC (Epicor) — a critical dependency given JCC is HSE's primary supplier
* Ensure master data quality and governance frameworks are embedded from implementation start, not bolted on post-go-live

*4. Team Leadership & Development*

* Lead, develop, and performance-manage the HSE Enterprise Systems team
* Build a team culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership — not a support desk culture
* Collaborate with the Process Excellence function (cross-entity functional consultants) to ensure D365 process design reflects actual business operations
* Act as a peer to the Enterprise Systems Architect (JCC side) and to the Sr. Manager Digital Transformation & Infrastructure — this is a collaborative leadership model, not a siloed one

*5. Strategic Contribution*

* Contribute to IT governance body (IT Steering Committee) — representing the enterprise systems function across both entities
* Identify and advocate for AI, automation, and analytics opportunities within HSE's operational scope
* Actively participate in cross-entity technology decisions — including shared platform evaluations, vendor negotiations, and architecture reviews
* Develop the strategic muscle and executive presence required to step into the CIO role — this is an explicit expectation, not a bonus

*Requirements*

*Non-Negotiable*

* Minimum one full D365 Finance & Supply Chain Management go-live as implementation lead or functional lead — not team member, not observer
* Proven track record managing external implementation partners as accountable vendors — with evidence of pushing back, escalating, and protecting the client organization's interests
* Direct experience presenting to and managing C-level stakeholders (CEO / CFO) — independently, not through a line manager
* Strong command of D365 Finance module: GL, AR/AP, fixed assets, financial reporting
* Solid working knowledge of D365 SCM: procurement, inventory management, warehouse management
* Understanding of ZATCA / VAT compliance requirements in KSA — or demonstrable track record of implementing tax compliance within ERP systems in a GCC jurisdiction
* 10+ years in enterprise systems, with at least 5 years in a leadership or senior delivery role

*Strongly Preferred*

* SAP experience (Finance, MM, or SD modules) — critical for managing the transition, knowledge transfer, and gap analysis between SAP and D365
* Experience in trading, distribution, or supply chain-intensive industries
* Microsoft Dynamics certifications: MB-300, MB-310 (Finance), MB-330 (SCM)
* Arabic language — working proficiency or better
* Prior GCC / KSA experience — understanding of regulatory environment, business culture, and vendor landscape
* Exposure to Power BI or analytics platforms — given the broader IT mandate and CIO trajectory

*Leadership Profile*

* Executive presence: can hold a room with a CFO and CEO and deliver bad news without losing the relationship
* Vendor discipline: treats the implementation partner as an accountable contractor, not an authority — reviews, challenges, and approves technical designs before they are locked in
* Business translator: converts system constraints into business-language decisions — not the other way around
* Builder mentality: comfortable arriving to a blank page, creating structure where none exists, and driving forward without a playbook
* Strategic thinker with operational credibility — the CIO path requires both.

*Working Environment*

* Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia — on-site presence required
* Reporting: Direct line to CIO. Peer relationships with Enterprise Systems Architect (JCC) and Sr. Manager Digital Transformation & Infrastructure
* Language: English is the working language of the IT function; Arabic is an advantage in business stakeholder interactions
* Infrastructure context: On-premise dominant + GCP + Google Workspace; Zoho CRM active at HSE; MenaItech for HR/payroll
* Cross-entity touchpoints: Regular collaboration with JCC enterprise systems team on integration, master data, and architecture decisions

YOU ARE

As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK

Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions

Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps

Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC

Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites

Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production

Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

Justify the value of model approaches in business problems

Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production

EDUCATION

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION

Proven experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.

Considerable experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming

experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks

experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..

Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.

Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL

Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment

Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams

Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation

MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)

Company Description 1Pass is a leading Saudi fitness and wellness platform that provides flexible access to hundreds of gyms, studios, padel courts, spas, and recovery experiences across major cities in the Kingdom. Through a single subscription, users can tailor their wellness journey by choosing activities that fit their goals, schedule, and lifestyle. In addition to its consumer offering, 1Pass delivers comprehensive Corporate Wellness Programs designed to improve employee wellbeing, morale, and productivity while reducing absenteeism. These programs offer data-driven insights, diverse activity options, and flexible activation plans customized to each organization’s needs. 1Pass is focused on building a dynamic, health-centered ecosystem powered by technology and user experience.

The Role
We are looking for a hands-on engineer to own the day-to-day health of our Google Cloud environment, build and maintain our CI/CD pipelines, and act as the first line of defence on infrastructure security.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure (GCP)
• Provision and operate our Google Cloud environment: compute, managed databases, storage, VPC networking, load balancing and DNS.
• Define environments in Terraform so staging and production are reproducible and versioned.
• Own backups, restore testing, disaster recovery and capacity planning.
• Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so issues are caught early.
• Track and optimise cloud spend.

CI/CD
• Build and maintain deployment pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
• Containerise services with Docker and manage image registries.
• Set up automated testing gates, staged environments, safe rollbacks and zero-downtime releases.
• Reduce manual steps and document how the platform works.

Security
• Enforce least-privilege IAM across cloud and internal systems, and support periodic access reviews.
• Manage secrets and keys properly, and keep credentials out of code and pipelines.
• Harden the environment: firewall rules, network segmentation, TLS, WAF and patching.
• Run vulnerability and dependency scanning, and drive remediation with the engineering team.
• Maintain audit trails and support incident response.

Compliance
• Help keep regulated workloads and data hosted inside Saudi Arabia.
• Support alignment with NCA cybersecurity controls and the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
• Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks and control evidence for audits.

Requirements
• 3-5 years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE or platform engineering.
• Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform. Strong AWS or Azure experience with a clear willingness to work on GCP will also be considered.
• Solid Linux administration skills.
• Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or equivalent.
• Docker in production, and familiarity with Kubernetes concepts.
• Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines end to end.
• Scripting and automation in Bash and Python.
• Networking fundamentals: VPC design, DNS, TLS, load balancing and firewall rules.
• Operational familiarity with relational databases, including backups and restores.
• A security-first mindset around least privilege, blast radius and auditability.
• Good written and spoken English, with clear documentation habits.

Nice to Have
• Working knowledge of NCA compliance frameworks and how they translate into technical controls.
• Familiarity with Saudi PDPL or other local regulatory requirements.
• Google Cloud certification: Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
• A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+ or similar.
• Arabic language skills.

How to Apply
Send your CV to jobs@1pass.app, or apply through this LinkedIn posting. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

CREALOGIX is a leading global FinTech software solutions provider working with some of the most innovative financial brands in the world. We are dynamic and growing with over 600 employees around the world including Switzerland, Germany, Spain, the UK, the Middle East and Singapore.

Some of the world’s largest banks and wealth management firms select and deploy our advanced SaaS and cloud-based technologies to meet their customers’ needs – and it’s our people who make the difference.



Job Description

As a Senior QA Tester, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software products. Your responsibilities will be manual testing across both desktop and mobile platforms, leveraging your experience and understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and best practices. Your role will involve close collaboration with development and QA teams to ensure that all defects are identified, documented, and resolved before product release.

Key Responsibilities:

Manual Testing: Execute detailed manual test cases on desktop and mobile applications to ensure software meets functional and non-functional requirements. 
Defect Tracking and Resolution: Collaborate with the development team to report, track, and resolve defects efficiently, ensuring high-quality software delivery. 
Test Case Development: Work closely with QA Analysts to design and develop comprehensive test cases that cover all aspects of the software, including edge cases and potential failure points. 
Test Planning: Contribute to the creation and refinement of test plans and strategies, ensuring all features are thoroughly tested before release. 
Quality Assurance: Maintain a high standard of quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle, identifying areas for improvement in both the testing process and the product itself. 

Qualifications

Required Skills

Experience: Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in manual testing, focused on web and mobile application testing. 
Software Development Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of both QA and software development lifecycles, with the ability to integrate testing processes seamlessly into the overall development process. 
Communication: Proficient in reading and writing in English (at least a B2 level), with the ability to clearly document test cases, defects, and reports. 
Tool Proficiency: Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Test Management tools, with a proven ability to manage and document testing activities. 
Attention to Detail: Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, ensuring all potential issues are identified and addressed before product release. 
Proactivity and Problem-Solving: A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to handle ad-hoc requests and meet multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
Collaboration: A team player who works flexibly and collaboratively, with a focus on achieving the overall success of the team and the project. 
Desired Skills

Test Automation Experience: Familiarity with automation testing tools like Selenium and Appium, with the ability to work closely with automation teams. 
Programming Knowledge: Basic understanding of JavaScript, which will be beneficial when working with development teams or automation scripts. 
Integrated Development Environment (IDE) Experience: Experience working with IDEs such as IntelliJ, Eclipse, or similar tools, allowing for a better understanding of the development environment and processes. 
Functional Analysis: Experience in functional analysis and test case design, ensuring comprehensive coverage of all test scenarios. 
Continuous Learning: A desire to stay updated with the latest trends in QA and software development, with a willingness to learn new tools and technologies. 
Language

Fluent in Arabic
Fluent in English

Incorta is a next-generation data analytics and business intelligence platform that excels at rapidly delivering business value from transactional data, this is the first real breakthrough in data analytics in 20 years. We provide an integrated end-to-end data experience, from data acquisition and enrichment to visualizing and sharing results. Our platform cuts project implementation time from months to weeks provides revolutionary query speed and maintains a unified, single source of truth for multiple workloads including business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning. Fully 90% of companies that try Incorta become customers, and over 98% of our customers are still with us. Our cloud-based service widens our reach into businesses of all sizes. There is simply no other analytics solution that is as cost-effective, agile, and impactful.

As a Solution Engineer at Incorta, you will play a key role in implementing and customizing our data analytics platform to meet complex customer requirements. You’ll work closely with our customers and partners to design and execute tailored analytics strategies while ensuring technical excellence and a seamless deployment experience.

This role demands a combination of strong technical acumen, consultative thinking, and excellent communication skills. You’ll be a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them unlock the full value of Incorta's capabilities.

YOU WILL

Implement the Incorta platform based on unique business requirements and project objectives.

Collaborate with customers to define an overarching analytics strategy and align it with Incorta’s technical capabilities.

Conduct technical discovery sessions to introduce the Incorta platform across a range of use cases and industries.

Estimate scope and level of effort required for implementation and integration work.

Write clear and detailed technical design documentation for solutions delivered.

Support the onboarding and enablement of customers and partners through hands-on configuration and guidance.

Work effectively within a cross-functional environment that includes clients, partners, and internal Incorta teams.

YOU HAVE

3 years of experience implementing analytics or business intelligence (BI) solutions.

Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with complex data models.

Demonstrated experience in leading or supporting technical implementation projects.

Familiarity with Linux server administration and cloud-based environments.

Exposure to advanced analytics tools such as R, SAS, or Apache Spark.

Experience with enterprise applications such as Oracle EBS or Oracle Fusion is a strong plus.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work in fast-paced, evolving environments.

A proactive mindset with a willingness to adapt, learn, and thrive in a rapidly changing landscape.

Only Saudi nationals will be considered for this vacancy.

MUST HAVE

Experience in consulting, client-facing roles, or working within a SaaS environment is highly desirable.

Saudi National.

We could tell you that we’re building something that truly optimizes the way business intelligence is done. We could also tell you that we’re backed by marquee VC's such as Google Ventures and Kleiner Perkins. Or even the fact that we were named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces of 2022 while also being the only vendor to be recognized in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ and the 2022 Gartner® Market Guide. All true, but the real reason you will want to come work for Incorta is that you’ll be part of an early team that is building a game-changing analytics product that will allow companies to answer complex questions in seconds...not days or weeks like the current solutions.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to serve as the foremost technical authority within our Product Engineering & Technology (PET) division. This is a hands-on leadership position for an exceptional software architect and engineering practitioner who will define the technical direction of our flagship cybersecurity products while driving the adoption of sovereign cryptography and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) principles across our technology ecosystem.
The successful candidate will architect and deliver high-assurance software solutions that operate seamlessly across both enterprise environments and highly sensitive sovereign, air-gapped infrastructures. This individual will establish engineering standards, govern secure software development practices, and provide strategic technical leadership across the organization.

Sovereign Architecture & Backend Engineering
Define and lead the architecture, development, and deployment of highly resilient backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, and architectural principles across the software development organization.
Design scalable microservices architectures capable of operating in both connected and disconnected sovereign environments.
Embed advanced cryptographic controls into applications, including:
Sovereign cryptographic frameworks
Secure key management implementations
Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) readiness
Secure data protection mechanisms for data in transit and at rest
Ensure compliance with NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) and other applicable security frameworks.
Frontend Engineering & Systems Integration
Lead the design and development of modern, highly responsive frontend platforms using Vue.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Architect seamless integration between application platforms and specialized cybersecurity hardware appliances deployed within Operational Technology (OT) environments.
Ensure reliable real-time communication, synchronization, and data integrity across distributed systems.
Drive frontend performance optimization, scalability, and maintainability across the CyProducts ecosystem.
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
Act as the highest technical escalation point for complex software engineering challenges.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and innovation.
Define and mandate best practices for:
Software architecture
Code quality
System reliability
Security engineering
Performance optimization
Review critical architectural decisions and provide authoritative technical direction.
Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)
Champion and enforce Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices across all engineering teams.
Establish security-first engineering processes from project inception through deployment and maintenance.
Design and implement secure CI/CD pipelines leveraging GitLab CI/CD.
Drive automated security validation including:
Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
Dependency and container security scanning
Infrastructure security validation
Ensure software releases meet stringent security and quality standards before deployment.
Strategic Architecture & Innovation
Define the long-term technical roadmap for software platforms and engineering practices.
Lead initiatives to reduce technical debt while maintaining delivery velocity.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and cryptographic approaches.
Support the organization's strategic vision for sovereign cybersecurity solutions and secure digital transformation.
Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Master's degree preferred.
Experience
Minimum 10 years of professional software engineering experience.
Significant experience operating at Principal Engineer, Lead Architect, or equivalent senior technical leadership level.
Proven track record designing and delivering complex distributed systems within high-security or mission-critical environments.
Extensive hands-on coding experience with continued involvement in architecture and software development.

Preferred Certifications

Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)
Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
CISSP
GIAC Secure Software Programmer (GSSP)
TOGAF (Architecture)

Job Function: Sales The role:
Do you thrive on translating complex business requirements into scalable AWS architectures while guiding customers through the full pre-sales lifecycle?
Are you experienced in cloud financial optimization and excited to advise C-level stakeholders on ROI, cost savings, and long-term cloud strategy?

Practical Information

We are looking for an AWS Growth Executive to drive AWS cloud adoption and business growth across the MEA region. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers translate business needs into scalable AWS solutions while leading technical discovery, solution design, and proposal development throughout the sales cycle. With a strong focus on cloud economics and financial optimization, you will help customers maximize the value of their AWS investments and accelerate their cloud journey.

Key Responsibilities

Opportunity Qualification: Assess and qualify new AWS leads to ensure technical, commercial, and financial viability
Solution Design: Collaborate with Technical Architects to design robust, cost-effective AWS solutions (Infrastructure, Data & AI, and App Modernization)

Sales Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end technical sales process, including RFPs, custom proposals, and contract negotiations
Stakeholder Engagement: Deliver high-impact presentations and technical demos to C-level executives (CFO/CTO) emphasizing the economic value of cloud migration
Technical Advocacy: Conduct AWS Well-Architected Reviews with a focus on the Cost Optimization pillar to ensure long-term customer success
Commercial Modeling: Develop accurate service and cost models showing ROI, TCO, and business impact for local clients

What we need to see from you:
AWS Expertise: Strong knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, CloudFront, WAF, EKS/ECS, and Data & AI solutions
Cloud FinOps: Hands-on experience with AWS Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, Compute Optimizer, and Budgets
Cost Optimization: Proven ability to optimize cloud spend through Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Spot Instances, and storage tiering strategies
Market Knowledge: Understanding of the MEA cloud market and regional regulatory and compliance requirements
Experience: Proven track record in cloud pre-sales, strategic cloud consulting, or FinOps roles.
Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect certification required; FinOps Practitioner is a plus
Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical and financial data into actionable business insights

What we offer

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future

Why SoftwareOne?:

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Please include the role for which you are applying and your country location. Someone from our organization that is not part of the decision-making process will be in touch to discuss your specific needs and we will make every effort to accommodate you. title_raw: Senior Intelligence Consultant, Advanced Intelligence Access
description_raw:
Due to national security requirements for this role, applications are strictly restricted to Saudi nationals.

Applicants to this role must have work authorization in Saudi Arabia as this role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience working in a government or military environment, leveraging and developing Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) for network, host and log analysis, to enable the detection and response to cyber threats.
Experience in leveraging CTI to describe, track and develop new intelligence on advanced persistent threats.
Experience in conducting or supporting incident response and investigations within enterprise environments.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience in SOC operations, threat hunting, detection engineering and SOC workflow optimization.
Understanding of core cyber security concepts, common enterprise IT infrastructure components, operating system internals and networking.

About the job
As a part of the MTIS Social Media Platform team, you will deliver Mandiant Threat Intelligence Services, including its key service known as Advanced Intelligence Access (AIA). You will provide the organization with access to a dedicated Mandiant Intelligence 'Integrator' who acts as an extension of the customer organization. Your team will work within the broader Mandiant Intelligence business and has experience supporting government and commercial sector customers, often working closely with national intelligence services, large government institutions, energy and finance.

In this role, you will serve as an AIA Integrator, a highly skilled cyber threat analyst and consultant, backed by the entire organization's support, enablement, and capabilities. As a part of the AIA, you will offer various CTI analytical deliverables like alert-driven threat reports, threat data analysis, briefings, and support to SOC/Blue team functions. AIA Integrators aim to be tightly integrated with their client, working onsite a number of days per week.
Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.
Responsibilities
Understand customers Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) requirements, identifying their needs and opportunities for deployment of CTI within their operations to have the greatest defensive impact.
Evaluate tools and best practices for tracking advanced threats, Tools, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) of attacker’s motivations, and industry and attacker trends.
Perform analysis of customer data, taking their bespoke sources to identify threat activity, or to build and automate investigative workflows.

Write intelligence reporting against customer requirements, appropriate for their intelligence analysts or executive leaders.

Support the integration of CTI into customer's security processes and technologies, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) systems.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

description_raw:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Partner Technical Lead – Middle East to drive technical alignment, integration stability, and deployment readiness with mobile network operator (MNO) partners across Middle East. This role leads partner‑facing technical operations across satellite radio access networks (RAN), core, gateway, and business process management systems, ensuring seamless integration and sustained operational health in diverse regulatory and network environments.

The Partner Technical Lead coordinates internal engineering and operations teams, manages partner action items and escalations, and publishes readiness KPIs to support regional launches and expansion initiatives while maintaining alignment with global integration standards.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Technical Operations & Integration Management

Lead partner technical operations and integration readiness across satellite RAN, core, gateway, and BPMS domains.
Validate interface behavior, interoperability, configuration flows, and KPIs across diverse partner network environments.
Oversee partner onboarding, interoperability testing, and pre‑launch technical readiness activities.

Cross‑Functional Alignment & Issue Resolution

Coordinate closely with engineering, service assurance, operations, deployment, and planning teams to align regional partner requirements.
Drive closure of partner action items, ensuring timely resolution and transparent risk communication.
Maintain structured reporting on integration progress, blockers, and dependencies across multiple markets.

Readiness KPIs, Documentation & Reporting

Define, track, and publish readiness KPIs aligned to regional market conditions and integration milestones.
Maintain accurate integration documentation, interface specifications, and technical deliverables.
Provide regular readiness and integration updates to leadership and regional stakeholder groups.

Incident Escalation & Technical Support

Act as the primary escalation point for partner‑related technical issues impacting integration stability or service readiness.
Coordinate with partner network operations centers and internal engineering teams to resolve incidents efficiently.
Support root cause analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and follow‑up for recurring issues.

Regional Stakeholder & Partner Support

Serve as a technical advisor during partner meetings, workshops, pilots, and technical discussions.
Support strategic and pre‑sales conversations requiring technical clarity on integration approaches or KPIs.
Participate in deployment sequencing, readiness reviews, and regional launch planning activities.

Continuous Improvement & Partner Experience

Recommend improvements to partner integration processes, readiness dashboards, documentation, and testing frameworks.
Ensure consistent application of best practices while accommodating regional requirements.
Contribute to enhancements that improve partner onboarding efficiency and operational outcomes.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Advanced degree or specialized telecom certifications are a plus.

Experience

A minimum of 5–8 years of experience in telecom integration, partner technical operations, solution engineering, or network deployment.
Experience working with mobile network operators, telecom vendors, or network operators in Middle East.
Proven experience coordinating multi‑market technical readiness or integration programs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with satellite‑enabled network integrations.
Exposure to multi‑vendor or multi‑operator environments.
Familiarity with regional regulatory or deployment considerations in Middle East.

Soft Skills

Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills across technical and leadership audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional and geographically distributed teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in multicultural and multilingual environments.
Structured problem‑solving skills with clear articulation of risks, mitigations, and technical decisions.
Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accuracy in documentation and readiness reporting.

Technology Stack

Telecom monitoring, diagnostics, and signaling analysis tools.
ITSM and ticketing platforms (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, or similar systems).
KPI dashboards and data visualization tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Power BI).
Collaboration and documentation tools (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint).
Basic familiarity with scripting or automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash) is a plus.

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in a standard office or remote environment and use a computer for extended periods.
Ability to collaborate across time zones with stakeholders in Middle East and US.
Willingness to travel within the region for partner workshops, testing cycles, and integration reviews as needed.

About Us

Built with in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

Role Overview

As an Agent Engineer, you will work closely with our engineering, product, and client-facing teams to design, build, and deploy AI agents that solve real-world problems. You'll support Proof of Concept (POC) development, own the end-to-end delivery of agent implementations, and interface directly with clients — gaining hands-on experience in one of the most in-demand areas of modern AI.

Key Responsibilities

Support the development of Proof of Concepts (POCs) for new client use cases, from scoping through to demo-ready delivery.

Design and build AI agents using our platform, translating client requirements into functional agent workflows.

Own end-to-end delivery of agent implementations — taking responsibility for timelines, quality, and outcomes.

Interface with clients to gather requirements, present progress, answer questions, and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Listen to recorded calls between AI agents and customers, evaluating each interaction for accuracy, tone, compliance, and customer experience.

Score conversations against a defined quality rubric and document findings in our QA tracking system.

Flag agent errors, hallucinations, missed customer cues, and policy or compliance issues for the team to address.

Identify patterns and trends across calls — recurring failure modes, common customer questions, and opportunities to improve agent prompts and workflows.

•Partner with the Operations team to share feedback that informs agent training, prompt updates, and product improvements.

Help refine and evolve the QA rubric and scoring guidelines as our agents grow and change.

Contribute to weekly quality reports summarizing performance metrics, key issues, and recommended improvements.

Occasionally review chat or text-based agent transcripts in addition to voice calls.

Requirements

Basic understanding of software testing concepts and methodologies

Familiarity with testing tools or programming languages is a plus

Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and analytical abilities

Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

Ability to speak and write fluently in both Arabic & English

Must be based in Riyadh

Why Join Us?

Opportunity to be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up

Collaborative, mission-driven culture

Hands-on experience working on impactful AI products

About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Frontend Engineer (React.js) with 4–6 years of professional experience, ideally gained in fast-paced startup environments. This role requires strong expertise in building modern, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces, with the added advantage of familiarity with backend technologies such as Node.js. You will play a key role in shaping our product's user experience, collaborating across teams, and driving technical excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Frontend Development (React.js):
Architect, develop, and optimize responsive, intuitive, and high-performing web applications using React.js and its ecosystem (Redux, Context API, Next.js).
Ensure accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and performance best practices.
Implement reusable components and maintainable code structures.
• Backend Collaboration (Node.js):
Work closely with backend engineers to integrate APIs seamlessly into the frontend.
Contribute to backend discussions and provide input on Node.js services when needed.
• Product & Design Partnership:
Collaborate with Product Managers and Designers to translate business requirements into elegant technical solutions.
Advocate for design consistency and usability across the platform.
• Quality & Delivery:
Participate in code reviews, testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure high-quality releases.
Take ownership of feature delivery, ensuring timelines and standards are met.
• Team Contribution:
Engage, Learn, and Share best practices.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

4–6 years of professional experience in frontend engineering, preferably in startups.
Strong expertise in React.js and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles.
Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Context API) and frameworks like Next.js.
Familiarity with backend development using Node.js and API integration patterns.
Understanding of frontend performance optimization, accessibility standards, and security best practices.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.

The Director - Digital Engineering will provide technical leadership across Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all platforms, services, and digital capabilities are designed and delivered to the highest engineering standards. The role is accountable for ensuring that digital products are built with a reusable, scalable, resilient, reliable, observable, and extensible architecture that can be leveraged across multiple Qiddiya assets. This includes setting the technical direction, challenging low-level engineering decisions, governing solution quality, and ensuring that all delivery outcomes meet the standards defined by Qiddiya Investment Company. The Director - Digital Engineering will work in a multi-vendor delivery environment and will play a critical role in ensuring that vendors, engineering teams, and embedded technical leaders are aligned to Qiddiya's technology strategy, architecture principles, and operating model.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

Lead the technical oversight of Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all solutions are designed and delivered in line with Qiddiya's target architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technology vision
Define and enforce engineering principles around reusability, scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and performance across all digital products and platforms
Ensure that all technical decisions are properly reviewed, challenged, and validated by Qiddiya, with clear ownership and governance over architecture and engineering direction
Act as a senior technical authority capable of engaging at low-level design, architecture, code, integration, infrastructure, and operational decision-making levels
Challenge vendor proposals, solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical trade offs to ensure that Qiddiya retains control over critical engineering decisions

Product Architecture & Reusability

Ensure that digital products are built as reusable capabilities that can be extended and adopted across multiple Qiddiya assets, rather than being designed as isolated one-off implementations
Drive the creation of reusable patterns, components, services, APIs, integration approaches, and engineering guidelines that support product scalability across the Qiddiya ecosystem
Partner closely with architecture, product, delivery, DevSecOps, cloud, and security teams to ensure that product delivery aligns with the overall digital target state

Leadership of Staff Engineers

Lead and manage Staff Software Engineers who will be embedded within product streams and work closely with vendor teams
Set clear expectations for Staff Engineers around technical governance, architecture review, engineering excellence, code quality, observability, resiliency, and vendor challenge
Ensure that Staff Engineers are actively influencing product delivery, reviewing technical decisions, and protecting Qiddiya's long-term technology interests
Build a strong internal engineering capability that reduces dependency on vendors for critical technical decisions and strengthens Qiddiya's ownership of its digital platforms

Requirements

Significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles, ideally within large-scale digital platforms, e-commerce, entertainment, travel, hospitality, fintech, or other high-traffic consumer digital environments
Strong hands-on technical background with the ability to challenge detailed engineering, architecture, integration, infrastructure, and implementation decisions
Proven experience leading engineering teams in a complex multi-vendor or system integrator delivery model
Strong experience governing the delivery of reusable digital platforms, shared services, APIs, and scalable product architectures
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, DevSecOps, cloud-native architecture, observability, resiliency, reliability engineering, and secure-by-design delivery
Experience working with executive stakeholders and translating technical risks, trade-offs, and recommendations into clear business and delivery decisions

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Wonderful, you’ll turn complex enterprise workflows into AI agents that work in the real world.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. Embedding directly with enterprise teams, you’ll uncover how their operations actually run, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and build the systems that deliver it.

You’ll lead projects from initial discovery through production deployment, combining customer insight with hands-on engineering. After launch, you’ll measure real-world impact and keep iterating until the solution delivers meaningful results.

This role is for versatile engineers who enjoy combining deep technical work with customer context. You’re comfortable entering unfamiliar environments, asking incisive questions, and shipping practical solutions without waiting for a perfect specification.

What You’ll Do

Embed with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and measures of success. 
Turn loosely defined operational problems into clear technical plans and production systems. 
Design and build AI agents that integrate with customer tools, data, and business processes. 
Own deployments from prototype through launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
Test with real-world data, measure business outcomes, and iterate based on evidence. 
Make pragmatic tradeoffs across architecture, reliability, speed, and user experience. 
Partner closely with Wonderful’s Product and Engineering teams to improve the core platform. 
Turn lessons from individual deployments into reusable tools, patterns, and best practices. 

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience building software or solving complex technical problems. 
Strong foundations in software architecture, system design, and production engineering. 
Experience working across APIs, integrations, data flows, and distributed systems. 
The ability to bring structure and momentum to ambiguous problems. 
Confidence working directly with customers, from operational teams to technical stakeholders. 
Clear communication, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership. 
Genuine curiosity about applied AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate. 

Nice to Have

Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting, or customer-facing technical role. 
Experience building AI agents, workflow automation, or conversational systems. 
Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, and reliability in production. 
Experience deploying and improving systems in complex enterprise environments.

As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.

Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.

This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.

Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win. 
Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria. 
Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts. 
Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams. 
Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders. 
Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment. 
Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended. 
Monitor deployed agents and drive follow-up improvements based on real usage. 
Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers. 

You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value.

You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest-growing startup in Europe. 
Work on a cutting-edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in Enterprise right now. 
You’ll join a team of high-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there. 
Never boring - you’ll be solving problems for and with the biggest Enterprises in the world.

Experience in deployment-focused, technical, or execution-oriented roles. 
Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into concrete plans.

Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills. 
High ownership mindset and bias toward action. 
Interest in building and deploying AI-powered systems in real environments.

Prior hands-on engineering experience.

description_raw:
Company

Qualcomm Middle East Information Technology Company LLC

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary

About Us

Qualcomm is growing its presence in Riyadh and is hiring Data Centre Engineers to support our expanding infrastructure across the region. As Saudi Arabia accelerates its digital transformation under Vision 2030, Qualcomm is investing in world‑class computing and data centre capabilities to power AI, cloud, and advanced connectivity at scale. This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast‑growing technology hub, supporting critical environments and helping shape the future of data centre operations in the Kingdom and beyond.

About The Role

We are seeking a Staff‑level ML Applications Engineer with deep hands‑on experience in C++/Python‑based AI development in a Linux environment. The ideal candidate operates with a high degree of autonomy, defines technical goals and scope for assigned problem areas, and leads development efforts through execution. This role requires strong analytical skills, effective cross‑team collaboration, and the ability to mentor and guide other engineers by example while remaining hands‑on and execution‑focused.

We are looking for 8+ years Software Engineering or related work experience

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Improve and optimize key Deep Learning models on Qualcomm AI 100
Build deep learning framework extensions for Qualcomm AI 100 in upstream open-source repositories
Collaborate and interact with internal teams to analyze and optimize training and inference for deep learning
Build software tools and ecosystem around AI SW Stack.
Work on Triton, ExecuTorch, Inductor, TorchDynamo to build abstraction layers for inference accelerator.
Optimize workloads for both scale-up (multi-SoC) and scale-out (multi-card) systems
Optimize the entire deep learning pipeline including graph compiler integration
Apply knowledge of software engineering best practices.


Desirable Skills And Aptitudes

Required Skills and Aptitude

Deep Learning experience or knowledge – LLMs, Natural Language Processing, Vision, Audio, Recommendation systems
Excellent C/C++ Or Python programming and software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, and test design.
Very strong hold on Pytorch and JIT.
Well versed with open-source development practices.
Ability to work independently, define requirements and scope, and lead a development effort.
Mentors and guides team members through influence and example, without direct people‑management responsibility
Avid problem solver – should be able to find solutions to key engineering and domain problems.
Strong developer with a research mindset – strives to innovate.


Preferred Skills

Experiences to run workloads on large scale heterogeneous clusters is a plus
Knowledge of compiler is a plus.
Hands-on experience with CUDA, CUDNN is a plus.


Qualifications

Bachelor's / Masters/ PHD degree in Engineering, Machine learning/ AI, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
8+ years Software Engineering or related work experience.
2+ years experience with Programming Language such as C++, Python.

Salary including housing & transport allowance
Stock (RSU's) and performance related bonus
16 weeks fully paid Maternity Leave
6 weeks fully paid Paternity Leave
Employee stock purchase scheme
Child Education Allowance
Relocation and immigration support (if needed)
Life and Medical Insurance
Live+ Well Reimbursement for health and recreational membership fees


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.


OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Qiddiya Investment Company is on the hunt for a highly skilled and visionary Senior Manager - Cybersecurity Risk Management to lead our cybersecurity initiatives in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. This critical role will involve overseeing the development and implementation of a robust cybersecurity risk management strategy that safeguards our assets while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

You will be tasked with identifying and mitigating cybersecurity risks, fostering a culture of security awareness, and leading a team dedicated to maintaining the integrity and security of our information systems. Your expertise will be essential in shaping the direction of our cybersecurity posture in alignment with our business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement a comprehensive cybersecurity risk management framework tailored to organizational needs and regulatory requirements
Lead risk assessments and vulnerability assessments to identify threats and exposures associated with information systems
Oversee the creation and maintenance of a cybersecurity risk register, tracking and reporting on identified risks and mitigation efforts
Collaborate with IT, legal, and compliance teams to ensure that cybersecurity measures align with overall enterprise risk management strategies
Drive the development and execution of training and awareness programs to ensure all employees understand their role in cybersecurity risk management
Prepare and present detailed reports on cybersecurity risks and compliance to executive leadership and stakeholders
Stay abreast of emerging cybersecurity threats and trends, providing strategic guidance to adapt risk management practices accordingly
Mentor and lead the cybersecurity risk management team, ensuring their professional growth and expertise in the field

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred
7+ years of experience in cybersecurity risk management or related roles, with substantial experience in leadership positions
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, methodologies, and industry best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT)
Expertise in risk assessment methodologies and risk mitigation strategies
Relevant certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), or equivalent are highly desirable
Exceptional analytical, organizational, and communication skills
A proactive and strategic mindset, capable of navigating complex challenges in cybersecurity

Benefits

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

Job Description

As a Project Manager at Devoteam Middle East, you will be responsible for managing end-to-end delivery of complex software products and applications, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and on budget. You will lead project planning within Agile frameworks, coordinate technical resources, manage risks inherent to software lifecycles, and maintain strong communication with clients and stakeholders. Your role will involve overseeing project performance through DevOps and DevSecOps lenses, tracking progress, resolving technical bottlenecks, and ensuring alignment with client expectations. Additionally, you will contribute to improving project management practices and governance within the organization, driving impactful digital transformation in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Lead applications development projects from initiation to closure, overseeing the full planning, execution, and delivery of high-quality software products. 
Develop and maintain detailed project plans using Agile methodologies, establishing clear objectives, sprints, milestones, and delivery timelines. 
Define and manage project scope and technical resources, coordinating between developers, DevOps engineers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment and availability. 
Proactively manage risks and mitigate disruptions, specifically addressing security vulnerabilities within a DevSecOps framework and handling scope changes effectively. 
Serve as the primary point of contact, facilitating communication between technical teams and stakeholders while providing regular updates on project health and quality control. 
Track project progress, adjusting plans when necessary to ensure all software delivery goals and KPIs are met. 
Manage project financials and track invoices and milestones to ensure adherence to the financial constraints of the engagement. 
Adhere to project management office practices and governance. 


Qualifications

Professional Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in managing software applications development or IT-related projects, with a strong background in technical leadership. 
Educational Background: Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a relevant technical field. 
Domain Expertise: Must be a Subject Matter Expert in Project Management with specific knowledge of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and DevSecOps integration. 
Certifications: Professional certification is required; PMP (Project Management Professional) and PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner) are highly preferred. 
Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
Language Proficiency: Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.
