Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst to join the Learning Solutions & Services Department.

The Learning Solutions & Services Department is responsible for delivering and continuously enhancing enterprise learning technologies that support Saudi Aramco’s corporate learning. The department manages the organization’s learning platforms, digital learning services, and technology-enabled learning solutions to provide an integrated, scalable, and learner-centric experience.

Your primary role is to analyze, design, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise learning systems. You will serve as the technical bridge between business requirements and technology solutions, ensuring seamless integration across learning platforms, applications, and future digital learning initiatives via reliable, secure, and scalable learning services.

Duties and Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
• Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions supporting enterprise learning systems.
• Design, assess, and support integrations between SAP SuccessFactors Learning, enterprise applications, and other internal and external systems.
• Lead technical analysis for new learning technologies to ensure compatibility with the existing enterprise learning architecture.
• Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of mobile learning solutions, including required backend integrations and system interfaces.
• Assess academic and corporate Learning Management Systems, including Blackboard, Canvas, Moodle, and similar platforms, to determine meeting business needs and integration requirements.
• Enhance and maintain corporate learning systems, including SuccessFactors Learning Managements System and Job Certification.
• Evaluate emerging learning technologies and recommend improvements that enhance learner experience, system performance, and operational efficiency.
• Lead AI enablement within learning systems.

Minimum Requirements
• You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering, or another related discipline from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
• You will have 8 years of experience in enterprise business systems, learning technologies, or Human Capital Management solutions.
• You will have strong experience with SAP SuccessFactors Learning or comparable enterprise Learning Management Systems.
• You will have experience designing and supporting system integrations using APIs, web services, middleware, or integration platforms.
• Experience with academic Learning Management Systems such as Blackboard, Canvas, or Moodle is preferred.
• You will have experience supporting mobile applications and digital learning platforms.

Work Location and Work Schedule

Work Location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer

Work Schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer

Job Post Duration

Job posting start date: 07/16/2026

Job posting end date: 12/31/2026

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

description_raw:
Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking Computational Research Expert with a strong background in Artificial Intelligence to join our Research & Development Center (R&DC).

R&DC conducts strategic research, development and demonstration programs in support of Aramco’s drive for innovation.

Your primary role is to design, develop, and deploy advance AI and ML solutions to address complex business, scientific, and engineering challenges.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
• Design, develop, and validate advanced AI/ML models
• Engage with stakeholders and domain experts to understand challenges, formulate AI-ready problem statements, and identify impactful solutions.
• Lead end-to-end AI projects, from data acquisition and feature engineering to deployment and performance monitoring.
• Integrate AI solutions with existing systems, digital twins, and operational workflows.
• Stay current with AI research and translate emerging methods into practical applications.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide technical guidance and mentorship.
• Contribute to technical documentation, patents, and publications.

Minimum Requirements
• As a successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor degree AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields. A PhD is also required.
• You should have a minimum of 5 years of experience.
• You will have a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, and optimization.
• You will also have a proven track record of conducting advanced technical projects with an ability to connect basic science research with industrial applications.
• It is also necessary to have proficiency in Python and experience with large-scale data and computing environments. Coding in PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX skills are also required.

Work Location and Work Schedule

Work location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer

Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer

Job Posting Duration

Job posting start date: 12/18/2025

Job posting end date: 12/31/2026

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

description_raw:
نبذة عن الدور

;">تعلن شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات شركة شخص واحد عن حاجتها لتوظيف فني نظم حاسب آلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور بدوام كامل مسؤولية دعم العمليات التقنية من خلال جمع البيانات، وتحليل الوحدات الجزئية من النظم، وتوثيق الإجراءات، بالإضافة إلى تصميم فرعيات النظم.
المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية

********;">يقوم فني نظم الحاسب الآلي بتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وفعالية النظم، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي:

• إعداد النماذج الخاصة بجمع البيانات والمعلومات وجمعها من مصادرها المختلفة.

• إعداد النماذج الأولية للدراسة التحليلية ودراسة وحدة جزئية من النظام وتحليلها وفقاً لاحتياجات المستخدم.

• متابعة ومراقبة وتوثيق إجراءات فحص النظام وإعداد أدلة الاستخدام.

• تصميم فرعيات النظام مثل شاشات الإدخال والإخراج، وتوثيق فرعيات النظام.

• إعداد نماذج المواصفات الفنية للبرامج والمشاركة في تقدير الكلفة المالية للنظم.

• إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري.

متطلبات الخبرة

********;">يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال نظم الحاسب الآلي أو مجال تقني ذي صلة، مع إثبات القدرة على تطبيق المهام المذكورة أعلاه بفعالية.
المؤهلات والمهارات

********;">يجب أن يمتلك المرشح لهذه الوظيفة مجموعة من المؤهلات والمهارات الأساسية التي تمكنه من أداء مهامه بكفاءة، ومنها:

• القدرة على جمع البيانات والمعلومات وتحليلها بدقة.

• فهم جيد لمكونات النظم وكيفية عملها، مع القدرة على دراسة الوحدات الجزئية.

• مهارات ممتازة في التوثيق وإعداد التقارير الفنية وأدلة الاستخدام.

• القدرة على تصميم واجهات المستخدم (شاشات الإدخال والإخراج) وفرعيات النظم.

• مهارات تواصل فعالة وقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق.

موقع العمل ونوع الدوام

********;">يقع مقر العمل لهذا الدور في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة هي بدوام كامل، مما يتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بساعات العمل المحددة.
معلومات إضافية

**********;">الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم.

The Zero Trust Architect will serve as the technical authority for the customer's enterprise Zero Trust, IAM, and identity-security environment. The role is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving Zero Trust architectures across identity, devices, applications, networks, cloud, data, and security operations. The Architect will work closely with IAM, SOC, AD, infrastructure, network, application, endpoint, cloud, and security teams to implement secure, scalable, and resilient Zero Trust solutions aligned with business and cybersecurity requirements.

Responsibilities

• Design and maintain Zero Trust architecture, security standards, reference architectures, and adoption roadmaps.
• Assess security gaps across identity, devices, applications, network, cloud, data, and workloads.
• Implement least privilege, continuous verification, identity-first security, device trust, and risk-based access controls.
• Design and support IAM, SSO, MFA, ITDR, ZTNA, micro-segmentation, and identity-based access controls.
• Support application integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC.
• Configure and troubleshoot enterprise security platforms including Ping Identity, RadiantOne, Semperis DSP, Silverfort, and Zimperium MTD.
• Integrate identity, endpoint, network, application, cloud, and security telemetry to support Zero Trust policy enforcement.
• Monitor and investigate identity threats, suspicious authentication, privileged access, AD security events, and indicators of compromise.
• Support integration with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, UEBA, MDM/UEM, and NAC platforms.
• Perform security architecture reviews, Zero Trust maturity assessments, risk assessments, and control-gap analysis.
• Provide L2/L3 troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident investigation, remediation, and vendor escalation.
• Develop HLD/LLD, architecture diagrams, technical documentation, security recommendations, and implementation roadmaps.
• Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to customer teams and support continuous security improvement.

Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in Zero Trust, IAM, cybersecurity, identity security, or infrastructure security.
• Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, authentication, authorization, MFA, and ITDR.
• Good working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, and Kerberos.

Cybersecurity Intern – Saudi Nationals Only

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Employment Type: Full-time, Paid Internship — Initial duration of 1 year, subject to extension/conversion based on performance

Eligibility: Saudi Nationals only

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated Cybersecurity Intern to join our team for a paid, one-year internship, with the opportunity for extension or conversion to a full-time role based on performance. This internship offers hands-on exposure to real-world security operations, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) practices, and IAM initiatives. It is designed for recent Saudi graduates in Computer Science or related fields who have supplemented their academic background with relevant cybersecurity certifications, and who are eager to build a long-term career in cybersecurity within the Kingdom.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the security team in day-to-day monitoring, documentation, and reporting activities

• Assist in reviewing security policies, procedures, and control frameworks against recognized standards (e.g., NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001)

• Help conduct access reviews, user account audits, and basic IAM hygiene checks

• Participate in vulnerability scanning, patch tracking, and remediation follow-up under supervision

• Support security awareness initiatives, including content preparation and campaign tracking

• Assist in documenting incidents, findings, and risk registers

• Contribute to research on emerging threats, tools, and regulatory updates relevant to the Saudi cybersecurity landscape

• Shadow senior consultants/analysts during client or stakeholder engagements

• Prepare summaries, reports, and presentations as directed by the supervising team member

• Take on progressively greater ownership of tasks over the course of the year as skills develop

Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a closely related field (recent graduate — within the last 1–2 years)

Certifications (at least one preferred, in addition to or in lieu of extensive experience)

• CompTIA Security+

• CompTIA Network+

• (ISC)2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)

• Cisco Certified CyberOps Associate

• EC-Council CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) — Associate/Foundational level

• Any equivalent foundational cybersecurity certification

Technical Skills

• Basic understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs)

• Familiarity with common operating systems (Windows, Linux)

• Awareness of security fundamentals: CIA triad, threat landscape, common attack vectors

• Exposure to at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) is a plus

• Basic knowledge of security tools (SIEM, vulnerability scanners) is a plus, not mandatory

Other Requirements

• Saudi National (mandatory — position restricted to Saudi locals under Saudization requirements)

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English

• Eager to learn, detail-oriented, and able to work both independently and within a team

• Genuine interest in pursuing a long-term career in cybersecurity/GRC

• Available to commit to a full one-year term

Compensation & Duration

• Duration: 1 year initially, with extension or conversion to a permanent role considered based on performance

• Compensation: Paid monthly stipend/salary (amount to be specified by HR/finance)

• Performance reviewed periodically (e.g., quarterly or at mid-point) to assess progress and conversion potential

What We Offer

• Hands-on mentorship from experienced cybersecurity and GRC professionals

• Exposure to real client engagements in government and financial sector environments
• A full year of structured learning across GRC, IAM, and technical security domains

• Strong potential path to full-time employment based on performance

• Certificate of completion

Apply for this position

description_raw:
We are seeking a Cybersecurity Operations Specialist to manage and operate enterprise security technologies and controls that protect endpoints, user devices, and organizational data. The successful candidate will be responsible for administering endpoint security solutions, enforcing security baselines, managing data protection controls, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including SAMA Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) regulations.

This role requires hands-on experience with endpoint security, device management, data protection technologies, and collaboration with Security Operations Centers (SOC) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSP).

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Security & Device Management
• Manage and administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Administer and maintain Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms, ensuring full coverage, availability, and health monitoring.
• Monitor endpoint security posture and ensure compliance across all managed devices.
• Coordinate with SOC/MSSP teams regarding endpoint security alerts, investigations, and incident response activities.

Security Hardening & Compliance
• Implement and maintain endpoint and server hardening standards based on CIS Benchmarks or equivalent frameworks.
• Ensure compliance with security baselines and configuration standards.
• Track remediation of security vulnerabilities, non-compliant configurations, and endpoint risks.
• Support security assessments, audits, and compliance initiatives.

Data Protection
• Manage and maintain Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions, including:
• Policy creation
• Rule tuning
• Incident monitoring
• Exception management
• Operate and maintain data classification and watermarking solutions.
• Enforce information classification and data handling standards across the organization.

Security Tools Administration
• Administer, monitor, and optimize security technologies, including:
• Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
• Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
• Mobile Device Management (MDM)
• Email Security Gateway solutions
• Perform ongoing tuning and optimization to improve security effectiveness and reduce false positives.

Collaboration & Incident Support
• Work closely with IT Infrastructure teams to ensure secure configurations are implemented and maintained.
• Support cybersecurity incident investigations and response activities.
• Provide technical support and evidence during audits, assessments, and compliance reviews.

Documentation & Governance
• Maintain security tool documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical configurations.
• Prepare security reports and compliance evidence for internal and external stakeholders.
• Support SAMA and NCA audit requirements and regulatory inspections.

Required Qualifications

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Experience
• 3-5+ years of experience in Cybersecurity Operations, Endpoint Security, Security Engineering, or a similar role.
• Experience working within regulated environments such as banking, financial services, fintech, or government sectors is highly preferred.

Technical Skills

Candidates should have hands-on experience with:
• Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions (Microsoft Intune, Workspace ONE, Jamf, or similar)
• Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Trend Micro, etc.)
• Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions
• Endpoint and server hardening methodologies
• CIS Benchmarks and security configuration standards
• Vulnerability management and remediation processes
• Security incident investigation and response
• Email security and secure gateway technologies
• Microsoft Windows endpoint security administration

Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge

Experience or exposure to:
• SAMA Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
• National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Controls
• Information Security Governance
• Security Compliance and Audit Support
• Risk Management and Security Best Practices

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Project Manager to lead cybersecurity projects and coordinate effectively between clients, technical teams, vendors, and other stakeholders.

The role requires someone who can manage projects from planning through completion while maintaining clear communication with clients and senior management. The successful candidate should be comfortable managing technical teams and vendors, resolving delivery challenges, and presenting project progress, risks, and required decisions to executive and governance committees.

• Plan and manage cybersecurity projects from initiation through delivery and closure.

• Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and deliverables.

• Coordinate between clients, cybersecurity teams, IT functions, vendors, consultants, and other stakeholders.

• Build strong client relationships, manage expectations, and provide clear and timely project updates.

• Monitor vendor deliverables, SLA performance, outstanding issues, and contractual commitments.

• Escalate unresolved project risks and vendor performance issues through the appropriate governance channels.

• Maintain project plans, risk and issue registers, action trackers, decision logs, and change requests.

• Prepare executive dashboards and committee reports covering project status, milestones, budgets, KPIs, KRIs, risks, and vendor performance.

• Present project updates and required decisions to executive management and governance or steering committees.

• Record committee decisions and follow up on assigned actions until closure, maintaining a clear audit trail.

• Support cybersecurity reporting required by regulators, boards, and senior management.

• Coordinate projects across areas such as GRC, vulnerability management, IAM, SOC, security assessments, network security, and security monitoring.

• Ensure that projects follow the required governance, security, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of 7 years of total professional experience.

• At least 3 years of direct experience managing cybersecurity or IT security projects.

• Proven experience coordinating technical security teams and managing cybersecurity vendors or consultants.

• Strong client-facing or Client Success experience.

• Practical experience managing project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, and deliverables.

• Experience preparing and presenting reports to executive management and steering committees.

• Familiarity with NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, or similar cybersecurity frameworks is strongly preferred.

• Good understanding of key cybersecurity domains, including GRC, IAM, SOC, vulnerability management, security assessments, and network security.

• Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project-management methodologies.

• PMP certification is preferred but not mandatory.

• Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or Security+ are an advantage.

• Strong communication, reporting, documentation, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

• Collaborate with the business/BI Team to standardize visuals, KPIs, and data definitions.

5. Data Quality and Validation

• Monitor data quality and consistency, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
• Implement validation checks to ensure the reliability of analytical outputs.
• Support data governance initiatives by adhering to established standards and policies.

6. Performance Monitoring and Optimization

• Analyze the performance of business metrics and KPIs, identifying areas for improvement.
• Troubleshoot data-related issues affecting reporting or analytical processes.

7. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing

• Document analytical methodologies, data sources, and report specifications for reference.
• Share insights and best practices with team members to foster a data-driven culture.
• Maintain a repository of analytical assets for future use.
• Support business users in self-service BI, promote usage of standardized datasets.

8. Stay Updated on Analytical Trends

• Keep abreast of advancements in data analytics, visualization tools, and industry best practices.
• Explore and recommend new tools or techniques to enhance analytical capabilities.

9. Support Business Intelligence Initiatives

• Assist BI teams in leveraging data for strategic decision-making.
• Provide analytical support for ad-hoc requests and long-term business intelligence projects.

• Leverage AI-powered capabilities within Microsoft Fabric and Power BI (e.g., Copilot) to accelerate data exploration, insight generation, report development
• Use AI tools to generate initial analysis hypotheses summarize trends and anomalies
• enhance storytelling in reports
• Validate and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, business relevance, alignment with approved KPIs
• Collaborate with BI team to identify opportunities for AI-driven insights, natural language querying, automation of repetitive reporting tasks

Education Required:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
• A Master's degree in a relevant field is an advantage but not mandatory.
• Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) preferred, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) is a plus.

Field of Experience:

• Data Processing: Basic understanding of ETL processes and data preparation techniques.
• Data Analysis: Proven experience in analyzing datasets and generating actionable insights.
• Business Intelligence: Proven experience with BI tools and reporting platforms.
• Data Visualization: Hands-on experience creating dashboards/visual representations of data.
• Data Modeling: Experience designing data models to support reporting and analytics.
• Database Querying: Proficiency in working with relational databases and querying tools.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Proficiency translating business needs into analytical solutions.
• AI & Advanced Analytics: Exposure to AI-assisted analytics or automation tools in reporting and data analysis

Years of Experience:

• Typically, 3 to 7 years of experience in data analysis or a related IT field.
• At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience with data visualization tools, SQL querying, and business intelligence reporting.

Technical Skills:

• Programming Languages: Proficiency in SQL for querying databases; familiarity with Python or R for data analysis and modeling is a plus.
• Data Visualization Tools: Advanced proficiency in Power BI. Tableau, Looker is a plus.
• Database Knowledge: Experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, Oracle) and data warehouses (e.g., Synapse, Big Query).
• Power BI: Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including dataflows, datasets, measures, and report development.
• Data Transformation: Proficiency in DAX and Power Query (M) for report-level calculations.
• Microsoft Fabric: Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric components (Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Pipelines) and their integration with Power BI.
• AI & Advanced Analytics: Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools such as Power BI Copilot, Natural language query features. Ability to use AI tools to enhance productivity while maintaining analytical accuracy.

Why Work for Us:

At Nexttec Technology Outsourcing, we value our employees and strive to create a positive and inclusive work environment. We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for growth and development. As a member of our team, you will have the chance to work on challenging projects, collaborate with talented professionals, and make a significant impact on our clients' businesses.

If you are a highly motivated and skilled IT Data Analyst looking for a new opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and join our dynamic and innovative team at Nexttec Technology Outsourcing.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Digital & IT Strategy Consultant to join the Strategy and Investment Department.

The Strategy and Investment Department is responsible for designing, governing, and evolving Saudi Aramco's digital and IT strategy, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives while optimizing investments and partnerships.

Your primary role is toact as an IT strategic advisor, identify opportunities to enhance digital/IT capabilities through targeted investments, innovative partnership models, and adaptive operating frameworks that drive operational excellence and competitive advantage.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:
• Develop and refine Saudi Aramco's Digital & IT strategy, aligning long-term priorities (e.g., operating model transformation, sustainability, operational resilience, innovation) with emerging technologies (e.g., AI, cloud, cybersecurity, quantum) and industry benchmarks.
• Provide strategic advisory to senior leadership by translating market trends, competitor activities, and technological disruptions into actionable insights to shape priorities and capabilities.
• Conduct financial modeling and scenario analysis for digital/IT investments (e.g., cloud migration, automation programs), evaluating risks, costs, and revenue impacts to inform decision-making.
• Design execution frameworks for strategic initiatives, by ensuring alignment between technical delivery teams and business goals, and monitoring progress through KPIs and milestone reviews.
• Conduct market intelligence and scenario planning, including competitor analysis, technology adoption curves, and regulatory shifts, to identify risks, opportunities, and innovation pathways.
• Collaborate with technical teams to translate strategic priorities into implementation roadmaps, resolve execution bottlenecks and ensure cross-functional alignment.
• Benchmark global best practices in digital/IT strategy and execution and adapt frameworks to Saudi Aramco's operational context and regulatory environment.
• Lead capability assessments to evaluate gaps in current digital/IT capabilities and recommend targeted improvements (e.g., skill development, technology adoption, process optimization).
Minimum Requirements
• As a successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor's degree in Digital & Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Communication Engineering or Software Engineering.
• You will have a Master's degree in Digital & Information Technology, Engineering related fields, or Business Administration. PhD is preferred.
• You will have 15+ years of experience in Digital/IT domain and strategic advisory role, market intelligence, and technology roadmap implementation in large, complex organizations (preferably energy, industrial, or global sectors).
• You will have a deep technical expertise in at least one of the following Digital and IT domains: Data & AI (e.g. machine learning, data infrastructure), Telecom (e.g. network design, protocols), Computing (e.g. cloud/edge systems, HPC) and ERP (e.g. enterprise systems, integrations).
• You will have a proven track record of advising executive leadership on technology-driven strategy, designing execution frameworks for strategic initiatives, and leading market intelligence programs to inform decision-making.
• You will have the ability to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, balancing innovation with operational feasibility and financial rigor.
• You will be able to demonstrate experience in strategic planning frameworks (e.g., SWOT, scenario planning), market intelligence methodologies (e.g., competitor analysis, technology forecasting), and execution governance (e.g., milestone tracking, cross-functional alignment), financial modeling tools (e.g., Excel, SAP, Power BI), and investment governance standards (e.g., ROI analysis, NPV calculations).

Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer

Job posting start date: 12/31/2025

Job posting end date: 12/31/2026

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

description_raw:
Job Title: Field Core Support Engineer (Ericsson Systems) | SIS Global | Saudi Arabia
Recruiting Company: SIS Global
Job Location: Saudi Arabia
Job Type: Full-Time
Location: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Position: Field Core Support Engineer (SD1)
Industry: Telecommunications & Mobile Core Networks
Technology Focus: Ericsson Core Networks, Cloud Virtualization & Infrastructure Support
Mobility Requirement: Valid Driving License Required
Preferred Certifications: OHS Certifications and Ericsson Technical Training
Position Summary
SIS Global is seeking a highly skilled Field Core Support Engineer to support Ericsson Core Network platforms, virtualization environments, and mission-critical telecom infrastructure across Saudi Arabia. This role is ideal for experienced telecom professionals with strong Ericsson Core knowledge, advanced troubleshooting skills, and hands-on experience supporting carrier-grade network environments.
Detailed Job Description
As a Field Core Support Engineer, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational support of Ericsson Core Network platforms and supporting infrastructure. You will work across mobile core technologies, cloud-native platforms, virtualization environments, and data center infrastructure to ensure high service availability and operational reliability. The successful candidate will support hardware diagnostics, software troubleshooting, network recovery activities, and field operations while working closely with operations teams and customers. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge telecom and cloud technologies in a fast-paced carrier environment.
Key Responsibilities
Install, support, and troubleshoot Ericsson Core Network systems across 2G, 4G, and 5G environments.
Support Ericsson Packet Core nodes including EPG, MME, and SAPC platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting core network services and infrastructure.
Perform hardware diagnostics, fault isolation, and board replacement activities.
Support APZ and APG platform maintenance and recovery procedures.
Execute hardware replacement verification (HRV) and post-maintenance testing activities.
Manage and troubleshoot Ericsson CNIS and NFVI infrastructure components.
Support containerized and cloud-native environments running on Red Hat OpenShift.
Utilize CELLO, MO-Shell, Linux, and Wireshark tools for diagnostics and troubleshooting.
Support fiber-optic connectivity troubleshooting using VFLs, optical power meters, and testing equipment.
Participate in data center operations, infrastructure maintenance, and service restoration activities.
Collaborate with operations, field support, and engineering teams to ensure service continuity.
Maintain technical documentation, maintenance records, and support reports.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong hands-on experience supporting Ericsson Core Network environments.
Proven expertise in Ericsson Core technologies across 2G, 4G, and 5G networks.
Experience supporting:
EPG (Evolved Packet Gateway)
MME (Mobility Management Entity)
SAPC (Service-Aware Policy Controller)
Knowledge of VAS and Intelligent Network (IN) environments.
Experience with Ericsson CNIS and NFVI platforms.
Strong knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift (OCP).
Experience with Linux operating systems and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of data center operations and enterprise infrastructure environments.
Strong understanding of hardware diagnostics and fault management.
Experience supporting enterprise platforms from HPE, Dell, Cisco, Juniper, and SAN environments.
Familiarity with fiber-optic troubleshooting methodologies and test equipment.
Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Strong English communication skills.
High level of commitment, flexibility, and ability to work under pressure.
Valid Driving License.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Kubernetes administration experience.
AWS cloud platform experience.
Ericsson vendor certifications.
Red Hat OpenShift certifications.
OHS and workplace safety certifications.
Experience supporting cloud-native telecom core networks.
Experience working within telecom managed services or operator environments.
Knowledge of automation and orchestration platforms.
Exposure to virtualization and container infrastructure management.
Recruitment Pro Tip
For Ericsson Core Network roles, hiring managers focus heavily on practical troubleshooting and field support experience. Ensure your CV highlights Ericsson Core nodes supported, major incidents resolved, hardware replacement activities performed, cloud-native platforms administered, and technologies such as EPG, MME, SAPC, CNIS, NFVI, and OpenShift. Quantifying network scale, customer environments supported, and service restoration achievements can significantly improve your chances of securing an interview.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Software Engineer - New Product based in Saudi Arabia.

This is a founding engineering opportunity focused on taking an early real-time 3D product from prototype to a strong technical foundation. You will be the first and initially only engineer, working closely with product leadership and an established engineering team. The product is browser-native and designed to run across a broad range of devices, from school Chromebooks and Android phones to tablets and gaming PCs. You will shape the MVP, evaluate competing technologies, and make foundational architectural decisions. The role combines hands-on software development, rapid experimentation, product thinking, and technical leadership. As the product and team grow, the position can evolve into a broader technical leadership role.
Accountabilities:

As the founding engineer, you will take significant ownership of the product's early technical direction while remaining deeply hands‑on. You will move quickly from ideas and prototypes to practical, scalable solutions and help establish an architecture that can support both product growth and an open‑source community.
• Define the MVP and rapidly prototype different technical approaches.
• Evaluate technologies including Three.js, WebGPU, WebGL, PlayCanvas, and comparable web-game technologies.
• Assess the existing browser-native prototype and determine which components should be retained, improved, or replaced.
• Design the architecture and build the technical foundation for the initial product.
• Determine how the browser-native experience should interact with the existing Windows-native product.
• Explore technical challenges involving multiplayer, content compatibility, and boundaries between browser and Windows-native experiences.
• Establish an architecture suitable for an open-source development community.
• Use AI-assisted development extensively to accelerate experimentation, implementation, and iteration.
• Provide strong technical and architectural leadership while contributing directly to the codebase.
• Collaborate closely with product leadership and the broader engineering organization.
• Help shape product decisions by combining technical feasibility, user needs, and long-term scalability.
• Establish performance and optimization strategies for a product expected to operate across a wide range of hardware.
• Contribute to the evolution of the product and potentially take on broader technical leadership as the team expands.
Requirements:

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands‑on game development, real‑time 3D expertise, and the ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment. You should be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, testing ideas quickly, and taking ownership of both product and technical outcomes.
• 5+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability.
• Strong experience with web-based game development and real‑time 3D.
• Hands‑on experience with technologies such as Three.js, WebGPU, WebGL, PlayCanvas, or comparable frameworks.
• Professional Unity or game development experience.
• Strong understanding of multiple game‑development disciplines, such as gameplay, rendering, networking, tools, engines, or technical art.
• Demonstrated ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate competing technologies.
• Experience with AI‑assisted software development.
• Strong product instincts and the ability to think as both a product owner and technical leader.
• Excellent architectural judgment and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently in a fast‑moving, ambiguous startup environment.
• Strong performance and optimization instincts across a wide range of hardware and device capabilities.
• A hands‑on mindset and willingness to move quickly from ideas to working prototypes.
• Curiosity and the ability to learn new technologies rapidly.
• Experience with game engines or editors, open‑source projects, multiplayer systems, content pipelines, or products shipped across desktop and mobile is a plus.
• A portfolio of software, games, tools, prototypes, GitHub projects, or other products you have built is highly valued.
Benefits:
• Remote / work from anywhere.
• Contractor engagement.
• Initial 3-month engagement.
• Opportunity to help define a new product from its earliest stages.
• Significant ownership over product direction, architecture, and implementation.
• Direct collaboration with product leadership and experienced engineering teams.
• Opportunity to work with modern browser‑based real‑time 3D technologies.
• Freedom to experiment, prototype, and evaluate new technical approaches.
• Opportunity to use AI‑assisted development to accelerate engineering work.
• Potential to continue with the product beyond the initial engagement.
• Opportunity to grow into a larger technical leadership role as the product and team expand.
• Exposure to open‑source product architecture and community‑driven development.

About Lucidya

;">Lucidya is a leading AI-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform in the MENA region. The platform enables enterprises to understand, engage, and serve customers across digital channels at scale. As Lucidya scales its platform and moves toward IPO-scale engineering, it seeks to expand its engineering team.

The Role: Frontend Software Engineer

********;">Lucidya is seeking a Frontend Software Engineer to join its team in Jeddah or Makkah. This full-time role is suitable for engineers with 0-1 years of professional experience who are passionate about building high-quality user experiences and learning modern engineering practices. The position emphasizes ownership, speed, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement in software delivery, including the use of AI as an engineering accelerator.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain production-grade web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

• Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable frontend components.

• Translate product requirements and designs into clean, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.

• Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and real-time communication services, including WebSockets/***

• Manage server state efficiently using React Query/TanStack Query and complex client-side state with Redux/Redux Toolkit when appropriate.

• Contribute to improving frontend architecture, performance, code organization, and maintainability.

• Write reliable unit and integration tests using Jest and build end-to-end tests using Playwright.

• Participate in code reviews, identify regressions, and debug issues systematically.

• Utilize AI coding tools for research, prototyping, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring solutions, while critically reviewing AI-generated code.

• Take ownership of work from requirements understanding through implementation, testing, review, and production.

• Collaborate with frontend, backend, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.

• 0-2 years of professional frontend development experience.

• Strong understanding of JavaScript fundamentals and hands-on experience building applications with React.

• Good understanding of TypeScript, type-safe development, and React fundamentals (components, hooks, state management, rendering, lifecycle).

• Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data.

• Familiarity with React Query/TanStack Query, Redux/Redux Toolkit, and frontend testing tools such as Jest and Playwright.

• Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using WebSockets/** and basic understanding of message queues like RabbitMQ.

• Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals.

• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

• Ability to debug problems, write clean and maintainable code, and use AI tools to improve productivity.

• Strong willingness to learn, continuously improve, and demonstrate good communication and teamwork skills.

Technical Environment

********;">The frontend ecosystem includes React, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React Query/TanStack Query, Redux/Redux Toolkit, Jest, Playwright, WebSockets/**, RabbitMQ, REST APIs, Git, and modern AI-assisted development tools. Experience with every technology is not required, but strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly are essential.

Career Growth at Lucidya

**********;">Joining Lucidya offers the opportunity to work on an enterprise platform operating at scale across the MENA region, building products used by major organizations. Engineers gain hands-on experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, RabbitMQ, APIs, and complex frontend applications within an AI-native product environment. The company supports learning from experienced engineers and provides meaningful ownership early in one's career, fostering continuous skill development and growth toward becoming an exceptional engineer.

• Experience with GRC platforms & ITSM knowledge is plus
Competencies
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills (verbal and written).
• Attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
• Team-oriented mindset with a proactive attitude.

Responsibilities
About the team:
The Cybersecurity team owns security for all services offered by Volcano Engine & BytePlus which is a cloud service provider owned by ByteDance, including IaaS, PaaS and SaaS. Join our forward-thinking security team dedicated to securing our cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge technologies and best practices. You will have the opportunity to design and implement robust security solutions for our cloud environments, ensuring the protection of sensitive data and the resilience of our systems.

The Director of Information Security is responsible for the overall cybersecurity posture of the organization and for ensuring compliance with applicable cybersecurity laws, regulations, and regulatory frameworks, including the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA).

This role will provide independent executive leadership and oversight across cybersecurity governance, risk management, and security operations. The role requires a pragmatic, business-oriented leader with strong expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, and modern technology environments, capable of ensuring that cybersecurity risks are identified, managed, and reported in alignment with the organization's risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

You’ll collaborate closely with senior executives. This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic outcomes, reduce risk exposure, and drive secure innovation across complex, interconnected ecosystems.

Responsibilities:
Cybersecurity Governance & Leadership:
- Establish and maintain enterprise-wide cybersecurity governance in line with SAMA CSF and NCA ECC requirements.
- Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and segregation of duties across cybersecurity functions.
- Advise executive management on cybersecurity risks, threats, and control effectiveness.
- Ensure cybersecurity considerations are embedded into corporate governance and enterprise risk management.

Cybersecurity Risk Management & Compliance:
- Own and oversee the cybersecurity risk management framework.
- Ensure continuous compliance with applicable regulations and industry good practices.
- Ensure timely remediation of audit findings and regulatory observations.
- Act as the primary point of accountability for cybersecurity matters with regulators.

Security Operations & Technology Oversight:
- Oversee cybersecurity operations including monitoring, detection, vulnerability management, IAM, and incident response.
- Ensure effective prevention, detection, response, and recovery capabilities.
- Govern the selection and operation of cybersecurity technologies.
- Ensure security by design across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and data platforms.

Incident Management & Cyber Resilience:
- Ensure effective incident response and cyber crisis management.
- Lead executive coordination during material cybersecurity incidents.
- Ensure alignment with business continuity and disaster recovery.
- Oversee post-incident reviews.

Third-Party & Outsourcing Cybersecurity:
- Ensure third-party cybersecurity risks are identified and managed.
- Ensure compliance of vendors with regulatory and contractual obligations.
- Oversee outsourced and managed security services.

People, Culture & Capability:
- Establish and maintain a compliant cybersecurity operating model.
- Develop national cybersecurity talent in alignment with Saudization.
- Promote cybersecurity awareness and culture.
- Ensure adequate resourcing and training.

Authority & Decision Rights:
- Define cybersecurity policies and standards.
- Escalate risks and incidents to executive management.
- Approve or reject cybersecurity risk acceptances.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Education: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, or a related field.
- Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in security strategy, cybersecurity governance, risk management, or related domains.
- Security Frameworks Knowledge: Familiarity with industry standards such as OWASP, SANS CWE Top 25, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST, and SAMA/NCA frameworks.
- Proven executive leadership in cybersecurity governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
- Strong experience engaging with Boards, regulators, and senior executives on cybersecurity matters.
- Ability to translate complex cybersecurity risks into clear business and risk implications
- Demonstrated leadership in building high-performing cybersecurity teams and national talent.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Sound decision-making and crisis leadership during material cybersecurity incidents Proven executive leadership in cybersecurity governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
- End-to-end security design and strategic roadmap of cloud security products and services.
- CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC Certifications

About Us
Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.

Why Join ByteDance
Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.
As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
Diversity & Inclusion
ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Position: Information Security Engineer (SOC L2)

Description

Department: Info Sec Monitoring

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: KSA

Reporting To: Weam Munshi
Description

Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest and fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.

Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing Fin Tech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.

As Information Security Engineer
, you’ll play a key part in monitoring and defending our infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments from cyber threats.

You’ll lead incident response efforts, develop and tune detection rules, investigate security events, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen our security posture.
Key Responsibilities Security Monitoring & Detection
• Monitor and analyze logs and alerts from a wide range of sources including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), endpoints, servers, and cloud platforms.
• Perform correlation of events from multiple sources to identify advanced threats and unusual patterns of behavior.
• Fine-tune alert thresholds and detection logic to reduce false positives and improve signal-to-noise ratio.
• Maintain dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into security posture.
Incident Response & Investigation
• Serve as a frontline responder for security incidents, managing incidents through their lifecycle – detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors during high-severity incidents or data breaches.
• Perform root cause analysis and forensic investigations using endpoint and network-based artifacts.
• Maintain detailed incident documentation and contribute to post-mortem analysis and reports.
Threat Intelligence & Detection Rule Development
• Research emerging threats and trends.
• Contribute to the creation and tuning of detection rules, threat-hunting queries, and use cases across multiple platforms including cloud environments.
• Maintaining CTI Platform along with the integration of the CTI feeds with the security controls to have active CTI driven detections.
Collaboration and Communication
• Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams including IT, Dev Ops, Risk, and Compliance during incidents and investigations.
• Provide concise and clear updates during incident handling to stakeholders and management.
• Mentor junior analysts and assist in training efforts within the SOC team.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• 2–3 years of experience in a SOC or cybersecurity operations role, ideally in a fast-paced fintech or enterprise environment.
• Strong knowledge of security best practices, including incident handling, alert triage, log analysis, and threat modeling.
• Understanding of online technologies, REST APIs, microservices, and modern application architectures.
• Experience working in a culturally diverse and collaborative environment.
• Familiarity with DLP, AV, and anti-malware systems from an operational monitoring perspective.
• Experience with phishing detection, user behavior analytics, and security awareness campaigns.
• Security certifications such as Security+, CySA+, eCIR, eCTHPv2, GCIA, or GMON (preferred but not required).
• Strong communication skills, especially for coordinating incident response and writing clear incident reports.
• Experience with SIEM platforms, SOAR tools, EDR/XDR, and Threat Intelligence platforms.
• Familiarity with cloud environments and cloud-native logging and monitoring tools.
• Scripting experience (e.g., Python) to automate tasks and improve SOC efficiency.

Department: InfoSec GRC

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: KSA

Description

We're looking for an Information Security Specialist (GRC) to join Tabby! The successful candidate will independently execute governance, risk, and compliance activities across the Tabby's information security programme.

Key Responsibilities

Information Security Governance

• Maintain and update the information security governance framework documentation, policy library, and associated standards and procedures.
• Draft and revise information security policies, standards, and baselines, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and business objectives.
• Monitor and track changes in legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements affecting information security (SAMA CSF, PDPL, NCA ECC, PCI-DSS), updating the compliance register accordingly.
• Maintain and update role and responsibility matrices (RACI), information security governance committee documentation, and reporting packs.
• Coordinate security governance committee meetings — preparing agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
• Produce internal and external communication materials related to information security governance, policies, and programme updates.

Information Risk Management

• Execute information security risk assessments independently, applying the organization's risk assessment methodology and producing complete risk registers with identified threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, impact, and treatment plans.
• Maintain and update the information asset register — tracking asset owners, classifications, and associated risk profiles.
• Lead business impact assessment (BIA) data collection activities, coordinating with asset owners and business units to capture accurate recovery objectives and criticality ratings.
• Conduct control effectiveness evaluations for key information security controls, documenting findings and escalating gaps to the Lead for treatment.
• Coordinate third-party information security risk assessments — preparing assessment questionnaires, reviewing vendor responses, and producing risk summaries.
• Integrate risk and vulnerability data into procurement reviews, project onboarding, and change management processes.
• Prepare periodic risk reports for senior review, highlighting emerging risks, significant changes in the risk profile, and the status of risk treatment actions.

Compliance & Programme Development

• Monitor the organization's compliance posture against SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, PDPL, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS — tracking control status, identifying gaps, and coordinating remediation.
• Coordinate internal and external audit activities — gathering evidence packages, liaising with auditors, tracking findings, and monitoring remediation progress.
• Support the preparation of regulatory submissions, self-assessments, and compliance attestations required by SAMA, NCA, and PCI Council.
• Maintain and enhance the security awareness programme — developing training materials, scheduling communications, and tracking completion metrics.
• Monitor KPIs and KRIs for the information security programme, preparing accurate and timely dashboards for senior management review.
• Support the integration of information security requirements into procurement, project management, and change control processes.

Cross-Functional & General GRC Support

• Maintain the information security policy, standard, and procedure library — managing version control, review cycles, and distribution.
• Support information security initiatives across business and technology teams, providing GRC subject matter expertise on projects and change programmes.
• Conduct information classification reviews and document security requirements for key business and IT projects.
• Deliver information security awareness sessions and materials to targeted staff groups.
• Provide analytical support for GRC team reporting, data gathering, and programme tracking activities.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or a related field.
• 1–3 years of professional experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, or a closely related field. Hands-on experience with risk assessment execution, policy development, or compliance monitoring is required. Prior exposure to SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, PDPL, or NCA ECC requirements is a strong advantage. Experience in a regulated Fintech or banking environment is preferred.
• ISO 27001 Foundation or Lead Implementer (preferred). CompTIA Security+ or equivalent.
• Working toward CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control) or CISM.

Benefits

• We are an international team of inspired professionals located all over the globe.
• We have an inclusive company culture, embracing diversity, integrity and transparency. We strive for work-life balance and cherish the moments you spend with your loved ones, off-work. In the same spirit as for our product, we are caring and nurturing for our employees.
• Our people are granted 100% trust and freedom to apply their own vision and come up with their ideas from day 1 at Tabby. You are the one who takes responsibility for your area of work. We encourage everyone to think and make decisions like Tabby was their own business, well because it is. Our employee stock options programme is available for everyone.
• You will have an opportunity to learn and grow in one of the fastest growing fin tech companies in the region
• We offer you relocation support as well as we guide you through all the process.
• We’ll set you up with the devices required for your work.

description_raw:
نبذة عن الدور

;">تبحث شركة الحلول المتميزة للاتصالات و تقنية المعلومات عن محلل نظم معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فهم متطلبات العملاء وتحليل العمليات التجارية والإجراءات المتبعة، بهدف ترجمتها إلى وظائف ومتطلبات نظامية فعالة، مع إعداد الوثائق الفنية ومخططات التدفق اللازمة.
المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية

• جمع متطلبات العميل واحتياجاته من خلال إجراء المقابلات وتنظيم الاستقصاءات الموجهة.

• تحليل العمليات التجارية والإجراءات والممارسات المتبعة في بيئة العمل، بالإضافة إلى احتياجات العملاء، وترجمتها إلى وظائف ومتطلبات نظامية محددة.

• صياغة وثائق التصميم ومخططاته الانسيابية، وإعداد نماذج البيانات ومخططات التدفق الوظيفية وغيرها من الوثائق الفنية.

• إعداد وعرض العناصر المطلوبة من المشروع بشكل واضح وفعال.

• إجراء الاختبارات اللازمة وتحليل تقييم الأداء، لضمان تقيد البرامج والتطبيقات والبرامج النصية بالمعايير المحددة.

المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة

• خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تحليل نظم المعلومات أو مجال تقني ذي صلة.

• القدرة على فهم وتحليل العمليات التجارية واحتياجات المستخدمين بفعالية.

المهارات الأساسية

• مهارات قوية في جمع المتطلبات وتحليلها وتوثيقها.

• القدرة على إعداد الوثائق الفنية، بما في ذلك نماذج البيانات ومخططات التدفق.

• مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة لتقديم النتائج والتوصيات.

• الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في تنفيذ المهام.

بيئة العمل

********;">هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المرشح ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم تطوير وتحسين نظم المعلومات والحلول التقنية.

**********;">ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

description_raw:
IT Support Technician

We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused IT Support Technician to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical support to employees, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and ensuring the smooth operation of IT systems and end-user devices.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide first-line and second-line technical support to users through phone, email, remote access, and on-site assistance.
• Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues in a timely manner.
• Configure and support Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office 365, email accounts, and common business applications.
• Create, update, and manage user accounts, permissions, and access rights in accordance with company policies.
• Monitor and respond to IT support requests and incidents through the ticketing system.
• Maintain accurate records of IT assets, configurations, and support activities.
• Support basic LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and network troubleshooting.
• Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate IT teams or vendors when required.
• Assist with IT projects, system upgrades, software installations, and preventive maintenance.
• Ensure compliance with company IT security policies and procedures.
• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 2+ years of experience in IT support or a similar role.
• Good knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.
• Professional certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, or ITIL are preferred but not mandatory.

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Company

Sons Sulaiman Hamad Al Saif for Land Transport & Logistics operates across a geographically distributed transportation and logistics environment, making reliable, secure and resilient network infrastructure essential to business continuity and operational performance.

Job Purpose The IT Network Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, troubleshooting and optimizing the Company’s network infrastructure across offices, branches and operational locations.

Key Responsibilities

· Manage LAN/WAN infrastructure across Company locations.

· Configure and maintain switches, routers, firewalls and wireless infrastructure.

· Monitor network availability, performance and capacity.

· Troubleshoot network connectivity and performance issues.

· Implement network security controls and segmentation.

· Manage VPN connectivity between branches and corporate locations.

· Support network infrastructure projects and new site implementations.

· Maintain network diagrams, configurations and technical documentation.

· Monitor network capacity and recommend infrastructure improvements.

· Coordinate with telecom providers and technology vendors.

· Support business continuity and disaster recovery requirements.

· Ensure network infrastructure meets performance, availability and security standards.

· Participate in IT infrastructure and digital transformation initiatives.

Qualifications

Mandatory:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking or a related field.

· 3–5 years of relevant network engineering experience.

· Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching.

· Practical experience with enterprise network environments.

· Strong troubleshooting skills.

Preferred:

· Cisco enterprise networking experience.

· Experience with Fortinet, Palo Alto or similar technologies.

· Experience supporting multi-site environments.

Preferred Certifications:

· CCNA

· CCNP

· Fortinet certifications

· Network

Core Competencies

· Network Engineering

· Troubleshooting

· Network Security

· Infrastructure Management

· Analytical Thinking

· Problem Solving

· Vendor Management

· Documentation

Success Measures

· Network uptime and availability

· Incident resolution time

· Network performance

· Infrastructure security

· Successful implementation of network projects

description_raw:
IT Support & Venue Technology Specialist

Location: Saudi Arabia

Contract: 7-Month Fixed-Term Contract

Duration: ASAP – February 2027

Work Location: Primarily stadium-based

About the Role

We are hiring an experienced IT Support & Venue Technology Specialist to provide technical support across stadiums and tournament-related venues in Riyadh.

This is a 7-month contract role supporting venue preparation, technology testing, rehearsals and live football tournament operations. The successful candidate will combine IT help desk support, venue technology coordination, troubleshooting and IT asset management.

The role requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and extended hours during matchdays and other critical operational periods.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide first- and second-line IT support to venue teams, employees, contractors and operational stakeholders.
• Install, configure and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, mobile devices and other IT equipment.
• Resolve hardware, software, Microsoft 365, email, user-access, network, Wi-Fi and connectivity issues.
• Log, prioritise and track incidents through the designated IT help desk or ticketing system.
• Set up and test IT equipment across stadium offices, accreditation areas, workforce centres, meeting rooms, control rooms and other operational spaces.
• Conduct venue technology checks before rehearsals, matchdays and live tournament activities.
• Operate from the venue IT help desk or technology operations centre during live events.
• Respond immediately to matchday incidents and prioritise issues according to their operational impact.
• Coordinate with network, telecommunications, audiovisual, access-control and specialist technology teams when required.
• Maintain live incident logs and provide regular updates until critical issues are resolved.
• Arrange temporary workarounds, backup equipment and escalation support to minimise operational disruption.
• Prepare, issue, track and recover IT equipment allocated to venue teams.
• Maintain accurate IT asset registers, equipment handover records and inventory reports.
• Ensure spare laptops, chargers, cables, adapters and other essential equipment are available at the venue.
• Support venue decommissioning and final equipment reconciliation at the end of the project.
• Follow all IT security, cybersecurity, access-control and data-protection requirements.
• Prepare daily reports covering incidents, outstanding issues, equipment status and operational risks.

Qualifications and Experience

• Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, IT help desk or venue technology.
• Previous experience supporting stadiums, football tournaments, sporting events or major live events is strongly preferred.
• Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 and standard IT equipment.
• Experience troubleshooting wired networks, Wi-Fi, VPN and general connectivity issues.
• Familiarity with Active Directory, user-access administration and IT ticketing systems.
• Experience managing IT assets and equipment inventory.
• Ability to remain calm and resolve technical issues quickly during live operations.
• Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder-coordination skills.
• Good command of English; Arabic would be an advantage.
• ITIL, CompTIA or Microsoft certifications would be advantageous.

Important Requirements

• Must be available for the full contract from ASAP to 28 February 2027.
• Must be comfortable working primarily from stadiums and tournament venues.
• Must be flexible to work evenings, weekends, public holidays and extended hours during live tournament periods.
• Candidates should clearly highlight any stadium, matchday, sporting event or venue technology experience in their CV.
