Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Delivery owns the end-to-end design, planning, delivery, and operation of the global AWS infrastructure footprint — the backbone that enables the cloud to operate at scale. Our teams support every AWS data center and the full stack of critical infrastructure including compute, storage, networking, power, and cooling systems, ensuring customers maintain continuous access to the services and innovation they depend on. We operate in one of the world’s most complex environments, solving high-impact challenges across supply chain, deployment, operational readiness, and infrastructure scaling while continuously raising the bar on execution, resiliency, and customer experience.

You will join a high-performing, diverse organization of software engineers, hardware engineers, network specialists, supply chain professionals, security experts, operations leaders, and infrastructure teams working collectively to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure globally. Success in this environment requires strong ownership, collaboration across organizational boundaries, and relentless focus on safety, quality, and operational excellence. At AWS, individuals are empowered to think big, challenge convention, and drive initiatives through completion with measurable impact.

We are seeking an ID Install Technician to support network infrastructure deployment and expansion within our next-generation data center environments.

This role requires operating with a high degree of autonomy in fast-paced, mission-critical environments while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and execution standards.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical judgment, disciplined operational practices, and proven experience supporting large-scale enterprise infrastructure deployments.

Success in this role requires strong implementation and troubleshooting capabilities, structured documentation practices, and the ability to communicate effectively across technical and operational stakeholders.

The ability to execute efficiently under pressure, adapt quickly to evolving priorities, and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams is essential.

Proven experience supporting large-scale enterprise network environments is required, along with strong implementation, troubleshooting, and structured documentation capabilities. Success in this role depends on effective written and verbal communication, disciplined operational practices, and the ability to collaborate efficiently across technical teams, stakeholders, and customers.

You must be able to adapt quickly to changing priorities, maintain composure under pressure, and contribute effectively within highly collaborative environments where precision, accountability, and execution excellence are critical to operational success.

Key job responsibilities

• As an ID Install Technician, you support deployment of next-generation network infrastructure across global data centers.
• Your day includes rack installation, structured cabling, hardware deployment, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure safe and accurate delivery at scale.
• You work closely with Network Engineering, Operations, Security, and Logistics teams to execute infrastructure builds with precision and efficiency.
• The role requires strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to operate in fast-paced, mission-critical environments with minimal supervision.
• You proactively identify risks, ensure adherence to safety and quality standards, and deliver consistent operational excellence across complex, high-impact deployments.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
• Experience in computer networking
• High school or equivalent diploma
• Knowledge of TCP/IP networks
• Knowledge of cloud computing technologies
• Knowledge of fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment and troubleshooting methodologies
• Knowledge of network design, protocols and Layer 1/2 troubleshooting

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
• Bachelor's degree in information technology or computer science
• Knowledge of fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment and troubleshooting methodologies
• Knowledge of server hardware and components

IT Application Support Administrator I

Company: HungerStation

Division: Technology

Department: IT Operations

Grade: IC1

Reports to: IT Operations Manager

Job Overview

The IT Application Support Administrator I is responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and supporting HungerStation’s IT applications and systems. The role provides day-to-day technical assistance to end users, ensures the reliable operation of IT applications and computer systems, and supports the timely resolution of incidents and service requests. The position serves as a key point of contact for application-related support, helping to maintain smooth IT operations and minimize disruption to business activities.

Key Responsibilities

The IT Application Support Administrator I acts as a first point of contact for IT application administration, support, and operational requests. The role is responsible for supporting the installation, configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and reliable operation of IT applications and computer systems across the organization.

The role manages day-to-day application support activities, responds to operational requests, troubleshoots technical issues, and provides assistance to different user groups. This includes handling incoming calls, emails, messages, and helpdesk requests in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), work instructions, and established IT processes.

The position is responsible for investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents with the aim of restoring services as quickly as possible, preferably at the First Point of Contact (FPOC). This includes monitoring, tracking, updating, and appropriately escalating active tickets when issues cannot be resolved within the required support level or timeframe.

The IT Application Support Administrator I provides support for desktop applications, workstations, and internal IT systems, ensuring that issues are addressed efficiently and with minimal disruption to employees. The role also takes proactive measures to identify recurring problems, investigate their root causes, and contribute to preventing similar incidents from occurring in the future.

The role researches and identifies appropriate solutions to application and software-related issues and communicates effectively with end users to understand the nature of technical problems. This may involve asking targeted questions to identify the root cause, guiding users through troubleshooting steps by phone, email, chat, or in person, and assisting HungerStation employees with setting up IT applications and resolving technical issues.

Where an issue cannot be resolved directly, the IT Application Support Administrator I is responsible for escalating it to the appropriate internal teams, such as software development, infrastructure, or other specialized IT teams. The role requires the ability to prioritize and manage multiple open incidents and requests simultaneously while maintaining appropriate communication and follow-up with affected users.

The position is also responsible for installing, configuring, monitoring, and maintaining IT applications and computer systems across the organization. This includes supporting the rollout and implementation of new systems and internal applications, as well as assisting with patches and anti-virus deployment and management.

All IT requests, incidents, and relevant support activities must be accurately recorded and maintained within the designated ticketing system. The role is also responsible for creating and maintaining application documentation, process workflows, technical notes, and user or support manuals, ensuring documentation is updated whenever systems, processes, or configurations change.

The IT Application Support Administrator I contributes technical documentation and relevant specifications to support the planning, implementation, enhancement, or upgrade of IT applications and systems. The role works closely with other IT team members to ensure that technical knowledge is properly documented and accessible to support effective service delivery.

Governance and Resilience

The IT Application Support Administrator I is expected to follow all relevant company and IT policies, procedures, processes, work instructions, and service standards to ensure that daily activities are carried out in a controlled, consistent, and effective manner.

The role contributes to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement across IT support processes and practices, with the aim of improving service quality, efficiency, user experience, and operational effectiveness. The position is also expected to contribute to maintaining a high-performance working environment and consistently demonstrate and promote HungerStation’s values.

Main Contacts

The role works closely with internal stakeholders across HungerStation, including employees, IT Operations, Technology teams, software and application teams, and other relevant internal departments. Where required, the position may also communicate with external partners, vendors, and service providers to support the resolution of IT application and system-related issues.

Qualifications and Requirements

The ideal candidate should have one to two years of relevant experience in IT application support, IT helpdesk, system administration, technical support, or a related field.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of IT troubleshooting and problem-solving and be able to investigate issues, identify appropriate solutions, and make practical decisions when implementing workarounds to restore services. The role requires creative and analytical thinking to identify alternative solutions when standard troubleshooting approaches do not resolve an issue.

The candidate should be able to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple requests simultaneously, and prioritize assigned tasks according to business impact, urgency, and agreed service levels. Strong communication and customer-service skills are also important, as the role requires regular interaction with end users and internal stakeholders.

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical field is required.

Competencies

The role requires strong problem-solving, communication, customer service, collaboration, time management, adaptability, and prioritization skills. The candidate should demonstrate a proactive approach to troubleshooting, a willingness to learn, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced technology environment.

From a technical perspective, the candidate should demonstrate knowledge of IT application support, troubleshooting, incident management, ticketing systems, application installation and configuration, workstation support, software maintenance, patching, anti-virus management, and basic IT systems administration.

Who we are

Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

• Strong proficiency with ITSM toolssuch as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or BMC Remedy.
• Solid understanding of enterprise ITenvironments, including infrastructure, cloud, networking, and applications.
• Demonstrated ability to balancegovernance rigor with business agility in a fast-moving environment.
• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholdermanagement skills.
• ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leaderdesignation.
• Experience implementing Change Enablement in DevOps orCI/CD-driven environments.
• Familiarity with release management, deployment pipelinesand DevSecOps practices.
• Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as ISO 20000, SOX,ISO 27001, or COBIT.
• Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2) is a plus.

We are looking for an experienced L2 Security Monitoring Specialist to join a high-profile project in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will work as part of a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC), responsible for real-time security monitoring, alert triage, investigation, and escalation of potential security incidents.

This is a project-based, fixed-term opportunity running from 1 December 2026 to 28 February 2027.

Key Responsibilities
• Monitor SIEM/SOAR dashboards and alert queues as part of a rotating 24/7 shift pattern.
• Perform L1/L2 triage and investigation of security alerts to determine whether activity represents a genuine security incident.
• Correlate events across network, endpoint, identity, and cloud log sources.
• Analyze logs and security events to identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and distinguish genuine threats from benign activity.
• Execute documented security detection use cases and incident response playbooks.
• Escalate confirmed or high-confidence incidents to the L3 Security team, ensuring a complete and accurate evidence trail.
• Maintain detailed and auditable case documentation within the ticketing/case management system.
• Track vulnerability and patch remediation activities and flag overdue items where required.
• Support incident response drills, tabletop exercises, and shift handovers.
• Assist with the onboarding and integration of new log sources into the SIEM environment.
• Follow established SOC procedures, incident response processes, and security escalation protocols.

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in SOC, security monitoring, cybersecurity operations, or a closely related role.
• Hands-on experience with SIEM and/or SOAR platforms.
• Strong experience in security alert triage, incident investigation, and log analysis.
• Understanding of network, endpoint, identity, and cloud security events.
• Experience working with incident response processes and security playbooks.
• Ability to identify and investigate suspicious activity and potential indicators of compromise.
• Strong documentation and evidence-gathering skills.
• Comfortable working in a 24/7 shift-based SOC environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively under time-sensitive conditions and escalate incidents appropriately.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience using platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR solutions, or similar security technologies are encouraged to apply.

• Project Duration: 1 December 2026 – 28 February 2027
• Contract Type: Project-Based / Fixed-Term
• (Saudi Nationals): Highly preferred

• Candidates must be comfortable committing to a short-term project-based assignment and working a rotating 24/7 shift pattern.

• Drive continuous improvements to engineering processes, collaboration practices, and team effectiveness.

• Strong understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, microservices patterns, and message brokers such as RabbitMQ.

• Solid database design and development experience with PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Redis.

• Practical experience modernizing legacy systems, including refactoring monolithic applications into microservices architectures.

• Experience with containerized environments and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges involving application architecture, implementation, data migration, performance, and production systems.

• Proven experience leading engineering teams, including conducting one‑on‑one meetings, performance reviews, objective evaluations, and career development discussions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance hands‑on technical leadership with people and delivery management.

• Full‑time remote opportunity.

• Initial compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.

description_raw:
Why This Role Matters

The Senior Specialist, Data Science & Artificial Intelligence II accelerates business value creation through the application of advanced analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI solutions. The role transforms data into actionable intelligence that improves decision-making, operational performance, automation, innovation, and business outcomes across the enterprise.

The role enables Ma’aden to harness the power of AI by developing scalable, reliable, and responsible solutions that address complex business challenges. Through the deployment of machine learning models and GenAI applications, the role improves efficiency, enhances user experiences, and unlocks new opportunities for digital transformation.

By combining technical expertise with governance, security, and ethical AI practices, the role ensures that AI solutions deliver measurable value while maintaining trust, compliance, and sustainable adoption across the organization.

What You Will Deliver AI Solution Development & Innovation

• Develop and deploy machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI solutions that address strategic and operational business challenges.

• Design scalable AI applications that improve decision-making, productivity, automation, and business performance.

• Accelerate AI adoption through innovative use of advanced analytics and emerging AI technologies.

Model Performance & Optimization

• Improve model accuracy, reliability, and effectiveness through feature engineering, tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques.

• Strengthen AI outcomes through robust testing, validation, and continuous performance enhancement.

• Ensure AI solutions remain aligned with business objectives and evolving operational requirements.

Generative AI & LLM Enablement

• Build and enhance GenAI applications using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and large language model technologies.

• Improve response quality, accuracy, and relevance through structured evaluation and optimization approaches.

• Deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities that support knowledge discovery, content generation, and intelligent automation.

Data Preparation & Engineering Enablement

• Transform structured and unstructured data into high-quality datasets suitable for AI and machine learning applications.

• Improve data usability and reliability through effective cleansing, preparation, and feature development practices.

• Ensure AI solutions are built on trusted, governed, and business-relevant data assets.

AI Operations & Lifecycle Management

• Support deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management of AI solutions using MLOps and LLMOps practices.

• Improve operational reliability and scalability of production AI models and applications.

• Enable sustainable AI adoption through effective performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

Governance, Risk & Responsible AI

• Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and ethical AI requirements.

• Strengthen transparency and trust by documenting models, assumptions, risks, and validation outcomes.

• Promote responsible AI practices that balance innovation with risk management and compliance obligations.

What Success Looks Like

• AI and machine learning solutions deliver measurable business value and operational improvement.

• Generative AI applications provide accurate, reliable, and high-quality outputs for end users.

• Machine learning models achieve performance targets and remain effective throughout their lifecycle.

• AI solutions are successfully integrated into enterprise processes and systems.

• MLOps and LLMOps practices improve model reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

• Governance, security, and responsible AI requirements are consistently embedded within AI initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

Experience

• 4–6 years of experience in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics roles.

• Experience developing and deploying machine learning and AI solutions in business environments.

• Experience working with structured and unstructured data for analytical and AI use cases.

• Experience supporting AI solution deployment, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.

Skills That Matter Functional Expertise

• Machine Learning & Deep Learning

• Generative AI & Large Language Models (LLMs)

• Prompt Engineering

• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

• Model Fine-Tuning & Evaluation

• Data Preparation & Feature Engineering

Business & Delivery

• Python & SQL

• TensorFlow, PyTorch & Scikit-Learn

• MLOps & LLMOps Practices

• API Integration & AI Deployment

• Model Monitoring & Performance Optimization

• Analytical Problem Solving

People & Collaboration

• Collaboration & Teamwork

• Stakeholder Engagement

• Communication & Knowledge Sharing

• Results Orientation

• Accountability

• Continuous Improvement

Why This Role Matters

This role defines and supports technical solution delivery for Procure-to-Pay initiatives by translating business challenges, site-based evidence, and domain priorities into practical technology solutions. It works with platform architects, solution architects, domain integrators, business partners, and delivery teams to ensure P2P solutions are scalable, integrated, aligned with enterprise standards, and delivered with measurable business value.

What You Will Deliver

Manage Solution Delivery

• Capture statements of requirements for initiatives by translating P2P business challenges, operational pain points, and site-based evidence into clear solution needs.

• Translate priority elements of solutioning required to meet business unit objectives for relevant technology domains.

• Define solution plans and packages of work in line with platform architects, solution architects, and delivery priorities.

• Resolve technical and integration issues that may impact initiative outcomes, implementation quality, or value realization.

Guide Delivery Teams

• Guide delivery teams including data scientists, engineers, digital specialists, analysts, and external partners to ensure correct implementation of solution designs.

• Provide technical direction, design clarification, quality oversight, and practical implementation guidance throughout delivery.

• Ensure implementations meet agreed functional, performance, integration, control, and quality expectations.

• Support business unit delivery with site-based deployments, transition-to-run activities, issue resolution, and solution stabilization.

• Work with domain integrators and business partners to shape initiative scope, success measures, value hypotheses, and quarterly value milestones.

• Ensure initiatives remain aligned with agreed KPIs, value outcomes, delivery priorities, and TechOps standards.

• Surface technical trade-offs, delivery risks, cross-domain dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early for decision-making.

• Maintain alignment between solution plans, business priorities, delivery capacity, enterprise standards, and expected business value.

Ensure Scalable and Integrated Solutions

• Ensure solution designs are scalable, integrated, secure, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.

• Coordinate with platform, integration, data, cybersecurity, ERP, analytics, and application teams to resolve cross-domain dependencies.

• Confirm that solutions support workflow automation, data quality, reporting, controls, auditability, and operational support requirements.

• Promote reuse of solution patterns, standard configurations, and practical delivery approaches across P2P initiatives.

Provide Technical Issue Resolution and Quality Assurance

• Troubleshoot current and future-state issues across processes, workflows, platforms, integrations, data, controls, and user adoption areas.

• Monitor delivery progress against requirements, solution plans, quality criteria, value milestones, and operational readiness expectations.

• Drive corrective actions for defects, technical blockers, design gaps, integration issues, and implementation risks.

• Provide clear status, risks, technical recommendations, and decision support to the Director, TechOps Delivery, P2P Domain and relevant stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

• P2P business challenges are translated into clear requirements, solution plans, packages of work, and quarterly value milestones.

• Solution designs are scalable, integrated, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture, platform, and TechOps standards.

• Delivery teams receive clear technical direction, design clarification, and quality oversight throughout implementation.

• Technical risks, trade-offs, dependencies, and integration issues are surfaced early and resolved effectively.

•
Implemented solutions improve P2P performance, adoption, operational reliability, controls, and measurable business value.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mining or Minerals Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Experience

• Minimum 5–10 years of experience in technical, analytics, technology delivery, solution design, digital transformation, or enterprise application delivery roles.

• Proven experience owning solution design, guiding delivery teams, resolving technical and integration issues, and translating business needs into technical solutions.

• Exposure to P2P, procurement, supply chain, ERP, workflow automation, data, analytics, or technology operations environments is preferred.

• Statement of requirements capture, business problem structuring, value hypothesis development, and delivery planning

• Quality-focused delivery guidance, implementation oversight, testing support, and operational readiness

• Systems thinking, cross-domain integration, workflow automation, data quality, and enterprise platform alignment

• Risk, dependency, issue, trade-off, and stakeholder management across multiple concurrent initiatives

• Clear communication of technical direction to business, delivery, platform, architecture, and domain stakeholders

• Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving technology delivery environments

Role Purpose:

To ensure the organization has reliable, well-governed, and analytics-ready data by building and maintaining robust data pipelines and models. The role exists to make trusted data available securely and cost-effectively to support enterprise reporting, BI, and data-driven decision-making.



Key Responsibilities:

1- Enterprise Data Ingestion and Data Engineering;


• Build reusable, parameterized mappings and task flows in Informatica IDMC to standardize data ingestion.

• Implement change data capture (CDC), idempotent loads, schema evolution, and data-quality gates.

• Optimize Big Query loads using partitioning, clustering, and the appropriate load-versus-stream approach.

• Set up version control and CI/CD pipelines for data engineering assets.




2- Data Mapping & Transformation Design;


• Profile source systems and define field-level mappings and transformation rules.

• Specify business logic, including joins, lookups, and derivations.

• Define data-quality rules, exception handling, and reject criteria.




3- Orchestration, Automation & Reliability Engineering;


• Parameterize task flows and configure schedules and dependencies.

• Implement retries, backoff, and checkpointing to ensure reliable processing.

• Integrate monitoring and alerting through the Ops console and ChatOps.




4- Data Roles and Privacy management;


• Define least-privilege IAM roles and service accounts for data access.

• Apply dataset, table, row, and column-level security and data masking.

• Enable audit logging and retention policies, and classify PHI/PII data.




5- Modern Data Architecture & Data Modelling;


• Implement Medallion Architecture across the Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.

• Develop scalable, curated data models for analytical and reporting needs.

• Define data quality, lineage, and governance standards for curated data.

• Collaborate with business and analytics teams to create trusted datasets.




6- Workload Monitoring, Performance & Cost Optimisation;


• Track data freshness, job health, volumes, and anomalies.

• Monitor SLAs across job duration, errors, cost per TB, and slot usage.

• Tune BigQuery performance through query optimisation and resource management.

• Optimize cost through storage lifecycle management, query tuning, and caching.

We are seeking a Mid-Level Data Management Consultant to support clients across Saudi Arabia in implementing enterprise data management and governance frameworks aligned with National Data Management Office (NDMO) standards and Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority regulatory requirements.

The consultant will work closely with client stakeholders to assess current data maturity, design governance operating models, improve data quality practices, and support compliance with Saudi national data regulations including Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

• Translate business requirements into practical data governance and management solutions.

Required Qualifications

• 4–7 years of experience in data management, data governance, or consulting roles.

Team: Product

Type: Full-time

Location: On-site in Khobar, but we are open to hire the right talent to work remotely.
About B8ak

B8ak is a home services marketplace in Saudi Arabia. Customers book cleaning and maintenance through our app and web platform; thousands of vetted service professionals pick up that work and get paid through us. We've served well over 180,000 customers since launch, and the business runs on high frequency - our customers come back often, which means every friction point in the booking flow shows up in the numbers quickly.
The

role

You'll own the end-to-end experience of a two-sided marketplace: the customer booking a cleaner for Thursday morning, and the technician managing their day's jobs. These are very different users with very different constraints, and the product only works when both sides do.

This is a hands-on design role with real ownership. You'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Growth and Operations, and you'll see the impact of your work in conversion and repeat-booking data within weeks.
What you'll do
• Design flows, screens and components for the B8ak customer app, service-provider app, and web platform - from first sketch to production-ready specs
• Own the booking funnel: service selection, scheduling, address and basket, checkout. Reducing drop-off here is the single highest-leverage design problem we have.
• Optimize the booking funnel to yield better conversion page-to-page.
• Improve the first-time-to-repeat experience - onboarding, post-service follow-up, rebooking and loyalty surfaces.
• Design for the provider side: job acceptance, scheduling, navigation, earnings and ratings.
• Build and maintain our design system across Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), iOS, Android and web
• Run usability sessions with Saudi customers and with service professionals in the field, and turn what you learn into concrete design changes.
• Partner with Growth on A/B tests - basket size, pricing presentation, lifecycle messaging - and design the variants properly rather than as afterthoughts.
• Work with engineers through implementation and QA so what ships matches what was designed.
• Full understanding of agile development and JIRA work environment.
What we're looking for
• 4+ years designing digital products, with at least 2 years on consumer mobile apps.
• A portfolio showing shipped work, with clear reasoning about the problem, the constraints and the outcome - not just polished screens
• Strong command of Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout and prototyping
• Real experience designing bilingual Arabic/English products with proper RTL handling. This is not a nice-to-have for us.
• Comfort with data: you can read a funnel, form a hypothesis about where users are struggling, and design against it.
• Working knowledge of iOS and Android platform conventions and what is realistic to build
• Fluency in Arabic and English.
• Marketplace, on-demand, delivery or logistics experience.
• Experience designing for field workers or blue-collar users, especially on low-end devices and patchy connections.
• Familiarity with lifecycle and CRM tools (Web Engage, Braze, Clever Tap).
• Service design or operations-facilitating tooling experience.
• Motion design, or front-end familiarity (HTML/CSS).
What we offer
• A product used every day by households across the Kingdom, with immediate and visible impact.
• Design ownership of a core surface rather than ticket-taking.
• A fast team where decisions get made in days, not quarters.
• Competitive salary, medical insurance, and standard Saudi benefits.
• On-site work with great work environment in Khobar city, we are also open to hire remotely with the right talents.

Location: Saudi Arabia

Department: Pre-Sales Dep

Reports To: Pre-Sales Director

Position Overview

The Senior Pre-Sales Engineer – Compute, Virtualization & HCI serves as the primary technical authority for enterprise server platforms, hypervisor virtualized environments, Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI), and hybrid cloud stacks. This role focuses on compute and virtualization domain depth, executing complex sizing models, authoring compliant RFP responses, and delivering hands-on PoCs.

Key Responsibilities
• Compute & HCI Architecture: Architect enterprise server configurations, rack/blade systems, and Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) nodes. Perform host sizing, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, RAM allocation, and software-defined storage (vSAN) calculations.
• Virtualization & Cloud Sizing: Design enterprise virtualization stacks, micro-segmentation, management clusters, and hybrid cloud integration platforms.
• RFP Technical Authoring: Analyze enterprise compute and virtualization RFPs/RFQs. Author technical proposal narratives, high-level designs (HLD), sizing matrices, and accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQ) with full software licensing breakdowns.
• Hands-on PoC Execution: Plan, build, and execute hands-on compute performance testing, hypervisor failover validation, workload migration, and HCI cluster demonstrations for clients.
• Vendor Technical Alignment: Collaborate directly with OEM technical teams (VMware, Nutanix, Dell, Cisco, Huawei) to ensure configuration compliance, deal registration accuracy, and optimal sizing.

• Technical Sizing Accuracy: 100% technical compliance and zero calculation or licensing errors across compute, hypervisor, and HCI BOQs.

• Turnaround Time: On-time delivery of complete technical proposals for enterprise compute tenders.

You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.

You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.

• Driving results in complex environments
• Solving business and technology problems
• Building strong client relationships
• Leading and developing teams
• Communicating complex topics clearly
• Collaborating across teams

• Experience in Energy sector (e.g., Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals)
• Track record in IT transformation delivery
• Expertise in IT/ Digital architecture, cloud, data & AI topics
• Strong leadership and stakeholder management
• Excellent academic degree
• Excellent English communication skills, Arabic is a plus.

Who You'll Work With

You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.

## Full Description

Position: Remote Coding Expertise for AI Training (Arabic - Saudi)

Outlier helps the world’s most innovative companies improve their AI models by providing human feedback. Are you an experienced software engineer who would like to lend your coding expertise to train AI models?

We partner with organizations to train AI large language models, helping cutting-edge generative AI models write better code. Projects typically include discrete, highly variable problems that involve engaging with these models as they learn to code. There is no requirement for previous AI experience.

About The Opportunity

• Outlier is looking for talented coders to help train generative artificial intelligence models.

• This freelance opportunity is remote and hours are flexible, so you can work whenever is best for you.

You may contribute your expertise by…

• Crafting and answering questions related to computer science in order to help train AI models.

• Evaluating and ranking code generated by AI models.

Examples Of Desirable Expertise

• Currently enrolled in or completed a bachelor's degree or higher in computer science at a selective institution.

• Proficiency working with one or more of the following languages:

Java, Python, JavaScript / Type Script, C++, Swift, and Verilog.

• Ability to articulate complex concepts fluently in Arabic and English.

• Excellent attention to detail, including grammar, punctuation, and style guidelines.

Payment

• Currently, pay rates for core project work by coding experts range from USD $16 to $33 per hour.

• Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project need, and other factors. For example, higher rates may be offered to PhDs. For non-core work, such as during initial project onboarding or project overtime phases, lower rates may apply. Certain projects offer incentive payments. Please review the payment terms for each project.

We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer based in Saudi Arabia.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will help design, build, and evolve the infrastructure that supports large-scale, customer-facing products.

You will take end-to-end ownership of critical infrastructure systems, from architecture and implementation through production operations and continuous improvement.

The role spans cloud architecture, deployment systems, observability, performance, security, and developer tooling.

You will solve complex distributed-systems challenges while building reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-efficient platforms.

Working closely with product engineering, security, and DevOps teams, you will help services prepare for continued growth and increasing workloads.

You will also act as a technical leader, mentoring engineers and driving cross-team decisions through strong engineering practices and pragmatic problem-solving.
Accountabilities
• Own a core infrastructure product or subsystem end to end, including design, implementation, deployment, operation, and ongoing improvement.
• Define project objectives and measurable success criteria, align technical initiatives with broader business goals, and proactively identify risks.
• Translate product requirements and technical specifications into pragmatic designs that address important edge cases without unnecessary complexity.
• Build and maintain secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-efficient infrastructure supporting diverse applications and workloads.
• Design, develop, and ship software and developer-facing tooling that improves engineering productivity and reduces operational toil.
• Manage infrastructure through code and configuration, primarily using Terraform, while maintaining consistency with broader architectural patterns.
• Partner with product engineering teams to design services for scalability, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and collaborate directly with stakeholders.
• Participate in incident response and apply systematic debugging techniques to diagnose issues within your area and across interconnected services.
• Improve monitoring and observability while using operational data to identify opportunities for better stability, performance, and reliability.
• Apply a security-first mindset to infrastructure and software development, proactively identifying vulnerabilities in your own work and during peer reviews.
• Serve as a technical resource for complex infrastructure challenges and mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions.
• Facilitate collaboration across engineering and other stakeholder groups on technical architecture, processes, and infrastructure priorities.
Requirements
• 6–10 years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering within primarily cloud-based environments, preferably AWS.
• Demonstrated experience owning a significant product, platform component, or subsystem from initial design through production operation and ongoing evolution.
• T-shaped technical expertise, with deep specialization in one or two infrastructure domains combined with enough breadth to navigate and contribute across the wider technology stack.
• Strong hands-on experience managing infrastructure through code and configuration using Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure-as-code solution.
• Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, load balancing, containerization, Kubernetes/EKS, and distributed systems.
• Strong programming skills in Go, Python, or a comparable language, with the ability to build and maintain production-ready software.
• Hands-on experience operating Redis or ElastiCache in production, including cluster and shard management, failover behavior, memory eviction policies, and scaling strategies.
• Experience with observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or comparable platforms, together with practical knowledge of performance tuning and incident management.
• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including source control, code review, comprehensive testing, edge-case handling, and safe deployment practices.
• High level of ownership and autonomy, with demonstrated ability to work effectively when requirements are incomplete or ambiguous.
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and bring engineers and stakeholders together around solutions.
• Strong written and spoken English, including experience producing technical design documents, reviewing pull requests, and communicating project or operational updates.
Benefits
• Competitive compensation aligned with the hiring location, experience, skills, and market conditions.
• Fully remote working environment.
• Opportunity to work on infrastructure supporting high-scale, customer-facing technology.
• Broad technical ownership across cloud architecture, distributed systems, observability, security, performance, and developer tooling.
• Opportunity to collaborate with product engineering, security, and DevOps teams on complex technical challenges.
• Strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.
• Inclusive and collaborative working environment that values diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds.
• Candidates must be authorized to work from their home location; visa sponsorship is not provided.

Manage and support physical and virtual Windows and/or Linux server environments, virtualization, storage, and backup infrastructure.

Recommend improvements to enhance availability, resilience, performance, and security.
Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, SOPs, and recovery documentation.

Coordinate with cloud providers, telecommunications providers, and technology vendors.
Participate in infrastructure projects and technical change-management activities.
Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to internal teams.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
5-10 years of strong hands-on experience with hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
Strong Windows and/or Linux administration and virtualization experience.
Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, and wireless networks.

IT Support Engineer

Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want we will find the means to deliver it. With your help Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds and implement innovation.

This is your chance to make history.

The Amazon IT teams keep our business running smoothly by resolving complex hardware software server and infrastructure issues with both onsite and oncall capacity for our Operations network.

As an IT Support Engineer you will report to the IT Manager at your home site and will be responsible for working closely with the business your colleagues and remote support teams to implement and maintain critical infrastructure elements as well as some day to day support to meet our operations present and future business needs. You will be an escalation point for the team of IT Support Technicians remote teams and Operations on technical issues as well as an interface between these teams as required.

Besides your daytoday activities there will be plenty of opportunities for you to get involved in projects and innovate. You will be a key part of a multinational team thrive in delivering highquality results and always be on the lookout for improvements.

Business Area: Operations Fulfilment Center and Logistics

Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is done on behalf of our customers as meeting their expectations makes us feel good.

The Operations teams in our Fulfilment Centers are responsible for controlling the vast range of fast paced inventory from inbound to outbound and work very hard to ensure that our customers receive what they want when they want it. OpsTechIT is at the heart of this process and plays a vital role to the business ability to meet the customer promise.

Responsibilities

Working as part of a busy support team your key duties will require you to implement and maintain IT infrastructure as well as interfacing confidently both verbally and written to senior management stakeholders at varying levels across multiple business entities. You will provide a support service that ensures all IT equipment and infrastructure is running to its optimum performance and that all departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met on your home site as well as any remote sites that you and your team also support. You will also be running projects across the site working closely with the business fellow engineers and remote support teams to implement changes and/or additions to the sites technology infrastructure to support changing business and IT requirements.

You will also have a keen eye for business and/or technology trends. There is a requirement for occasional travel.

The extent of your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

Managing the availability of all IT equipment and infrastructure through continuous improvement and continuously look to improve equipment efficiencies and cost reductions accordingly.

Liaising with global SME teams to facilitate the installation and maintenance of networking and server infrastructure in accordance to Amazon standards.

The creation review revision and execution of change management requests and project plans as required.

Perform site audits on technical infrastructure to ensure adherence to latest Amazon IT and Health & Safety guidelines as required.

Represent the IT department in site meetings / conference calls and be the point of contact/escalation for the business and other support functions.

Act as a point of contact for contractors or external suppliers and clearly communicate technical issues and Amazon standards.

Undertake project management

o Act as a single point of contact for projects.

o Provide technical and management support/input to site and team projects/initiatives.

o Keep key stakeholders informed of progress of projects and maintain project documentation in the required format.

o Provide validation and sanity check the technical execution of projects.

Provide direction and support to the IT Support Technicians as required with regards to trouble tickets (issues) and action items (requests).

Managing and supporting the updating and auditing of departmental documentation.

Continuously be focused on your customers delivering an outstanding level of service.

Interact with suppliers request quotes and purchase equipment in accordance with policies budgets and operational demand.

Produce weekly reports covering metrics and work performed.

Contribute to the paid oncall schedule covering your home site and sites within your node/region for high severity incidents.

Provide mentoring and training to technicians and other engineers and act as technical contact for remote support teams as and when required.

Support the recruitment of new talent into OpsTechIT (once trained)

1 years of Windows Server technologies: AD DFS Print Services SCCM experience

2 years of troubleshooting in a multiuser high availability environment experience

2 years of PC repair troubleshooting deployment and liquidation experience

1 years of IT client server and network service delivery experience

2 years of networking (such as DNS DHCP SSL OSI Model and TCP/IP) experience

2 years of corporate setting Windows Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience

2 years of supporting and maintaining a corporate network environment experience

High school or equivalent diploma

2 years of computer networking experience

Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment

description_raw:
Job description:

JOB SCOPE

Provide professional support on various of IT programming, application and operation tasks, such as designing, documenting, and coding program logic. Provide technical training, guidance, and resource support for organizations end users and proponent department staff. Provides support and enhancements to existing applications. Support the planning, execution and implementation of various IT programs in compliance with strategies and operational priorities. Engage in technical discussions with stakeholders inside and outside the organization and ensure they provide the best technical solutions in the interest of YASREF. Provide guidance and solutions to project implementation problems.
COMMUNICATION
• Internal : Report and refer on a regular basis with hierarchy. Implement pertinent policies, exchange information, discuss and know relevant KPIs/performance parameters. Provide service to other organizations.
• External: NA.
KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Develop existing applications and contribute to new applications by analysing and identifying areas for modification and improvement. Develop new routine applications to meet customer requirements.
• Research, design, develop and test operating system-level software, compilers, and network distribution software computing applications. Set operational specifications and formulate and analyse software requirements. May design embedded systems software. Apply principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis.
• Document current state architecture, design ideal state architecture and develop plans and solutions to deploy new solutions that meet emerging business needs.
• Create, update and maintain a road map to facilitate application software development and ensure the development work is prioritized in line with business requirements.
• Performs analysis and makes recommendations in areas that require a high level of technical competency. Designs databases and data dictionary criteria.
• Performs a various complex programming tasks, such as designing, documenting, and coding program logic. Provides application support and enhancements to existing applications. Defines system requirements, priorities, and viable alternatives.
• Coordinates the efforts of staff to locate, assess, install, test, and maintain computer software systems. Coordinates conversions and upgrades to vendor systems.
• Performs as a project lead and directs IT systems analysts. Provides leadership and coordination on projects assigned to IT systems analysts. Provides technical training, guidance, and resource support for end users and Departmental staff.
• Develops user documentation and departmental policies and procedures that impact the use of application systems. Continuously monitor system releases and develop applicability to the organization.
• Maintain Standard Operating Procedure for all technology systems and processes. Provide necessary logs and reports to support internal investigations.
• Manage escalations and provide Subject Matter Expert support on recurring incidents. Monitor the systems and user behaviour and report in case of any suspicious activity.
• Design and perform applications software tests and respond to user emails to monitor, diagnose, and correct performance issues. Monitor, identify, and correct straightforward software defects to maintain fully functioning applications software.
• Conduct Horizon scanning, Explore and develop a basic understanding of external developments or emerging issues, and contribute to evaluating their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
• Ensure operational compliance, identify instances of non-compliance with the organization's policies and procedures and/or relevant regulatory codes and codes of conduct, and report, correct, and ensure appropriate compliance.
• Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.
• Ensure compliance with all cybersecurity guidelines and procedures regarding change control, security and auditing, release, configuration, problem, and incident management.
• Monitor daily operational activities to ensure smooth progress. Evaluate overall performance by gathering, analysing and interpreting data and metrics.
• Provide regular updates to Senior Management. Provide end-user training on systems and procedures as needed. Establish a plan and ensure strict adherence from the team for successful project delivery within the agreed timelines.
• Perform other job-related duties as assigned by the direct Supervisor.
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, Computer Engineering or equivalent.
• Professional certification in either of Data Analytics, Data Security, Information System solution architect, IT network, IT audit or equivalent.
YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE

title_raw: Senior Manager - AV And Broadcast Technology Solution - Sport
description_raw:
Senior manager – AV & broadcast technology solutions

The senior manager – AV & broadcast technology solutions is responsible for supporting the strategy, planning, design coordination and technical governance of audiovisual, creative technology, immersive media and integrated digital experience systems across Qiddiya Sports Business Unit assets.

Acting as the Sports Business Unit Center of Excellence representative, the role works closely with development, design, project delivery, operations, asset management, Qiddiya technology and external consultants to ensure that AV, media and creative technology systems deliver world-class fan, athlete and guest experiences while meeting the highest standards of technical performance, operational reliability, cybersecurity, maintainability and long-term sustainability.

The role also requires a strong understanding of ICT infrastructure and digital technologies, recognizing that modern sports and entertainment venues rely on seamless integration between AV, broadcast, networking, operational technology and enterprise platforms.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with strategic thinking, stakeholder management and a passion for innovation. They are comfortable operating across multiple disciplines, translating creative ambitions into technically robust, future-ready solutions that enhance the performance, efficiency and guest experience of Qiddiya's world-class sports assets.

Key responsibilities

Design governance & technical leadership

• Coordinate AV, media and creative technology design across sports venues throughout all project stages.

• Establish and promote technical standards, system architectures and design guidelines across the portfolio.

• Provide specialist technical advisory to development and design teams to ensure consistency, scalability and future readiness.

• Safeguard design intent while balancing operational, technical, programme and budget considerations.

Strategy & innovation

• Contribute to long-term technology roadmaps aligned with Qiddiya's Sports Technology, Innovation and Guest Experience strategies.

• Identify emerging technologies and industry innovations that enhance fan, athlete and operational experiences.

Integrated sports technology

• Support the integration of AV systems with ICT infrastructure, broadcast, communications, venue management platforms, digital signage, IPTV, control systems, operational technologies and other smart venue solutions.

• Promote coordinated design between AV, ICT, MEP, architectural and operational disciplines.

• Evaluate system architectures for resilience, redundancy, cybersecurity, maintainability and lifecycle performance.

Operational readiness

• Ensure AV and creative technology systems are designed for long-term operational performance, maintainability and high-throughput event environments.

• Support development of operational documentation, maintenance strategies, testing and commissioning, training and handover processes.

• Assist transition from project delivery into venue operations.

Stakeholder & vendor management

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across Sports Business Unit, Qiddiya Technology and other corporate functions.

• Coordinate with creative teams, consultants, system integrators, operators and technology vendors.

• Act as a trusted technical interface between creative, technical, operational and commercial stakeholders.

Requirements

Qualifications & experience

• Bachelor's degree in audio engineering, electrical engineering, media technology, entertainment technology, computer engineering, information technology or a related discipline.

• At least 7+ years of relevant experience delivering AV, media or integrated technology systems for internationally recognised sports venues, entertainment destinations, arenas, stadiums, major events or large-scale mixed-use developments.

• Strong understanding of modern audiovisual systems, digital media technologies, IPTV, digital signage, broadcast integration, show control and immersive experiences.

• Good understanding of ICT infrastructure, networking, systems integration and smart venue technologies.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary project teams throughout design and delivery phases.

• Familiarity with procurement processes, consultant management and technical specifications.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to work effectively within complex, fast-paced, multidisciplinary project environments.

Location: Riyadh / NEOM Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA)
Sector: Hyperscale Cloud Operations & AI Infrastructure

Role Type: Full-Time / Permanent

Role Objective
As the Kingdom moves toward becoming a global hub for AI and Cloud technology the stability of our physical and virtual infrastructure is paramount. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to apply a software engineering mindset to system administration. You will be the bridge between our massive physical hardware footprint and the automated software layers that power them ensuring our services are fast reliable and scalable.
Key Responsibilities
1. Infrastructure Automation & IaC
• Replace manual operational tasks with automated workflows using Python Go or Bash.

• Deploy and manage infrastructure using Terraform Ansible or Pulumi (Infrastructure as Code).

• Maintain and scale Kubernetes (K8s) clusters across multiple availability zones within KSA.

2. Monitoring & Incident Management
• Design and implement robust observability stacks using Prometheus Grafana and ELK.

• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to manage high-severity incidents conducting thorough Post-Mortem (RCA) reports to ensure issues do not recur.

• Define and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

3. Performance Tuning & Scaling
• Optimize the interaction between high-performance AI workloads (GPUs) and the underlying Linux kernel/network stack.

• Collaborate with hardware teams to ensure efficient thermal and power consumption during peak loads.

4. Security & Sovereignty
• Implement security protocols in alignment with SDAIA (Saudi Data & AI Authority) and NCA (National Cybersecurity Authority) regulations.

• Ensure data residency requirements are met within the Kingdoms borders.

Required Qualifications & Skills
• Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science Software Engineering or a related field.

• Technical Stack: * Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix administration.

• Experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS GCP Azure or Oracle Cloud).

• Experience: 3 years in an SRE DevOps or Systems Engineering role preferably in a high-scale environment.

• Local Standing: Valid registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE).

Preferred Attributes
• Experience with distributed storage systems (Ceph GlusterFS).

• Knowledge of networking protocols (BGP OSPF) in a data center context.

• Familiarity with the unique infrastructure challenges of NEOMs cognitive city framework.

Own the design, development, and maintenance of our data models and transformation pipelines.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand data needs and build scalable solutions.

Ensure data quality and consistency through rigorous testing, validation, and monitoring practices.

Proactively spot and fix data issues.

Maintain and document the data warehouse structure, data dictionary, and lineage.

Define and enforce data modeling best practices.

Partner with analytics and business teams to optimize self-serve access to reliable metrics and insights.

Improve developer experience across the data stack by automating workflows and simplifying data discovery.

6+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, product analytics infrastructure, or software engineering, including at least 3 years directly owning event instrumentation and tracking.

Proven track record designing an event taxonomy and tracking plan from scratch, and driving genuine adoption across engineering teams.

Hands-on experience with event collection or CDP platforms (Segment, Jitsu, or similar) and product analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, GA4).

Strong software engineering fundamentals, enough production fluency in at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, Go or Python to meaningfully review an engineer's tracking pull request.

Working knowledge of streaming architecture (Kafka or equivalent), including delivery semantics, idempotency, deduplication and late-arriving data.

Experience with server-side tagging, consent management, and privacy regulation.

A clear, defensible point of view on identity resolution, sessionisation, and cross-platform stitching.

Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams without authority, and excellent written communication.

Alnafitha IT is a leading independent provider of IT services and solutions in Saudi Arabia, founded in 1993.

As a fully Saudi-owned company, we have established ourselves from a startup business to a market leader, offering a comprehensive range of IT solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients.

Our expertise spans across various domains, including Microsoft, AWS, ManageEngine, and Zoho Solutions, ensuring that we deliver strategic IT solutions that drive digital transformation and operational excellence to our clients.

With over 30 years of experience, Alnafitha IT has successfully completed more than 4,000 projects, serving over 3,000 satisfied customers, and collaborating with 65+ partners.

Our commitment to excellence is evident in our customer-centric approach, which emphasizes engagement, collaboration, and a relentless pursuit of quality in every interaction

Our vision is to be the Kingdom's most customer-centric provider for digital transformation and consultation, fostering innovation and excellence in all our solutions. We are dedicated to optimizing operational efficiency and ensuring effective resource utilization to enhance customer satisfaction and profitability

At Alnafitha IT, we believe in empowering our employees and nurturing their growth, which is essential for driving leadership in technology and customer satisfaction. As we continue to expand our presence in the IT landscape, we remain committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that not only meet but exceed our clients' expectations.

Job Summary/Objective

The Zoho Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized business solutions using the Zoho platform. The role focuses on building scalable applications, automating business processes, and integrating Zoho products with internal and external systems to enhance operational efficiency and support business objectives.

The Zoho Developer works closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into functional solutions, ensuring high-quality delivery, system reliability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Zoho Solutions Development & Implementation

• Design, develop, and implement solutions across Zoho applications (e.g., Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Zoho Desk, Zoho Books).

• Customize Zoho applications using Deluge scripting, workflows, blueprints, and custom modules to meet business requirements.

• Translate business needs into technical designs, including process flows, data models, and system configurations.

• Configure and deploy Zoho solutions, ensuring alignment with best practices and scalability requirements.

• System Integration

• Integrate Zoho applications with third-party systems, APIs, and internal platforms.

• Develop and manage REST API integrations to enable seamless data exchange between systems.

• Ensure data synchronization, integrity, and consistency across integrated platforms.

• Client & Stakeholder Collaboration

• Work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to gather, analyze, and validate business and technical requirements.

• Provide technical consultation and recommend optimal Zoho-based solutions.

• Support users by troubleshooting issues, resolving defects, and escalating complex cases when needed.

• Quality Assurance & Testing

• Perform unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality and performance.

• Validate all configurations and customizations in sandbox environments prior to production deployment.

• Ensure solutions meet functional, performance, and security standards.

• Technical Documentation

• Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, configurations, and user guides.

• Document integrations, workflows, and customization logic for future scalability and maintenance.

• Training & Support

• Provide training sessions and workshops for clients and internal teams on Zoho applications and implemented solutions.

• Support post-implementation activities, including enhancements, issue resolution, and system optimization.

• Continuous Improvement

• Stay up to date with the latest Zoho platform updates, features, and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to enhance existing solutions, automate processes, and improve system performance.

Requirements

Qualifications
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Experience: 2–4 years of experience in Zoho development or business applications development.
• Hands-on experience with Zoho applications such as Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Zoho Desk, and Zoho Books.
• Strong experience in Deluge scripting and Zoho customization capabilities.
• Experience in API integrations (REST APIs, webhooks).
• Good understanding of databases, data modeling, and cloud-based application development.
• Basic knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
• Zoho certifications (e.g., Zoho Creator Developer, Zoho CRM Developer).
• Experience in building end-to-end Zoho solutions across multiple business functions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Benefits

Alnafitha IT also takes affirmative action to employ, and advance in employment, qualified women, minorities and diversity representations. Job Responsibilities

• Provides technical support for activities related to delivering technical support to internal and external customers.
• Assists in receiving and logging incidents and service requests submitted through approved channels, documenting request details and actions taken, and updating ticket status until closure.
• Assists in providing technical support for meeting rooms, video communication and conferencing systems, and associated devices; diagnoses faults and coordinates with relevant parties when necessary.
• Assists in providing first-level technical support to users, diagnosing faults and issues related to hardware, operating systems, applications, and technical services, and resolving them in accordance with approved procedures.
• Assists in carrying out troubleshooting procedures, including inspecting hardware and software, testing connectivity and services, resetting passwords, and determining the appropriate solution.
• Assists in escalating incidents and issues that cannot be resolved or fall outside their authority to the relevant support teams, providing the necessary information and diagnostic findings, and following up until resolution.
• Assists in preparing user devices and accessories, installing approved operating systems and software, and conducting the necessary tests to ensure readiness.
• Assists in providing remote technical support to users in accordance with approved security policies and procedures, coordinating with relevant parties when necessary.
• Assists in following up on incidents and service requests to ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs), approved priorities, response times, and escalation procedures.
• Assists in verifying that incidents have been resolved and services restored, and communicates with the beneficiary in accordance with approved procedures before closing the ticket.
• Coordinates and follows up on activities related to technical support services provided by external service providers when necessary, and raises observations regarding service levels.
• Assists in reconfiguring and preparing devices for reuse or handover, and contributes to disposal and decommissioning procedures in coordination with the department responsible for asset management.
• Coordinates the preparation and installation of telephone devices and the assignment of numbers to users in accordance with approved procedures and authorities.
• Assists in monitoring and documenting users’ feedback and suggestions and submitting them to the relevant teams to support the improvement of services and the beneficiary experience.
• Applies the approved cybersecurity policies and controls during technical support services, and escalates security cases and observations to the relevant authorities.
• Compliance with the policies, procedures, and approved work controls and behaviors of the organization and the organizational unit.
• Performs any other related tasks within the nature of the job that may be assigned by the direct manager.

Qualification

• A Diploma degree in Information Technology or any related field.

Required Experience

• Minimum of 4 years of experience in a relevant field.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Telecom Engineer with a strong background in substation telecom asset inspection, quality assurance, maintenance, and commissioning for power utility projects. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands‑on experience with SDH, OTN-DWDM, and Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) systems, ensuring compliance with utility standards, project specifications, and quality requirements across electrical substations.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Perform inspection, testing, and quality assurance of substation telecom systems and assets.
• Conduct maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning support for SDH, OTN-DWDM, and Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) networks.
• Verify telecom installations comply with project specifications, utility standards, and approved inspection procedures.
• Prepare and maintain inspection reports, technical documentation, and quality records.
• Coordinate with project engineers, contractors, and client representatives to resolve technical and quality-related issues.
• Support site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning activities, and system handovers.
• Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, quality standards, and client requirements throughout project execution.
• Provide technical recommendations to improve system reliability and operational performance.
• 6 months contract based.
Mandatory Requirements
• Bachelor's Degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in substation telecom systems within power utility projects.
• Proven experience in inspection, quality assurance, maintenance, or commissioning of:
• SDH (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy)
• OTN-DWDM (Optical Transport Network - Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing)
• Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) infrastructure
• Strong knowledge of international and utility standards, inspection procedures, and technical documentation.
• Hands‑on experience in electrical substations and transmission utility environments.
• Excellent communication and technical reporting skills.
• Candidates with Gulf utility project experience are highly preferred.
• Candidates currently based in Saudi Arabia will be given first preference.
#
