Job Purpose

The Network Security Manager is responsible for leading the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of network security across enterprise, data center, and cloud environments.

The role ensures that network infrastructure is securely designed, properly segmented, continuously monitored, and protected against cyber threats while maintaining high availability and performance of business-critical services.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead the Network Security function and provide technical and operational leadership to the team.
• Define and maintain network security architecture, standards, configurations, and operational procedures.
• Manage enterprise and data center security technologies, including firewalls, WAF, VPN, IDS/IPS, secure gateways, and network access controls.
• Design and enforce network segmentation and security zones across data center, cloud, Kubernetes, and enterprise environments.
• Review firewall rules, security policies, NAT configurations, VPN connectivity, and network access requests.
• Ensure secure connectivity between on-premises infrastructure, cloud platforms, partners, and customer environments.
• Work closely with Network, Cloud, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SOC/Cybersecurity, and Architecture teams.
• Lead technical assessment and remediation of network security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
• Support incident response and perform technical investigation of network-related security incidents.
• Implement security monitoring, logging, alerting, and integration with SIEM/SOC platforms.
• Ensure network security controls comply with organizational policies and applicable cybersecurity requirements and standards.
• Conduct periodic reviews of firewall rules, privileged access, network segmentation, and security configurations.
• Evaluate new network security technologies and recommend improvements to the security architecture.
• Manage vendor relationships, support contracts, licensing, capacity, and technology lifecycle for network security solutions.
• Define and report operational KPIs covering security posture, availability, incidents, vulnerabilities, and remediation.
• Coach and develop network security engineers and ensure appropriate knowledge transfer and documentation.

Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
• 7+ years of relevant experience in network and infrastructure security.
• 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership or management role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise firewalls, WAF, VPN, IDS/IPS, routing, switching, and network segmentation.
• Strong hands-on experience with enterprise network and application security technologies, including NGFW, WAF, VPN, IDS/IPS, and Application Delivery Controllers (ADC), with experience in F5 BIG-IP (LTM/ASM/Advanced WAF) highly preferred.
• Experience securing data center, cloud, and container/Kubernetes environments.
• Experience with high-availability and business-critical production environments.
• Good understanding of Zero Trust and defense-in-depth security principles.
• Familiarity with Saudi cybersecurity requirements, particularly NCA cybersecurity controls, is highly desirable.
• Experience with automation, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, or network/security automation is an advantage.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNP Security, Fortinet NSE/FCP/FCSS, Palo Alto PCNSE, Check Point, or equivalent are preferred.

Key Competencies
• Strong technical leadership
• Security architecture and design
• Troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
• Incident management
• Risk-based decision making
• Stakeholder and vendor management
• Documentation and operational discipline
• Team leadership and development

description_raw:
Job Title: Senior Core Network Engineer (Mobile Core, EPC & 5G Core) | SIS Global | Saudi Arabia

Recruiting Company: SIS Global

Job Location: Saudi Arabia

Job Type: Full-Time

Industry: Telecommunications | Mobile Core Networks | EPC | 5G Core

Experience Level: Senior Engineer

Position Summary
SIS Global is seeking a highly experienced Senior Core Network Engineer to support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, optimization, and evolution of mission-critical mobile core network platforms. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring network stability, service continuity, capacity readiness, and operational excellence across legacy, LTE, and 5G Core environments.

Detailed Job Description
As a Senior Core Network Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a broad range of mobile core network elements spanning CS Core, EPC, and 5G Core architectures. You will provide technical leadership for fault management, root cause analysis, software lifecycle activities, performance optimization, and infrastructure governance. Working closely with Network Engineering, Solution Architecture, Customer Support, and Operations teams, you will ensure high network availability and rapid resolution of service-affecting issues. The role demands strong expertise in telecom protocols, end-to-end service tracing, configuration management, and core network modernization initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for a telecom specialist to work within a large-scale operator environment supporting next-generation voice and data services.

Key Responsibilities

• Operate, maintain, and optimize mobile core network platforms across CS Core, EPC, and 5G Core environments.

• Monitor network health, alarms, traffic statistics, and service performance indicators.

• Perform end-to-end service tracing and advanced troubleshooting across voice and data services.

• Conduct fault isolation, root cause analysis, and service restoration activities.

• Support network configuration management and operational change implementation.

• Perform software upgrades, patch management, and platform lifecycle activities.

• Analyze network performance trends and implement optimization initiatives.

• Conduct capacity planning and resource utilization assessments.

• Support security audits, configuration audits, and compliance activities.

• Implement corrective actions to improve service quality and network reliability.

• Collaborate with engineering teams during new node integrations, expansions, and modernization projects.

• Prepare technical reports, operational documentation, and incident analysis reports.

• Support technical escalations and serve as a senior subject matter expert for core network operations.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on experience in Mobile Core Network Operations and Maintenance.

• Proven expertise with MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS, UDC, EIR, PGW/UPG, UPF, and 5GC network functions.

• Strong understanding of Core Network architecture and service delivery mechanisms.

• Deep knowledge of telecom protocols, signaling, and interfaces supporting mobile core networks.

• Experience performing end-to-end tracing, fault isolation, and root cause analysis.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across voice, data, subscriber, and packet core services.

• Experience with configuration management, software upgrades, and patch implementation.

• Knowledge of network capacity management and performance optimization methodologies.

• Experience conducting security reviews and configuration audits.

• Ability to coordinate effectively with Network Engineering, Solution, Operations, and Customer Support teams.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to operate within high-availability carrier-grade network environments.

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with IMS, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and 5G Voice services.

• Knowledge of cloud-native network functions and telecom virtualization platforms.

• Experience with Ericsson, Huawei, Nokia, or Oracle core network solutions.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes, OpenStack, VMware, or containerized telecom environments.

• Experience supporting network transformation and 5G Core migration projects.

• Relevant vendor certifications in Core Network, EPC, IMS, or 5G technologies.

Recruitment Pro Tip
For Senior Core Network Engineering positions, hiring managers prioritize candidates who can demonstrate successful resolution of complex service-impacting incidents. Highlight specific examples involving MSC, HSS, PGW, UPF, or 5GC troubleshooting, large-scale software upgrades, performance optimization initiatives, and measurable improvements in network availability, service quality, or customer experience. Quantifiable operational achievements significantly increase your chances of securing interviews.

title_raw: Senior Hardware Design Engineer - Schematic & PCB Designer
description_raw:
KAEM Solutions is looking for an experienced Senior Hardware Design Engineer based in Saudi Arabia to support the development of a professional embedded communication system.

The overall system architecture and preliminary component selection have already been completed. The selected engineer will be responsible for converting the architecture into complete electrical schematics, PCB layouts, and manufacturing-ready design files using Altium Designer.

Location: Saudi Arabia (Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia preferred)
Employment Type: Full Time
Experience Level: Senior

Key Responsibilities

• Review existing system architecture, block diagrams, and preliminary BOM

• Validate electrical interfaces and component selections before schematic design

• Create complete hierarchical schematics using Altium Designer

• Design multilayer PCBs from schematic through production release

• Design and integrate high-performance MCU/processor circuitry

• Design external memory interfaces and high-speed digital interfaces

• Implement digital and mixed-signal audio circuitry

• Integrate wireless/RF communication modules

• Design multi-rail power supplies for industrial input voltages

• Design protection circuits including ESD, surge, reverse-polarity, and input filtering

• Define PCB stack-up, controlled impedance, routing constraints, and design rules

• Perform BGA component placement and routing

• Address signal integrity, power integrity, grounding, EMI/EMC, and thermal requirements

• Perform ERC and DRC verification

• Prepare complete manufacturing and PCBA documentation

• Support prototype board bring-up, troubleshooting, and design revisions

• Coordinate with firmware engineers and PCB manufacturing partners where required

• Document design decisions, interfaces, test points, and technical assumptions

Required Qualifications

• Bachelors degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a closely related field

• Minimum 5 years of professional electronic hardware design experience

• Strong practical experience with both schematic design and PCB layout

• Advanced proficiency in Altium Designer

• Demonstrated experience designing complex multilayer PCBs

• Experience with BGA processors or high-performance microcontrollers

• Experience with external RAM, Flash, and other high-speed memory interfaces

• Good understanding of high-speed digital PCB design

• Experience with digital audio interfaces such as I2S, PCM, TDM, or similar

• Experience with mixed-signal audio circuits, DACs, microphones, and audio amplifiers

• Experience integrating RF or wireless communication modules

• Experience with industrial power-supply design

• Strong knowledge of grounding, EMI/EMC, ESD, and surge protection

• Understanding of PCB signal integrity and power integrity

• Experience preparing designs for PCB fabrication and PCBA manufacturing

• Experience supporting prototype bring-up and hardware debugging

Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in one or more of the following will be highly preferred:

• Professional audio systems

• Intercom or communication systems

• Industrial electronics

• Automotive electronics

• Real-time embedded systems

• High-speed memory routing

• MIPI, USB, Ethernet, or similar interfaces

• Class-D audio amplifier design

• Long-distance digital communication interfaces

• RF module and antenna integration

• Product certification and EMC testing

Tools
Strong experience with the following is expected:

• Altium Designer

• Oscilloscope

• Logic analyzer

• Digital multimeter

• Bench power supply

• Hardware debugging and prototype bring-up tools

Deliverables
The engineer will be expected to produce:

• Complete Altium schematic source files

• Complete PCB layout source files

• Component libraries, symbols, and footprints

• Final BOM

• Gerber/manufacturing files

• NC drill files

• Pick-and-place files

• Fabrication and assembly drawings

• PCB stack-up and controlled-impedance requirements

• STEP/3D board models

• Test-point and debug documentation

• Manufacturing-ready DFM package

All editable design files and project source files will remain the property of KAEM Solutions.

Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who has personally taken complex electronic products through the complete process of:

Architecture review Schematic design PCB layout Prototype manufacturing Hardware bring-up Debugging Design revision Production release

Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to basic 2-layer boards, Arduino-style projects, or simple development-board integrations may not be suitable for this position.

Shortlisted candidates will receive detailed project documentation after signing a confidentiality agreement.

description_raw:
Team: Media & Fan Marketing

Activity: Full-time

Role grade: (7)

Direct reports: 0

Indirect reports: 0

Reporting to: Director Digital Products

Role location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Job Purpose: As the Senior Manager Digital Products Growth & Engagement, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for fan growth, engagement, and retention across our web and mobile digital experiences. This role is accountable for executing large-scale, moment-driven events and potentially turning them into a continuous, year-round digital ecosystem. You will design and scale powerful engagement loops using gamification systems, personalization, and messaging, while partnering closely with internal and external teams and partners.

Duties And Responsibilities

• Growth Strategy: Define and own the fan growth, engagement, and retention roadmap across web and mobile platforms.
• Gamification Systems: Design, build, and scale loyalty programs, quests, progression systems, and engagement mechanics that drive repeat participation.
• Special Products: Own the strategy, expansion, and execution of fantasy leagues, predictions, and other interactive fan products.
• Lifecycle Optimization: Define and continuously optimize the end-to-end fan journeys, from initial activation through post-event re-engagement.
• Experimentation & Optimization: Drive a culture of experimentation through split testing and rapid iteration to systematically improve engagement and retention.
• Narrative Integration: Partner with creative and content teams to translate brand narratives and storylines into compelling digital engagement experiences.
• Commercial Alignment: Collaborate with commercial teams to design and execute sponsor-safe engagement activations.
• Performance Tracking: Define, track, and report on engagement performance using clear, data-driven KPIs.
• Opportunity Identification: Identify and validate new digital growth opportunities based on fan behavior analysis, product insights, and brand alignment.

Education And Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Digital Media, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in digital product management, growth product, or consumer engagement roles.
• Proven track record in owning growth, engagement, and retention strategies for large-scale consumer digital platforms.
• Hands-on experience designing and scaling gamification systems, loyalty programs, or engagement loops.
• Strong experience working with cross-functional teams, including marketing, content, community, engineering, analytics, and commercial partners.
• Experience in sports, gaming, entertainment, or live event ecosystems is strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

• Deep understanding of growth product principles, engagement loops, and product lifecycle management.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into product strategy and experimentation plans.
• Experience with personalization, segmentation, CRM, and notification systems.
• Proven ability to balance creative storytelling with data-driven decision making.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across senior team members, without direct authority.
• Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-visibility environments with evolving priorities.

Benefits

• Relocation support
• Transportation allowance
• Competitive compensation
• Housing allowance
• VIP medical insurance
• Opportunity to work on a new exciting project with a group of passionate professionals. You will get the freedom to excel and make a real impact

Diversity disclaimer

Our mission is to build a diverse organization where our members, regardless of background or identity, have a sense of belonging. We genuinely believe that thanks to creating a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued, we can achieve more. Together, we want to reshape the boundaries of what is achievable in the esports domain.

description_raw:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product/UI Designer to take ownership of the visual design language across our digital products. You will work closely with UX Researchers, Product Managers, and Front-End Engineers to transform user needs, research insights, and product requirements into polished, intuitive, accessible, and on-brand digital experiences.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who combines strong visual/UI craft with product thinking, understands how design decisions impact users and business outcomes, and can take designs from early concepts through to developer-ready implementation.

Key Responsibilities
• Design high-fidelity UI for web and mobile products, from wireframes through to final developer-ready screens using Figma.
• Build interactive micro-prototypes to demonstrate interactions, animations, transitions, and component behavior before development handoff.
• Own, build, and continuously evolve the design system, including components, patterns, design tokens, documentation, and governance.
• Translate UX research, user journeys, and flows into clear, consistent, and intuitive visual experiences.
• Partner closely with UX Researchers and Product Managers to ensure designs address real user needs and business objectives.
• Collaborate with Front-End Engineers to ensure a high level of design fidelity in the final product.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews.
• Present and defend design decisions to both design and non-design stakeholders, using user insights and data to support recommendations.
• Incorporate feedback from usability testing, stakeholder reviews, and product teams into design iterations.
• Maintain strong attention to typography, layout, color, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and accessibility.
• Stay up to date with UI/UX trends, accessibility standards, and platform guidelines across Web, iOS, and Android.

Requirements

Experience
• 5–6 years of relevant professional experience in Product/UI Design.
• Strong professional experience designing digital products, ideally within a product-led, SaaS, or technology environment.
• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UI design work, including the reasoning behind design decisions and their impact on users and business outcomes.
• Proven experience building and maintaining design systems at scale.
• Experience working within Agile, cross-functional product teams.

Technical & Design Skills
• Expert-level Figma skills, including component architecture, Auto Layout, variants, variables/tokens, and scalable file structures.
• Strong experience creating interactive prototypes and micro-interactions in Figma or tools such as ProtoPie.
• Hands-on experience creating and maintaining design systems, including component libraries, design tokens, documentation, and governance.
• Strong understanding of visual design fundamentals, including typography, layout, color, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
• Strong understanding of interaction design, responsive design, and micro-interactions.
• Working knowledge of WCAG/accessibility standards.
• Understanding of front-end constraints; basic knowledge of HTML/CSS is advantageous.
• Comfortable presenting, explaining, and defending design decisions using user research and data.

Nice to Have
• Experience designing for Arabic RTL and English LTR interfaces.
• Knowledge of Saudi DGA standards, regulations, or Digital Maturity metrics.
• Experience with motion/prototyping tools such as ProtoPie or After Effects.
• Basic understanding of front-end frameworks such as React.
• Experience designing products for both Web and mobile platforms.

What You'll Achieve
• Deliver polished and user-friendly digital experiences that are consistent across platforms.
• Help establish and continuously improve a scalable design system that supports the growth of the product.
• Ensure a smooth transition from design concepts to high-quality final implementation in collaboration with engineering teams.
• Create design solutions that balance user needs, product objectives, and business priorities.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Saudi Arabia.

This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.

You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.

The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.

The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.

This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.

Accountabilities

• Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.

• Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.

• Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.

• Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.

• Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.

• Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.

• Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.

• Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.

• Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.

• Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

Requirements

• Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.

• Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.

• Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.

• Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools.

• Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools.

• Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling.

• Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued.

• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements.

• SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.

• Experience with distributed systems is a plus.

• Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.

• A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality improvements across the wider engineering lifecycle.

Benefits

• Competitive, market-aligned compensation.

• Fully remote-friendly working environment, with flexibility around working hours.

• Opportunity to work on a high-impact fintech product handling real-world global payment flows.

• Modern technology stack and engineering-focused environment.

• Exposure to scalable distributed systems, external financial integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

• International and distributed team with a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture.

• Supportive environment that encourages ownership, technical growth, and continuous improvement.

• Opportunities to work with modern QA automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.

This is an opportunity for an experienced full-stack engineer to build and support scalable, cloud-based applications.

You will work across modern front-end and back-end technologies, combining React, .NET, C#, REST APIs, and AWS serverless services.

The role offers broad ownership across application design, development, architecture, testing, deployment, and production support.

description_raw:
Job Summary

The Sr Test Analyst role focuses on validating complex web services and application programming interfaces for enterprise billing and revenue management systems in a work from office environment. The role involves designing executing and automating test scenarios for Rest and Soap based services ensuring data integrity using structured query language and collaborating closely with developers and analysts to maintain high quality releases for global customers.
Responsibilities
• Design comprehensive test strategies and test cases for web services testing using structured query language and industry tools to ensure complete validation of functional and non functional requirements
• Execute thorough application programming interface testing for Rest and Soap based services to verify request response flows data accuracy and integration consistency across upstream and downstream systems
• Create detailed test data sets using structured query language queries to validate complex business rules transformations and billing scenarios while maintaining strict data quality standards
• Use Postman to design automate and execute collections for regression and smoke testing of critical application programming interfaces improving test repeatability and reducing execution effort
• Apply SoapUI to model service contracts create reusable test suites and validate responses for Soap based services ensuring alignment with interface specifications and service level expectations
• Perform end to end validation of billing and revenue management workflows by combining user interface tests structured query language based data checks and application programming interface validations to ensure reliability and accuracy
• Document clear reproducible defects with detailed steps logs payloads and structured query language evidence to support efficient triage and timely resolution by engineering and analyst teams
• Collaborate with developers product analysts and operations partners in a work from office model to clarify requirements review interface designs and align test coverage with priority business outcomes
• Analyze test execution results to identify trends recurring defects and coverage gaps and propose practical improvements in services data validations or test design that increase product robustness
• Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by refining templates enhancing test data management and promoting better use of Postman SoapUI and structured query language based checks across the team
• Support production readiness by participating in release validations performing sanity checks on key billing and revenue management flows and confirming that deployed services behave as expected in target environments
• Maintain clear traceability between requirements test cases and execution results to provide transparent quality status for stakeholders and to support audit or compliance needs
• Share knowledge on web services testing practices and tools with peers helping build a stronger quality culture that supports the company mission of delivering reliable digital solutions that positively impact customers and society
Qualifications
• Understand core concepts of software testing including test design techniques defect lifecycle risk based testing and regression optimization for service oriented systems
• Demonstrate strong proficiency with application programming interface testing using Postman including collection design environment configuration parameterization and validation scripts
• Apply advanced structured query language skills to join tables validate business rules verify data integrity and troubleshoot discrepancies across billing and transactional data sets
• Use SoapUI effectively to create functional regression and data driven test suites for Soap services including assertions on response structures status codes and business fields
• Interpret and test Rest service specifications including endpoints methods request payloads response formats and error handling ensuring services meet expected interface and performance behavior
• Draw on prior experience in billing and revenue management domains when available to design realistic scenarios validate rating and invoicing flows and identify defects that affect financial accuracy
• Communicate clearly with cross functional teams in a work from office setting documenting scenarios providing status updates and explaining issues in a concise and collaborative manner
• Adapt quickly to changing priorities and new service integrations in an agile environment while maintaining disciplined test planning execution and evidence collection practices
Certifications Required
• ISTQB Foundation Level or Certified Software Test Professional or equivalent certification in software testing or quality assurance

About the Role

As a Technical Project Manager, you’ll lead the delivery of CCTV and physical security technology projects from initial design and estimation through deployment and ongoing support. You’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with strong project management skills to ensure systems are designed, quoted, and implemented accurately. Your responsibilities will span CCTV layouts, network integration, hardware selection, project scheduling, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication. You’ll work with clients, technicians, vendors, and internal teams to keep complex deployments on track. Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals will be essential for configuring and troubleshooting reliable security systems. This is a fully remote, autonomous role offering the opportunity to manage impactful technology projects in a fast-paced, service-focused environment.

Accountabilities

• Design detailed CCTV system layouts, including camera placement, coverage maps, system schematics, and configurations tailored to client requirements.

• Manage CCTV and physical security projects end to end, from initial planning and design through deployment, completion, and support.

• Establish project timelines, coordinate resources, monitor progress, and keep clients and stakeholders informed throughout the project lifecycle.

• Apply networking expertise to support reliable system deployments, including IP addressing, subnets, switches, routers, PoE, port forwarding, bandwidth, and storage considerations.

• Configure and troubleshoot network-connected CCTV infrastructure, including NVR and DVR systems.

• Prepare accurate project quotes, scopes of work, hardware bills of materials (BOMs), and cost estimates using relevant quoting and estimating tools.

• Select appropriate cameras, networking equipment, recording hardware, and other system components based on project requirements.

• Collaborate with field technicians and vendor partners to coordinate installation activities and resolve technical or operational issues.

• Communicate professionally with clients and project stakeholders through phone, video, and written channels, providing clear technical updates and support.

• Maintain accurate project documentation and use project management systems to track tasks, deadlines, resources, and deliverables.

Requirements

• Proven experience managing the full lifecycle of CCTV, physical security, or related technology deployment projects.

• Strong practical knowledge of network architecture and troubleshooting, including LAN/WAN environments, IP routing, subnets, PoE switching, port forwarding, bandwidth, and storage calculations.

• Demonstrated ability to design CCTV layouts and determine suitable camera types, placements, configurations, and supporting hardware.

• Experience with NVR/DVR systems and the integration of CCTV infrastructure with IP networks.

• Hands-on experience using project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Jira, or Monday.com.

• Familiarity with digital quoting, estimating, and bill-of-materials tools.

• Experience using Dialpad or comparable VoIP and communication platforms for client and team interactions.

• Exceptional written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, technicians, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.

• Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical and project-related issues.

• Comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.

• A reliable, quiet, and professional home-office setup with stable high-speed internet suitable for regular client and team calls.

Benefits

• 100% remote: Work remotely from Poland as part of a globally distributed team.

• Full-time position: Take ownership of projects and contribute to the successful delivery of technology deployments.

• Flexible schedule: Benefit from flexible working arrangements aligned with core client operating hours.

• Global scope: Collaborate remotely with clients, technicians, vendors, and stakeholders across different locations.

• Technical variety: Work across CCTV, networking, project management, system design, quoting, and deployment coordination.

• High autonomy: Manage projects independently while having a direct impact on project quality, timelines, and customer outcomes.

description_raw:
Role Summary:

As a Technology Business Specialist at Lifera, you will serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and the Digital & IT delivery teams. In this role, you will elicit, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements, optimize operational workflows, and support the implementation of robust, scalable enterprise digital solutions across our expanding biopharma operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Requirements Elicitation & Management: Gather, validate, and document business, functional, and technical requirements for enterprise systems and digital solutions.

• Process Optimization: Analyze existing business and operational workflows, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and design IT-enabled process improvements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with business units, IT delivery teams, and project managers to define scope, prioritize backlogs, and track project deliverables.

• Implementation Support: Assist in solution delivery, configuration reviews, system integration support, and technical documentation.

• Quality & Testing Orchestration: Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), define test cases/criteria, coordinate user feedback loops, and track defect resolution.

• Change Management & Adoption: Prepare end-user documentation, deliver training sessions, and champion change management for smooth digital adoption.

• Strategic Alignment: Contribute to digital product roadmaps and strategic IT initiatives aligned with Lifera's broader business and transformation objectives.

Qualifications & Experience

Mandatory Requirements

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related discipline.

• Experience: 3–4 years of hands‑on experience in business analysis, systems analysis, or IT solution delivery.

• Methodologies & Tooling: Strong proficiency in business analysis frameworks (e.g., BABOK), SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall), process mapping (BPMN), and standard tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Visio).

• Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management, presentation, and analytical problem‑solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional certifications in business analysis (e.g., IIBA-CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA).

• Prior exposure to enterprise environments in biopharma, life sciences, healthcare, or regulated manufacturing sectors (familiarity with GxP, CSV, or SAP environments is a plus).

description_raw:
Role Summary The Venue Technology Coordinator supports the day-to-day delivery of technology services at tournament venues. The role assists with equipment setup, testing, basic troubleshooting and coordination with technical teams and suppliers to help ensure venue technology is ready and operational.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee daily operations of venue technology systems (AV, networking, ticketing, access control, etc.)

• Monitor system performance and promptly troubleshoot technical issues

• Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for equipment maintenance and upgrades

• Support setup and teardown of technology for events and functions

• Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance checks

• Maintain accurate documentation of technical assets and incidents

• Provide on-call technical support during live events and peak operational hours

Required Skills

• Strong understanding of AV, IT networking, and venue technology infrastructure

• Problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities under time pressure

• Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and event days

• Basic project coordination and vendor management experience

Required Qualifications

• Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or related field

• Relevant technical certifications (networking, AV systems) preferred

• Valid work authorization for Saudi Arabia

• Willingness to work on-site at venue locations as required

Experience Requirement

• At least 1 year of experience in venue operations, event technology, or technical support roles

• Prior experience in live large-scale event or venue environments is highly preferred

Location / Work Mode

Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia — On-site
